prs.title: fix(agents): keep A2A tasks recoverable after transcript read errors
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Session-based A2A requests return the existing retryable JSON-RPC error `-32012` when a filesystem error prevents reply lookup in an active or archived transcript. The failing observation saves no task result. Once reads recover, the same task can report `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with its original reply.

## Why it's needed

A transient read error could make a recorded reply appear absent and cause a completed task to be permanently saved as `TASK_STATE_FAILED`. A permissions check can still succeed when the actual read fails. The linked issue reproduces this with injected `EIO`. [Issue #13738](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13738), [earlier proposal and review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13797).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From `packages/cli`, run `npx --no-install vitest run --coverage.enabled=false src/serve/routes/a2a.test.ts -t 'after an EIO'`. The regression cases inject a stream read failure in each transcript location. Check that `GetTask`, `ListTasks`, `CancelTask`, and a replay of `SendMessage` return `-32012` with no internal path details and no saved task result. After restoring the stream, poll the same task with `GetTask` and check that it returns and saves `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with the original reply. The cases also check the oversized archive and unexpected-error paths.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The local JSON-RPC daemon probe used the same recorded-reply fixtures for both versions. On installed Qwen Code 0.27.3, polling under `EIO` returned and saved `TASK_STATE_FAILED` for both transcript locations. Polling after recovery returned the same state. In the fixed bundle, polling under the same fault returned `-32012` and the task mappings contained no result. The next poll returned and saved `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with the original reply. Healthy, missing-transcript, and mismatched-reply controls produced the expected results on both versions.

Build, bundle, typecheck, focused ESLint and Prettier checks, and the focused CLI and core suites passed. The suites ran 22 CLI tests and 391 core tests.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status        |
| :--------: | :------------ |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested     |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 27.0 arm64 and Node 22.18.0 for the fixed bundle. The probe used a local `serve` daemon with experimental agent collaboration enabled and synthetic on-disk fixtures.

## Risk & Scope

- An unreadable active transcript takes precedence over the archived copy because the archive may hold a stale reply. The session loaders use strict reads by opt-in, with A2A as the sole caller that enables them.
- Previously saved failures, malformed reply records, and concurrent archive restoration are outside the fix. The existing cancellation decision and receipt behavior still depend on observing the task.
- The fix uses the existing task schema, storage format, and JSON-RPC code. It requires no data migration.

[Design document (Simplified Chinese)](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/350a7e3f7a3850d4f8bdb3b8b3784c897f832537/docs/design/managed-agents/a2a-transcript-read-recovery.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13738

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

基于会话的 A2A 请求在活动或归档 transcript 因文件系统错误而无法查找回复时，返回现有的可重试 JSON-RPC 错误 `-32012`。本次失败的观测不会保存任务结果。读取恢复后，同一个任务可以返回 `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` 和原回复。

## Why it's needed

瞬时读取错误可能让已记录的回复看起来缺失，导致已经完成的任务被永久保存为 `TASK_STATE_FAILED`。即使实际读取失败，权限检查仍可能通过。关联 issue 使用注入的 `EIO` 复现了这个问题。[Issue #13738](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13738)、[早期方案及评审](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13797)。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

在 `packages/cli` 运行 `npx --no-install vitest run --coverage.enabled=false src/serve/routes/a2a.test.ts -t 'after an EIO'`。回归用例分别在两处 transcript 注入流读取故障。确认 `GetTask`、`ListTasks`、`CancelTask` 和同请求重发的 `SendMessage` 返回 `-32012`，响应不包含内部路径，任务也没有保存结果。恢复读取后，通过 `GetTask` 查询同一个任务，确认返回并保存 `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` 和原回复。用例也检查归档超出大小限制和未预期错误的处理路径。

### Evidence (Before & After)

本地 JSON-RPC daemon 探针对两个版本使用了相同的已记录回复 fixture。使用已安装的 Qwen Code 0.27.3 时，两处 transcript 在 `EIO` 期间的查询都返回并保存 `TASK_STATE_FAILED`。读取恢复后查询仍返回相同状态。使用修复后的 bundle，在相同故障下查询返回 `-32012`，任务映射没有保存结果。下一次查询返回并保存了 `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` 和原回复。正常 transcript、文件缺失以及回复属于其他 run 的对照在两个版本上均符合预期。

构建、打包、类型检查、定向 ESLint 与 Prettier 检查，以及 CLI 和 core 定向测试均通过。两套测试分别运行了 22 项和 391 项。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status        |
| :--------: | :------------ |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested     |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

修复后的 bundle 使用 macOS 27.0 arm64 和 Node 22.18.0。探针在启用实验性 Agent 协作的本地 `serve` daemon 中运行，使用合成的磁盘 fixture。

## Risk & Scope

- 活动 transcript 无法读取时优先报告该故障，因为归档副本里的回复可能已过时。加载器以显式启用的方式使用严格读取，只有 A2A 调用方启用。
- 之前已保存的失败、损坏的回复记录和并发归档还原超出本次修复范围。现有的取消决策和回执仍依赖于观测任务。
- 修复沿用现有任务数据结构、存储格式和 JSON-RPC 错误码，无需数据迁移。

[中文设计文档](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/350a7e3f7a3850d4f8bdb3b8b3784c897f832537/docs/design/managed-agents/a2a-transcript-read-recovery.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

</details>

prs.body:
## What this PR does Allows a clean idle suspension or Action park to release its Session placement after the durable wake-stamped seal, so another healthy Harness can take over before the old writer lease expires. The release uses a new additive writer-grant capability, preserves wake and parked-Turn certificates, and retries only the placement release without repeating activation release or sealing. Adds a bounded pool-refresh reaper for expired clean-suspension placements left by departed or known-unreachable instances. It transfers ownership through the existing takeover CAS without manufacturing release receipts or opening a Harness attachment. Recovery still happens only when a real request or wake loads the Session. Design documents: [suspension placement release (EN)](docs/design/2026-11-26-managed-suspension-placement-release.md) / [挂起 placement 释放（中文）](docs/design/2026-11-26-managed-suspension-placement-release.zh-CN.md), and [departed-placement reaper (EN)](docs/design/2026-11-26-managed-departed-placement-reaper.md) / [离池 placement 回收（中文）](docs/design/2026-11-26-managed-departed-placement-reaper.zh-CN.md). Both language versions contain the same decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria and follow-up work. ## Why it's needed Suspension already releases Harness memory and renewal work, but a sealed Session previously remained pinned to its old placement owner until writer-lease expiry. A healthy pool therefore could not rebalance promptly, and a crash between seal and release or a smaller-pool restart left stale ownership behind. This PR enables immediate healthy-member handover for clean releases and conservative background reclamation for expired legacy rows, without weakening writer, activation or tenant fencing. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify - Start two healthy Harness members and park a Session on A. Confirm A seals and releases the placement, B acquires the next epoch while A's old lease is still live, and the old writer cannot mutate the successor. For Action parking, Allow must execute exactly once and Deny zero times; cancellation, mode change and expiry retain their existing behavior. - Inject a lost release acknowledgement. Confirm the identical operation ID and proof are retried without another quiesce, activation release or seal, and bare/stale seals cannot release. - Leave an expired wake-stamped placement on a departed or known-unreachable owner and refresh the pool with a healthy successor. Confirm the existing CAS transfers ownership without a release record or attachment, and only the subsequent explicit load restores the Session. Healthy, draining, uncertain-discovery and unknown-health members must not be reclaimed; unreachability alone is not sufficient proof. - Regression evidence on the merged PR head: `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run bundle` passed; core Store tests 256/256 passed; CLI suspension and Action-parking tests 114/114 passed; Java placement and pool tests 54/54 passed with both Checkstyle executions at zero violations. - Merged-head real MySQL 8.4 verification: Hosted pool scenarios passed 3/3, all five Action outcomes passed 5/5, and `HarnessPlacementMySqlIT` passed 18/18. The real A/B reaper scenario produced no attachment or release record before explicit load, then restored successfully and rejected the old writer credential. - Full real-process evidence is recorded separately with disposable MySQL 8.4 instances and residual-process checks. ### Evidence (Before & After) N/A — control-plane and Harness lifecycle changes with no user-facing UI changes. Before: a clean seal remained pinned until lease expiry and departed placements required request-driven recovery. After: healthy handover can occur immediately, and expired legacy placements are reclaimed without opening attachments. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested locally with disposable MySQL 8.4.11 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally; CI | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally; CI | ### Environment (optional) Local macOS ARM64, Node 24.12.0, JDK 21.0.8, Maven 3.9.12, disposable MySQL 8.4.11, repository-built `dist/cli.js`. No external model service was used. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: additional ownership transitions and release writes can increase cold-open churn and Store load. The change preserves the existing takeover protocol, uses strict lease/seal/activation proof, keeps reaper batches bounded, and defers all actual recovery to the normal load path. - Not validated / out of scope: boot-level reclamation when a still-configured instance has a healthy replacement incarnation, dedicated crash injection exactly between seal and release, and a healthy two-member Action-parked Allow/Deny soak. Action replacement outcomes, new-epoch Action recovery and healthy idle handover are covered separately. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The writer-grant field is additive, older grants retain bare-seal behavior, and no configuration, public route or schema migration is introduced. ## Linked Issues Refs #18149
中文说明 ## 这个 PR 做了什么 允许干净的空闲挂起或 Action park 在持久化 wake-stamped seal 后释放 Session placement，使另一个健康 Harness 能在旧 writer lease 到期前接管。释放通过新增的增量 writer-grant 能力位协商，保留 wake 和 parked-Turn 证书，并且失败时只重试 placement release，不重复 activation release 或 seal。 在 pool refresh 中新增有界 reaper，处理离池或已知不可达实例遗留的到期干净挂起 placement。它通过现有 takeover CAS 转移所有权，不伪造 release receipt，也不打开 Harness attachment。只有真实请求或 wake 加载 Session 时才执行恢复。 设计文档：[挂起 placement 释放（英文）](docs/design/2026-11-26-managed-suspension-placement-release.md) / [挂起 placement 释放（中文）](docs/design/2026-11-26-managed-suspension-placement-release.zh-CN.md)，以及[离池 placement 回收（英文）](docs/design/2026-11-26-managed-departed-placement-reaper.md) / [离池 placement 回收（中文）](docs/design/2026-11-26-managed-departed-placement-reaper.zh-CN.md)。两种语言完整同步了设计决策、约束、验收标准和后续工作。 ## 为什么需要 挂起原本已经释放 Harness 内存和续约工作，但 sealed Session 在 writer lease 到期前仍固定在旧 placement owner 上。健康池因此无法及时重新均衡，seal 与 release 之间崩溃或以更小池重启也会遗留陈旧所有权。本 PR 让干净释放可以立即健康接管，并以保守的后台回收处理到期历史行，同时不削弱 writer、activation 或 tenant fencing。 ## 评审者验证计划 ### 如何验证 - 启动两个健康 Harness 成员，在 A 上 park 一个 Session。确认 A 完成 seal 和 placement release，B 在 A 的旧 lease 未到期时取得下一个 epoch，旧 writer 不能修改后继状态。Action parking 中 Allow 必须恰好执行一次，Deny 零次；取消、模式切换和到期保持现有行为。 - 注入 release 响应丢失。确认使用相同 operation ID 和 proof 重试，不重复 quiesce、activation release 或 seal，bare/stale seal 不能释放。 - 在离池或已知不可达 owner 上遗留到期的 wake-stamped placement，使用健康后继刷新池。确认现有 CAS 在没有 release 记录和附件的情况下转移所有权，只有后续显式 load 才恢复 Session。健康、drain、discovery 不确定和健康状态未知的成员不得被回收；仅不可达并不足以证明。 - 合并后 PR head 的回归证据：`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 和 `npm run bundle` 通过；core Store 测试 256/256 通过；CLI 挂起与 Action-parking 测试 114/114 通过；Java placement 与 pool 测试 54/54 通过，两个 Checkstyle execution 均为零违规。 - 合并后 head 的真实 MySQL 8.4 验证：Hosted pool 场景 3/3 通过，五种 Action 结局 5/5 通过，`HarnessPlacementMySqlIT` 18/18 通过。真实 A/B reaper 场景在显式 load 前没有附件或 release 记录，随后成功恢复，并拒绝旧 writer 凭证。 - 完整真实进程证据使用一次性 MySQL 8.4 实例单独记录，并检查残留进程。 ### 前后证据（Before & After） N/A——这是控制面与 Harness 生命周期改动，没有用户界面变化。之前：干净 seal 在 lease 到期前保持粘滞，离池 placement 只能依赖请求驱动恢复。之后：健康成员可以立即接管，到期历史 placement 也能在不打开附件的情况下回收。 ### 已测试系统 | 系统 | 状态 | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已使用一次性 MySQL 8.4.11 本地验证 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未本地验证；交由 CI | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未本地验证；交由 CI | ### 环境（可选） 本机 macOS ARM64、Node 24.12.0、JDK 21.0.8、Maven 3.9.12、一次性 MySQL 8.4.11、仓库构建的 `dist/cli.js`。未使用外部模型服务。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：额外所有权转换和 release 写入可能增加冷启动抖动与 Store 负载。本改动保留现有 takeover 协议，使用严格的 lease/seal/activation 证明，限制 reaper 批次，并将所有实际恢复推迟到正常 load 路径。 - 未验证或不在范围内：仍在配置中的实例出现健康替换 incarnation 时按 boot 回收、专门注入 seal 与 release 之间的崩溃，以及健康双成员 Action-parked Allow/Deny soak。Action replacement 结局、新 epoch Action 恢复和健康 idle 接管已分别覆盖。 - 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。writer-grant 字段为增量字段，旧 grant 保持 bare-seal 行为，不引入新配置、公开路由或 schema migration。 ## 关联 Issue Refs #18149

prs.title: fix(web-shell): pass the reasoning selection at standalone session creation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A standalone session creation now carries the reasoning effort picked in the native model menu together with the model, instead of leaving it to the post-create `reasoning_effort` setter. The daemon echoes the effort it actually applied on the create response, and Web Shell skips the setter when that echo matches the selection. A create that carried an effort but did not apply it now fails closed and releases the session rather than running on a value the user did not pick. The setter path is kept for creates that carry no model.

## Why it's needed

Before this change, `createAndAttachSessionForPrompt` folded `modelServiceId` and `approvalMode` into the standalone create request but left the reasoning selection out, so a create with a model and an effort always ended with a post-create setter. Embedded hosts that only accept initial session configuration reject that later update, so the first prompt never went out with the effort the user had chosen.

After this change, selecting `Thinking off` (`none`) or a non-default effort before lazy creation is applied at spawn, and no post-create update is issued for it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The create contract is the only thing that changes, so the discriminating checks are the request shape and the confirmation branch.

1. `packages/web-shell`: `client/utils/sessionPreparation.test.ts` — new cases assert `reasoningEffort` rides with the create for `none` and `low` on both the attached and detached first-prompt paths, that no `reasoningEffort` is sent when nothing was selected, that a create without a model keeps the post-create setter, and that a create which does not confirm the effort releases the session.
2. `packages/web-shell`: `client/daemon/session/actions.test.ts` — new cases assert the effort reaches `createDetachedStandaloneSession` on the attached and detached branches, that an echo of a different effort (or no echo) rejects, and that a non-standalone create rejects `reasoningEffort`.
3. `packages/sdk-typescript`: `test/unit/DaemonClientStandalone.test.ts` — create-request/response parsing still passes with the new `reasoningEffortApplied` field.

A red run of the regression case before the fix showed the create request with no `reasoningEffort`; the same case passes after it.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — the change is a request/response contract plus the client branch that consumes it; no visible layout changes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests through the package `vitest` configs; `tsc --noEmit` for `packages/web-shell` and `packages/sdk-typescript`, plus `eslint` and `prettier --check` on the changed files.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the confirmation depends on the daemon echoing `reasoningEffortApplied`. A daemon that predates this field drops it, and a create that carried both a model and an effort then fails closed instead of silently continuing; the previous behaviour was a post-create setter that hosts with initial-only configuration reject anyway. Creates without a model keep the old setter path unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: no end-to-end run against a real embedded host that rejects post-create updates; the evidence is the request shape and the confirmation branch. Windows and Linux were not exercised locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for existing callers. `reasoningEffort` is optional, has no effect on daemons that ignore it except the fail-closed path above, and the model-less create keeps the current setter.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #18313

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

独立会话创建现在会把原生模型菜单里选中的推理强度与模型一起带进创建请求，而不再依赖创建之后的 `reasoning_effort` setter。守护进程会在创建响应里回显实际生效的强度，Web Shell 在回显与所选值一致时跳过 setter。如果创建时带了强度但实际没有生效，现在会直接失败并释放会话，而不是让会话跑在用户没有选择的值上。没有携带模型的创建仍保留 setter 路径。

## 为什么需要

改动之前，`createAndAttachSessionForPrompt` 会把 `modelServiceId` 和 `approvalMode` 折进独立会话的创建请求，却漏掉了推理强度选择，因此带模型和强度的创建总是以一次创建后的 setter 结束。只接受初始会话配置的嵌入式宿主会拒绝这次后续更新，首个 prompt 于是从未带上用户选择的强度。

改动之后，在懒创建之前选择 **关闭思考**（`none`）或非默认强度，会在 spawn 时直接生效，不会再发出创建后的更新。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

本 PR 只改变创建契约，因此判别性检查是请求形状和确认分支。

1. `packages/web-shell`：`client/utils/sessionPreparation.test.ts` —— 新增用例断言在 attached 与 detached 两条首条 prompt 路径上，`none` 和 `low` 的 `reasoningEffort` 都随创建请求发出；未选择时不发送 `reasoningEffort`；没有携带模型的创建保留创建后 setter；创建未确认强度时释放会话。
2. `packages/web-shell`：`client/daemon/session/actions.test.ts` —— 新增用例断言强度在 attached 与 detached 两个分支都传给了 `createDetachedStandaloneSession`；回显值不同或没有回显时拒绝；非独立会话的创建拒绝 `reasoningEffort`。
3. `packages/sdk-typescript`：`test/unit/DaemonClientStandalone.test.ts` —— 带新字段 `reasoningEffortApplied` 的创建请求/响应解析仍然通过。

修复前的红色运行显示创建请求里没有 `reasoningEffort`；同一用例在修复后通过。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A —— 本次改动是请求/响应契约加上消费它的客户端分支，没有可见的布局变化。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

使用各包的 `vitest` 配置跑单元测试；对 `packages/web-shell` 和 `packages/sdk-typescript` 运行 `tsc --noEmit`，并对改动文件运行 `eslint` 与 `prettier --check`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：确认依赖守护进程回显 `reasoningEffortApplied`。早于该字段的守护进程会丢弃它，此时同时带模型和强度的创建会直接失败，而不是静默继续；此前行为是执行一次只接受初始配置的宿主本来就会拒绝的创建后 setter。没有携带模型的创建保持原有 setter 路径不变。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：没有对真实拒绝创建后更新的嵌入式宿主做端到端运行，证据是请求形状与确认分支。Windows 与 Linux 未在本地验证。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对现有调用方没有破坏性变更。`reasoningEffort` 是可选字段，对忽略它的守护进程除上述失败路径外没有影响，无模型的创建保留现有 setter。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): restore custom inline tags in composer drafts
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Desktop Web Shell drafts preserve the positions of inline chips supplied by an embedding host. On reload or session switch, the host's existing message parser restores the chips. If a draft predates saved positions, Web Shell recovers source-preserving references outside existing file chips.

## Why it's needed

Refreshing with an unsent custom inline chip currently shows its full serialized reference in the composer. This makes drafts harder to read and removes the chip's removal control.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In an embedded Web Shell with a message parser, insert two custom chips in a draft and type a literal copy of one reference elsewhere. Reload. Expect the two inserted chips to return in place and the literal copy to remain editable.
2. Remove one chip and reload again. Expect the remaining chip and surrounding text to persist. On submit, expect the remaining chip's reference annotation at its original offset in the submitted text.
3. Open an older draft containing recognized serialized references. Expect them to become chips when the parser preserves the complete source. An existing file chip keeps its position and a parser that changes the source leaves the draft editable.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Draft scenario | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Two chips and one matching literal, then reload | 0 chips, 3 serialized references | 2 chips, 1 literal reference |
| Legacy text draft with two recognizable references | 0 chips | 2 chips |
| Remove one chip and reload again | Removal control absent after reload | 1 chip, 1 literal reference, 1 reference annotation on submit |

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Chromium reload and submission exercised |
| Windows | Pending CI |
| Linux | Pending CI |

## Risk & Scope

- Desktop inline restoration depends on the embedding host's parser recognizing the serialized reference and preserving the draft text. The touch textarea retains its existing behavior.
- The existing draft format accepts the optional positions field. Chip metadata is reconstructed from text at restore time.
- [English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c09be4229277c6cf9f0353b1e1773c0a10e20dd7/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-composer-draft-tags.md) · [中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c09be4229277c6cf9f0353b1e1773c0a10e20dd7/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-composer-draft-tags.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动内容

桌面端 Web Shell 草稿保存宿主提供的内联标签的位置。刷新或切换会话时，复用宿主的现有消息解析器还原标签。对没有保存位置的旧草稿，Web Shell 在已有文件标签的区间之外恢复能逐字还原原文的引用。

## 为什么需要这项改动

如果草稿中有尚未发送的自定义内联标签，刷新后输入框会显示完整的序列化引用。这样草稿更难阅读，也失去了标签的删除控件。

## 审核验收计划

### 如何验证

1. 在提供消息解析器的嵌入式 Web Shell 中，在草稿里插入两个自定义标签，并在其他位置手动输入一处相同的引用。刷新后，两个已插入的标签应在原位恢复，手输文本应仍可编辑。
2. 删除一个标签并再次刷新。剩余标签和前后正文应保留。提交时，剩余标签的引用标注应对应它在提交正文中的原位置。
3. 打开包含可识别引用的旧草稿。解析器能逐字保留原文时，引用应恢复成标签。已有的文件标签应保持位置，解析器改变原文时草稿应保持可编辑。

### 修复前后证据

| 草稿场景 | 修复前 | 修复后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 两个标签和一处同文文本，再刷新 | 0 个标签，3 处序列化引用 | 2 个标签，1 处纯文本引用 |
| 包含两个可识别引用的旧草稿 | 0 个标签 | 2 个标签 |
| 删除一个标签后再次刷新 | 刷新后无标签删除控件 | 1 个标签，1 处纯文本引用，提交时带 1 条引用标注 |

### 测试环境

| 系统 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | 已在 Chromium 验证刷新和提交 |
| Windows | 等待 CI |
| Linux | 等待 CI |

## 风险和范围

- 桌面端内联标签的恢复依赖宿主解析器识别序列化引用并逐字保留草稿。触屏文本框沿用现有行为。
- 现有草稿格式接受可选的位置字段。标签元数据在恢复时根据正文重新生成。
- [English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c09be4229277c6cf9f0353b1e1773c0a10e20dd7/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-composer-draft-tags.md) · [中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c09be4229277c6cf9f0353b1e1773c0a10e20dd7/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-composer-draft-tags.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(desktop): guide Rosetta 2 users to the Apple Silicon build
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When the Intel (x64) desktop build fails to start under Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon, the bootstrap screen now detects the translated process (via `sysctl.proc_translated`, macOS x86_64 only) and replaces the generic failure message with a clear architecture-mismatch explanation plus a primary "Download Apple Silicon version" button that opens the `desktop-latest` release page. The meaningless "Choose another workspace" and "Retry" actions are hidden in this state. Independently of Rosetta, the error box is now height-capped and scrollable so a long crash stack can no longer push all action buttons out of the window.

## Why it's needed

Users on M-series Macs sometimes install the Intel build by mistake. Under Rosetta 2 the bundled Node runtime aborts immediately (V8 `Check failed: 12 == (*__error()).` in `SetPermissions` on executable memory, because the hardened-runtime entitlements only allow `MAP_JIT`), and the bootstrap screen showed only "Qwen Code could not start" plus a raw crash stack that overflowed the window and hid every button — a dead end with no path forward. This change turns it into a one-click route to the correct native build. Detection is failure-time only, not a pre-launch block, because the macOS x64 release build and its packaged smoke test themselves run under Rosetta 2 on `macos-15` runners.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. On Apple Silicon, build the desktop app for `x86_64-apple-darwin` and launch it under Rosetta 2 with a runtime that fails to start. Expected: title "Intel version installed on Apple Silicon", a scrollable error box, and "Download Apple Silicon version" + "Open logs" buttons; "Choose another workspace" and "Retry" hidden. Clicking download opens the `desktop-latest` release page in the browser.
2. Any non-Rosetta failure (e.g. native arm64 with a broken runtime): the generic "Qwen Code could not start" screen is unchanged, with Choose/Retry visible.
3. Automated: `node packages/desktop/scripts/test-release.js` covers both event orderings (`runtime-failed` arriving before vs. after the `bootstrap_state` snapshot), the non-Rosetta path, button visibility/click, the capability allow-list, and the error-box overflow guard. `cargo test --manifest-path packages/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml` passes on both `aarch64-apple-darwin` and `x86_64-apple-darwin` (the latter executed under Rosetta 2), 43/43 each.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: generic "Qwen Code could not start" with the raw V8 crash stack overflowing the window and pushing all buttons off-screen. After: architecture-mismatch message, scrollable 180px error box, download + logs buttons visible and clickable. Verified visually on a local x86_64 build running under Rosetta 2 with a failing runtime; regression assertions added in `packages/desktop/scripts/test-release.js`.

| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ (arm64 native + x86_64 under Rosetta 2) |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested (Rust detection is macOS-gated; bootstrap JS/HTML changes are platform-neutral) |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested (same gating as Windows) |

### Environment (optional)

`cargo test` on both Apple targets, `node packages/desktop/scripts/test-release.js`, and a local `x86_64-apple-darwin` desktop build launched under Rosetta 2.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the download button opens the release page rather than a direct arm64 asset link, so the user still picks the arm64 dmg from the page; chosen to keep the URL stable across releases.
- Not validated / out of scope: `NodeEntitlements.plist` is intentionally unchanged — a real Intel Mac hitting the same V8 CHECK crash still fails with the generic error; widening entitlements (`allow-unsigned-executable-memory`) needs validation on genuine Intel hardware and is left as follow-up.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new Tauri command `open_download_page` is restricted to the bootstrap origin and allow-listed only in the bootstrap capability; the remote Web Shell cannot invoke it.

None.

prs.title: perf(release): shallow-checkout prepare job and fetch version tags without trees
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Switches the release preparation job's repository checkout from a full history clone to a shallow single-commit clone, fetches only version tag references without trees or blobs (with retries) right before resolving the release version when running in a shallow repository, and updates the release workflow tests with a real Git fixture verifying that version tags are populated before version resolution.

## Why it's needed

Because persistent self-hosted release runners wipe the workspace before checkout, the preparation job previously cloned the entire Git history and all historical blobs from scratch on every release run just so the version resolver could list existing version tags. On Hangzhou self-hosted runners behind a local HTTP proxy, that full history clone takes 5–12+ minutes before any validation job can start (as observed in release run 45659392117), even though the preparation job only inspects the checked-out commit and version tag names. Fetching a single commit and pulling only version tag refs without trees or blobs transfers ~500 KB in a few seconds while keeping local tag listing working identically, including when releasing older commits.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Confirm that the release preparation job uses a shallow checkout while the publishing and release-build jobs retain full history.
- Confirm that when version resolution runs in a shallow checkout with no local tags, it fetches the version tag references from origin (with retries on transient failures) so version conflict checks and previous-release tag lookup see all existing version tags.
- Confirm that non-Git and full-clone environments remain unaffected and that release workflow contract tests, shell linting, YAML linting, and workflow size checks pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: In release run 45659392117 on a Hangzhou self-hosted runner, job setup and workspace cleanup completed in 13 seconds total, while the full-history checkout step ran for over 12 minutes; fetching all 704 version tags with a treeless shallow fetch against the repository completed in 3 seconds (~508 KB).
- After: Local verification passed for shell linting, YAML linting, workflow size checks, Prettier formatting, and the release workflow tests including the new real-Git shallow-checkout tag-fetch test (4 passed).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: The version-resolution step now performs an explicit treeless tag fetch against origin when running inside a shallow repository; a transient network error during that fetch is retried up to three times and fails closed if all attempts fail rather than silently resolving against an empty tag list.
- Not validated / out of scope: A live end-to-end release run using this branch has not been executed yet; this PR is opened as a draft while the current release finishes.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Observed in release run https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/45659392117.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次 PR 改动

将发布准备任务的仓库检出从全量历史克隆改为单提交浅克隆，在浅仓库环境下解析发布版本前按需执行不拉树对象和文件内容的版本 tag 拉取（带重试），并在发布 workflow 测试中补充真实 Git 仓库用例以验证浅克隆下版本解析前能正确拿到全部版本 tag。

## 改动原因

由于持久化自建发布 runner 在检出前会清空工作区，准备任务此前每次发布都要从零拉取整个仓库的完整 Git 历史和全部历史对象，而实际目的仅仅是让版本解析步骤列出已有的版本 tag。在走本地 HTTP 代理的杭州自建 runner 上，全量历史克隆每次耗时 5–12 分钟以上（如发布运行 45659392117 所示），直接阻塞下游所有验证任务启动，尽管准备任务本身只读取当前检出提交和版本 tag 名。改为单提交浅克隆并在版本解析前以无树/无文件内容方式拉取版本 tag 后，拉取全部 tag 仅需约 500 KB 和几秒钟，同时对旧发布提交的版本解析逻辑保持完全兼容。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证方式

- 确认发布准备任务使用浅克隆，而发布和构建发布产物任务仍保留全量历史。
- 确认在没有本地 tag 的浅克隆仓库中执行版本解析时，会从远端拉取版本 tag（遇到瞬时网络错误自动重试），使版本冲突检查和上一版本 tag 查找能看到全部已有版本 tag。
- 确认非 Git 目录和完整克隆环境不受影响，且发布 workflow 契约测试、shell 检查、YAML 检查和 workflow 体积检查全部通过。

### 验证证据（改动前后）

- 改动前：在发布运行 45659392117 的杭州自建 runner 上，任务准备和工作区清理合计仅耗时 13 秒，而全量历史检出耗时长达 12 分钟以上；对仓库实测无树浅拉取全部 704 个版本 tag 仅耗时 3 秒（约 508 KB）。
- 改动后：本地已通过 shell 检查、YAML 检查、workflow 体积检查、Prettier 格式检查，以及包含新增真实 Git 浅克隆拉 tag 用例在内的发布 workflow 测试（4 项通过）。

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 运行环境（可选）

N/A

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：版本解析步骤在浅仓库中会额外向远端执行一次无树 tag 拉取；遇到瞬时网络故障最多重试 3 次，全部失败时显式报错退出，避免在空 tag 列表下静默算出错误版本。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：尚未用该分支跑真实端到端发布验证，当前以草稿 PR 形式提交，待本次发布完成后推进。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

问题出现在发布运行 https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/45659392117。

Russian CLI counts read incorrectly for values like 2 and 21, and a single extension capability always used the plural. The two tool labels could collapse into one in a tool group. The translated settings descriptions omitted details already present in the English schema.

prs.title: fix(serve): recover detached background-shell liveness for persisted sessions (#17819)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a session is not owned by the connected daemon (for example after a daemon restart), the web shell previously had no way to know whether that session's detached background shells were still running: the live in-memory registry signal only exists for sessions this daemon owns, so a persisted-only session whose shell claimed to be running looked completely silent — and could be deleted while its work was still in progress. This is the data-loss scenario reported in #17819.

This PR recovers that signal end to end. The background-shell registry now records process identity — process start ticks and pid namespace where the platform provides them — into the on-disk status sidecars it already writes (a small additive change inside core). A new probe layer reads those sidecars for persisted-only sessions when a list is served, and settles every claimed-running shell into one of three verdicts: verified running (identity tokens match a live process), unverifiable (kept unknown — shown as a hint, never blocked silently), or provably dead (a shell that cannot possibly be alive contributes no signal). Probing is skipped entirely for live sessions, whose in-memory state remains authoritative, and is bounded by a per-refresh budget plus a TTL cache so a large catalog cannot turn one list request into a scan storm. The session list attaches the resulting verdict to summaries (additive optional wire field), and the web shell uses it: rows with a verified-running shell show the existing running-work indicator and cannot be deleted, unverifiable rows show a hollow hint cue plus an advisory line in the delete confirmation, and the delete confirmation re-checks its guard against the freshest data the catalog already holds instead of the snapshot captured when the dialog opened. Both design documents are added/updated in English and Chinese.

## Why it's needed

After a daemon restart, all sessions become persisted-only, and the sidebar's background-work indicator disappears for all of them — even for sessions that still have detached background shells running. A user reviewing their history sees a quiet, deletable session and can wipe a still-running task's outputs. Issue #17819 documents the reproduction; the fix reuses the sidebar's existing background-work indicator and delete gating, extending both to the persisted-only case instead of inventing a new affordance.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Use Linux for the verified-running checks below. The process identity check relies on procfs. A detached shell can also survive its Agent process on macOS. The daemon reports `unknown` while that PID is present because macOS sidecars lack identity tokens. Once a local check returns `ESRCH`, the next refresh clears the hint.

1. Start the daemon and open the web shell; run a session that launches a long background shell (e.g. a slow build).
2. Kill only the session's agent bridge process (not the daemon), so the session goes offline while the shell keeps running.
3. Refresh the sidebar: the session should show the running-work indicator and its delete action should be blocked, with an explanation in the delete confirmation.
4. Kill the shell process too, wait past the probe refresh, and confirm the session becomes deletable again.
5. On Linux, also verify the identity-token path: a freshly written sidecar carries the process identity, and a session whose claimed pid no longer exists is immediately deletable (no stale blocking).

Expected vs observed: before this PR, step 3 showed a silent deletable row; after, the running cue and gate appear while the shell is alive and clear once it is provably gone.

Unit tests cover the probe verdict matrix (verified / unknown / dead, namespace mismatches, boot-id mismatches, pid reuse, malformed files, budget rollover, caching), the list integration (verdicts attached only to persisted-only rows, live rows untouched), the registry write path (identity tokens written for real shells; the end-to-end probe test needs Linux procfs and is skipped elsewhere), and the web shell (indicator, tooltip, delete dialog advisory, confirm-time re-check against the catalog cache, i18n for all four dictionaries).

### Evidence (Before & After)

No TUI screenshots. Linux CI exercises the procfs-dependent process identity test.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | Untested |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

The CLI and Web Shell unit suites and typecheck passed on Windows. In the tested Windows setup, stopping the Agent also stopped its shell. Manual testing on macOS and Linux is pending. The procfs identity test runs in Linux CI.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only (`npm run dev` daemon used during development for manual tracing).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: on platforms without identity tokens, sidecars with a claimed-running shell resolve to unknown — conservative by design, showing a hint without blocking deletion; the probe budget and TTL cache bound the added per-refresh cost, and live sessions are never probed.
- Not validated / out of scope: server-side re-check at delete time (the current guard is enforced in the web shell); a Windows/macOS identity token (process creation time) is a documented follow-up.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — the new summary field is optional and absent on older daemons; clients that do not know it ignore it.

Design documents: [web-shell-detached-background-shell-liveness.md](docs/design/web-shell-detached-background-shell-liveness.md) and [web-shell-detached-background-shell-liveness.zh-CN.md](docs/design/web-shell-detached-background-shell-liveness.zh-CN.md) (new); the sidebar indicator design is updated in both languages.

## Linked Issues

Closes #17819. Refs #17713.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

当会话不被当前 daemon 持有（例如 daemon 重启后），网页侧栏此前无法得知该会话的 detached 后台 shell 是否仍在运行：内存注册表信号只对 daemon 自己持有的会话存在，因此 persisted-only 会话即使 shell 声称仍在运行，看起来也完全安静——用户可能在任务仍在进行时删除它。这正是 #17819 报告的数据丢失场景。

本 PR 端到端恢复该信号。后台 shell 注册表现在会把进程身份——进程启动时间片与（平台支持时的）pid namespace——写入它本来就会落盘的状态侧车文件（core 内的一处小的增量改动）。新的探测层在服务列表时读取 persisted-only 会话的这些侧车文件，把每条「声称运行中」的 shell 归入三种裁决之一：验证存活（身份令牌与活进程吻合）、无法验证（保持 unknown——展示为提示，绝不静默拦截）、可证死亡（不可能存活的 shell 不贡献信号）。live 会话完全跳过探测（内存状态保持权威），探测受单次预算与 TTL 缓存约束，大目录不会把一次列表请求变成扫描风暴。会话列表把裁决附加到摘要上（新增可选 wire 字段），网页端据此行为：验证运行的行显示既有的运行中指示并禁止删除；无法验证的行显示空心提示点，并在删除确认弹窗中显示说明行；删除确认时不再使用打开弹窗时捕获的快照，而是对目录缓存中已有的最新数据复查守卫。设计文档以中英双语新增/更新。

## 为什么需要

daemon 重启后所有会话都变成 persisted-only，侧栏的后台工作指示对它们全部消失——即使会话仍有 detached 后台 shell 在运行。用户浏览历史时看到的是安静、可删除的会话，可能顺手清掉仍在运行任务的产物。#17819 记录了复现路径；本修复复用侧栏既有的后台工作指示与删除门控，把两者扩展到 persisted-only 场景，而不是发明新的交互。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

以下验证「确认仍在运行」的步骤使用 Linux，因为进程身份核验依赖 procfs。macOS 上的分离后台 shell 也可能在 Agent 退出后继续运行。macOS 的状态文件缺少身份令牌，因此该 PID 仍存在时显示「状态未知」。本机探测返回 `ESRCH` 后，下一次刷新会清除提示。

1. 启动 daemon 并打开网页端；运行一个启动长后台 shell（如慢构建）的会话。
2. 只杀该会话的 agent bridge 进程（不动 daemon），让会话离线而 shell 继续运行。
3. 刷新侧栏：该会话应显示运行中指示，删除操作被拦截，删除确认弹窗中有解释。
4. 再杀掉 shell 进程，等探测刷新过后，确认会话恢复可删除。
5. Linux 上另验证身份令牌路径：新写入的侧车文件携带进程身份；声称的 pid 已不存在时，会话立即可删除（无过期拦截）。

前后对比：修复前第 3 步显示安静可删的行；修复后 shell 存活时出现运行指示与门控，可证死亡后清除。

单测覆盖探测裁决矩阵（验证/未知/死亡、namespace 不匹配、boot-id 不匹配、pid 复用、坏文件、预算滚动、缓存）、列表集成（裁决只附加给 persisted-only 行，live 行不动）、注册表写入路径（真实 shell 写入身份令牌；端到端探测测试依赖 Linux procfs，其他平台跳过）与网页端（指示点、tooltip、删除弹窗提示、确认时对目录缓存的复查、四语言词典）。

### 证据（前后对比）

未提供 TUI 截图。Linux CI 会运行依赖 procfs 的进程身份核验测试。

### 测试平台

|    操作系统    | 状态 |
| :------------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS      | 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows     |  ✅  |
|  🐧 Linux      |  ⚠️  |

Windows 上的 CLI 和 Web Shell 单测及类型检查已通过。在本次 Windows 测试配置下，停止 Agent 时 shell 也随之退出。macOS 和 Linux 尚未手动验证，依赖 procfs 的身份核验测试在 Linux CI 上运行。

### 环境（可选）

仅单测（开发期间用 `npm run dev` daemon 做过手工链路追踪）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：在没有身份令牌的平台上，声称运行中的侧车文件解析为 unknown——这是保守设计，展示提示但不拦截删除；探测预算与 TTL 缓存约束了每次刷新的额外成本，live 会话从不探测。
- 未验证 / 范围外：删除时的服务端复查（当前守卫在网页端执行）；Windows/macOS 身份令牌（进程创建时间）为文档化的后续项。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无——新摘要字段可选且在旧 daemon 上缺省；不知道它的客户端自然忽略。

设计文档：[web-shell-detached-background-shell-liveness.md](docs/design/web-shell-detached-background-shell-liveness.md) 与 [web-shell-detached-background-shell-liveness.zh-CN.md](docs/design/web-shell-detached-background-shell-liveness.zh-CN.md)（新增）；侧栏指示器设计文档双语同步更新。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #17819. Refs #17713.

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): add GPT-6 / 6.1 / 6.2 model IDs to getGptReasoningCapabilities
prs.body:
## Summary

Fixes #18200

`getGptReasoningCapabilities()` currently only includes `gpt-6-astra` from the GPT-6 family. This PR adds the remaining released GPT-6 / 6.1 / 6.2 model IDs served by `GET https://api.openai.com/v1/models`, verified directly against `POST https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions`:

| Model | Supported efforts | `thinkingMandatory` |
|---|---|---|
| `gpt-6-luna` | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` | `false` (`none` returns 200) |
| `gpt-6-sol` | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` | `false` (`none` returns 200) |
| `gpt-6.1-terra` | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` | `false` (`none` returns 200) |
| `gpt-6.1-sol` | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` | `true` (`none` returns 400) |
| `gpt-6.2-astra` | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` | `true` (`none` returns 400) |
| `gpt-6.2-sol` | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` | `true` (`none` returns 400) |

All six models reject `reasoning_effort: "max"` with HTTP 400 (`Supported values are: ... and 'xhigh'`), so clamping caps them at `xhigh`.

### Changes
- `packages/core/src/core/reasoning-effort.ts`: add the 6 GPT-6 / 6.1 / 6.2 model IDs to `getGptReasoningCapabilities()`.
- `packages/core/src/core/reasoning-effort.test.ts`: add positive and negative unit tests for the new IDs (including provider prefixes, case normalization, dated snapshots, and `:batch`).
- `packages/core/src/core/openaiContentGenerator/provider/default.test.ts`: verify effort clamping (`max` -> `xhigh`) and flattening for all 6 models.
- `packages/core/src/core/openaiContentGenerator/pipeline.test.ts`: verify `reasoning_effort: "none"` emission for disable-capable models and omission for mandatory-thinking models.
- `docs/users/configuration/model-providers.md`: update the documented built-in mandatory set and GPT-6 clamping note.

## Demo

N/A — internal capability table and provider wire mapping (verified via unit/pipeline tests and live OpenAI Chat Completions API probes).

## Verification
- `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core exec vitest run src/core/reasoning-effort.test.ts src/core/openaiContentGenerator/provider/default.test.ts src/core/openaiContentGenerator/pipeline.test.ts` — 3 files, 566 tests passed
- `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core typecheck` — passed
- `npx eslint` on all touched TS files — passed
- `npx prettier --check` on all touched files — passed

Opened as Draft while #18200 awaits triage feedback. Happy to mark Ready for Review once scope is confirmed.

prs.title: fix(ci): fail closed on authority-surface PRs and ambient credential probes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The precheck that decides whether automated triage and review may run on an outside contribution now judges what a pull request can reach, not only whether its wording matches a known-bad phrase. Three behaviours change. A contribution from someone without write access that modifies the surfaces deciding what CI executes, or what the reviewing agent reads as instructions, is held for maintainer approval instead of being handed to the reviewer. Reads of credentials the runner holds ambiently — cloud instance metadata endpoints, the process environment, well-known credential files — count as a signal on their own, without having to be paired with a named secret reference or a JavaScript logging call. And a diff that had to be truncated to fit the collection cap now fails closed rather than being reported as clean.

The held state is the existing one: a maintainer can still opt in explicitly with a triage or review command. Nothing is auto-closed, and authors with write access are unaffected.

## Why it's needed

Two fork pull requests opened ten minutes apart probed this automation. One modified a script that CI executes after checking out the contribution, adding an environment dump and a walk of the Alibaba Cloud and AWS instance metadata endpoints for role credentials. The other added a documentation page whose text instructed the reviewing agent to run a list of commands with its shell tool and paste their raw output verbatim into a public comment; the list included the process environment and the same metadata endpoints. Neither payload named a GitHub secret, and the precheck admitted both with an empty finding list.

The manual "Approve workflows to run" setting does not cover this path. It gates fork events of one kind, while the triage and review automation runs on the privileged base-branch trigger and started within a second of each pull request being opened; the lane the setting did protect recorded zero jobs. So the human step was guarding the lane that was not attacked, and it still asks a person to recognise a payload phrased as routine read-only diagnostics.

The existing rules could not see either payload for structural reasons: their sinks are JavaScript-only, so a shell `echo` is not a sink; their notion of a secret is a named reference, so an ambient credential source is invisible; their injection rules match known phrases, and both payloads used ordinary operational vocabulary; and they never looked at which paths a contribution changes. A `.github`-only path rule would still miss the second pull request, which changes no CI path at all — the agent's own instruction files are a stronger channel than a documentation page, because project context is loaded from the checked-out contribution.

Separately, a capped diff was reportable as clean. A payload the existing rules do catch flips to admitted once padding pushes it past the two-megabyte cap, because the collection step tolerated the resulting broken-pipe status and only failed closed on an empty diff.

This is defence in depth. It does not remove the payoff: a runner that holds a cloud role still hands out credentials to anything that executes on it, and disposable runners and container isolation do not change that. That hardening is listed as out of scope below.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Replay both probe payloads through the precheck, on this branch and on the base, and compare. This is the decisive check and needs nothing beyond `gh` and `node`.

```bash
for n in 18362 18364; do
  gh pr view "$n" --repo QwenLM/qwen-code --json title,body,headRefOid > "/tmp/pr-$n.json"
  gh pr diff "$n" --repo QwenLM/qwen-code --patch > "/tmp/pr-$n.diff"
done

# This branch.
for n in 18362 18364; do
  node .github/scripts/pr-safety-precheck.mjs \
    --pr "/tmp/pr-$n.json" --diff "/tmp/pr-$n.diff" \
    --trusted-author false --diff-truncated false --output /dev/null
done

# The base, for comparison (it takes no truncation flag). Keep this copy inside
# the checkout: the script only enters main() when its own module URL matches
# argv[1], and on macOS /tmp is a symlink, so a copy placed there exits silently
# with no output at all.
mkdir -p .qwen/tmp
git show origin/main:.github/scripts/pr-safety-precheck.mjs > .qwen/tmp/base-precheck.mjs
for n in 18362 18364; do
  node .qwen/tmp/base-precheck.mjs \
    --pr "/tmp/pr-$n.json" --diff "/tmp/pr-$n.diff" \
    --trusted-author false --output /dev/null
done
```

Expected on the base: `allow_triage` with `"reason_codes": []` for both. Expected on this branch, observed locally:

```
18362  manual_required  ["protected_path:authority_surface","ambient_credential:cloud_metadata","ambient_credential:env_dump"]
18364  manual_required  ["ambient_credential:cloud_metadata","ambient_credential:proc_environ"]
```

Note that the second payload is caught without any path finding — that is the case a CI-directory-only rule misses.

Then run the suites:

```bash
node --test .github/scripts/pr-safety-precheck.test.mjs .github/scripts/pr-safety-precheck.workflow.test.mjs # expect 146 pass, 0 fail
node --test .github/scripts/ci/classify-profile.test.mjs     # expect 27 pass, 0 fail
```

Behaviours worth confirming individually, all covered by named cases in the precheck suite:

- A contribution that only deletes a CI guard, only renames a file into a protected directory, or only changes a file mode is still held.
- A path git quotes because it contains a tab or a non-ASCII byte is still held. Before this was handled, adding a file under the CI workflow directory with a tab in its name returned `allow_triage`; that bypass is now closed and pinned.
- An `env VAR=value command` prefix is **not** held — the environment rule targets dumps, not ordinary command prefixes.
- A truncated diff is held even when the visible portion is clean, and a trusted author is never held by any of the new rules.
- The collection step reads one byte past the cap so that a read of exactly the cap is distinguishable from a complete diff of that size. At exactly two megabytes the truncation flag stays false; at one byte more it becomes true.

Three cases in the precheck suite previously asserted that outside changes to CI and script directories are admitted. They were retargeted to the new policy rather than removed. One fixture also lacked a diff header, so it had been passing without exercising path detection at all; it now carries a real header.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible or TUI surface. The before/after comparison is the base-versus-branch replay above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit suites only, plus a stubbed `gh` on `PATH` to drive the collection step's shell across the cap boundary. No model calls and no runner time.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: false positives hold legitimate outside contributions for a maintainer opt-in. In a sample of 80 open pull requests, out of 578 open at the time, 67 had authors without write access and 7 of those touched a protected surface; the sample is not a repo-wide rate. The repository's own network-policy and fetch fixtures contain instance-metadata addresses, so an outside edit to them is held as well. The cost per hit is one maintainer decision, not a rejected contributor — which is why this holds rather than closes.
- Not validated / out of scope: attaching no cloud role to CI runners or hardening the instance metadata service; a default-deny egress allowlist for the reviewing agent; redaction of agent-authored comments before publication. Also unmeasured: whether the diff API can itself return a silently shortened patch for a very large contribution — the witness byte only detects truncation by the collection step, so an upstream short read would arrive under the cap and look complete. One further observation is recorded rather than explained: the review run for the second probe aborted at its first check because its bot token was empty, while an in-repo review in the same minute succeeded; the mechanism was not determined, so an empty secret is not counted as a control.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Existing finding codes are unchanged; three new codes are added. Automated dependency pull requests from outside authors will now need a maintainer opt-in, since dependency manifests are in the protected set — whether they should stay there is an open question in the design.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/pr-precheck-authority-gate/docs/design/pr-safety-precheck-authority-gate.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/pr-precheck-authority-gate/docs/design/pr-safety-precheck-authority-gate.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

References #18362 and #18364 (the two probe pull requests). No closing keyword.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

决定「自动化 triage 与 review 能否在外部贡献上运行」的那道预检，现在依据 PR **能触达什么**来判定，而不只依据其措辞是否命中已知坏词。三项行为变化：无 write 权限的作者若改动了「决定 CI 执行什么」或「评审 agent 把什么当指令读」的那些面，改为扣住等维护者批准，而不是直接交给评审器；对 runner **环境自带**凭据的读取——云实例元数据端点、进程环境、知名凭据文件——本身即算信号，不再必须与具名 secret 引用或 JavaScript 日志调用配对；以及为采集上限而被截断的 diff 现在 fail closed，不再被报成干净。

扣住用的是既有状态：维护者仍可用 triage 或 review 命令显式放行。不自动关闭任何 PR，有 write 权限的作者不受影响。

## 为什么需要

相隔十分钟开启的两个 fork PR 探测了这套自动化。其中一个修改了 CI 在检出贡献**之后**执行的脚本，加入环境导出以及对阿里云与 AWS 实例元数据端点的遍历以取角色凭据。另一个新增了一个文档页，其正文指示评审 agent 用 shell 工具执行一串命令、并把原始输出**逐字**贴进公开评论；清单里包含进程环境与同样的元数据端点。两个载荷都没有点名任何 GitHub secret，而预检对两者都以「零发现」放行。

人工的「Approve workflows to run」设置**不覆盖这条通路**。它作用于某一类 fork 事件，而 triage 与 review 自动化跑在带权限的基线分支触发器上，在每个 PR 开启后一秒内就起跑；被该设置守住的那条车道记录到零个 job。所以那道人工步骤守的是没被攻击的车道，而且它仍然要求人去识别一段措辞为「例行只读诊断」的载荷。

既有规则看不见这两个载荷是结构性的：它们的 sink 只认 JavaScript，所以 shell 的 `echo` 不是 sink；它们的「secret」概念是具名引用，所以环境凭据源不可见；它们的注入规则匹配已知短语，而两个载荷都用普通运维词汇；而且它们从不看贡献改了哪些路径。**只挡 CI 目录**的路径规则仍会漏掉第二个 PR——它根本没改任何 CI 路径；agent 自身的指令文件是比文档页更强的通道，因为项目上下文是从检出的贡献里加载的。

另外，被截断的 diff 原本可以被报成干净。一条现有规则**确实能抓**的载荷，一旦用填充把它推过两兆上限就翻成放行——因为采集步骤容忍了由此产生的 broken-pipe 状态码，且只在 diff 为空时 fail closed。

这属于防御纵深，**并未消除收益**：挂着云角色的 runner 仍会把凭据交给任何在其上执行的代码，一次性 runner 与容器隔离都不改变这一点。该加固列在下面的范围之外。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

把两个探针载荷分别在本分支与基线上重放过预检并对比。这是判定性检查，除 `gh` 与 `node` 外不需要任何东西。

```bash
for n in 18362 18364; do
  gh pr view "$n" --repo QwenLM/qwen-code --json title,body,headRefOid > "/tmp/pr-$n.json"
  gh pr diff "$n" --repo QwenLM/qwen-code --patch > "/tmp/pr-$n.diff"
done

# 本分支。
for n in 18362 18364; do
  node .github/scripts/pr-safety-precheck.mjs \
    --pr "/tmp/pr-$n.json" --diff "/tmp/pr-$n.diff" \
    --trusted-author false --diff-truncated false --output /dev/null
done

# 基线，用于对比（它不接受截断旗标）。这份副本要放在检出目录**之内**：
# 该脚本只有在自身模块 URL 与 argv[1] 相同时才进入 main()，而 macOS 上
# /tmp 是符号链接，放在那里的副本会**静默退出、毫无输出**。
mkdir -p .qwen/tmp
git show origin/main:.github/scripts/pr-safety-precheck.mjs > .qwen/tmp/base-precheck.mjs
for n in 18362 18364; do
  node .qwen/tmp/base-precheck.mjs \
    --pr "/tmp/pr-$n.json" --diff "/tmp/pr-$n.diff" \
    --trusted-author false --output /dev/null
done
```

基线上的预期：两者都是 `allow_triage`、`"reason_codes": []`。本分支上的预期（本地实测）：

```
18362  manual_required  ["protected_path:authority_surface","ambient_credential:cloud_metadata","ambient_credential:env_dump"]
18364  manual_required  ["ambient_credential:cloud_metadata","ambient_credential:proc_environ"]
```

注意第二个载荷是在**没有任何路径发现**的情况下被拦下的——这正是「只挡 CI 目录」的规则会漏掉的情形。

然后跑套件：

```bash
node --test .github/scripts/pr-safety-precheck.test.mjs .github/scripts/pr-safety-precheck.workflow.test.mjs # 预期 146 通过、0 失败
node --test .github/scripts/ci/classify-profile.test.mjs     # 预期 27 通过、0 失败
```

值得逐条确认的行为，预检套件里都有对应命名用例：

- 只**删除**一个 CI 守卫、只把文件**重命名**进受保护目录、或只改文件**权限位**的贡献，仍被扣住。
- 因含 tab 或非 ASCII 字节而被 git 加引号的路径，仍被扣住。在处理这一点之前，以带 tab 的名字在 CI workflow 目录下新增文件会返回 `allow_triage`；该绕过现已关闭并被钉住。
- `env VAR=value command` 前缀**不**被扣住——环境规则针对的是导出，不是普通命令前缀。
- 被截断的 diff 即使可见部分干净也被扣住；可信作者不会被任何新规则扣住。
- 采集步骤多读一个字节，使「恰好等于上限的读取」与「一个正好这么大的完整 diff」可区分。恰好两兆时截断旗标保持 false；多一个字节即变 true。

预检套件里原有三条用例断言「外部作者对 CI 与脚本目录的改动应放行」。它们被**改靶**到新策略而非删除。另有一条夹具原本缺 diff 头，因此一直在**没有真正走到路径检测**的情况下通过；现已带上真实头。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A——无用户可见或 TUI 面。前后对比即上面的基线／分支重放。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 运行环境（可选）

仅单元套件，外加在 `PATH` 上放一个打桩 `gh` 来驱动采集步骤的 shell 跨上限边界。无模型调用、无 runner 占用。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险／取舍：误报会把合法的外部贡献扣住等维护者放行。取样 80 个开放 PR（当时开放总数 578）：67 个作者无 write 权限，其中 7 个触及受保护面；该取样**不是全仓比率**。仓库自己的 network-policy 与 fetch 夹具含实例元数据地址，因此外部对它们的编辑也会被扣住。每次命中的代价是一次维护者决策，而不是拒绝贡献者——这也是选择「扣住」而非「关闭」的原因。
- 未验证／范围之外：给 CI runner 不挂云角色或加固实例元数据服务；给评审 agent 配默认拒绝的出网白名单；agent 撰写评论在发布前脱敏。同样未实测：diff API 自身是否可能对超大贡献返回被静默截短的 patch——见证字节只能检测**采集步骤**的截断，上游短读会以小于上限的体量到达、看起来完整。另有一条只记录不解释的观测：第二个探针的 review run 在第一道检查就因其 bot token 为空而中止，而同一分钟内一个仓内 PR 的 review 成功；机制未查明，因此「secret 为空」不被算作一道控制。
- 破坏性变更／迁移说明：无。既有发现码未改动，新增三个码。来自外部作者的自动化依赖 PR 从此需要维护者显式放行，因为依赖清单在受保护集合内——它们是否应留在那里，是设计文档里的一个未决问题。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/pr-precheck-authority-gate/docs/design/pr-safety-precheck-authority-gate.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/pr-precheck-authority-gate/docs/design/pr-safety-precheck-authority-gate.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

引用 #18362 与 #18364（两个探针 PR）。不使用自动关闭关键字。

</details>

prs.title: feat(core,cli): add ledger-backed session census and daemon session-end usage persistence
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This follow-up to #17902 completes the two remaining session-accounting gaps across the daemon status Usage dashboard and cross-session `/stats`:

- **Ledger-backed distinct-session census:** Summary session counts, daily session bars, cross-session statistics session counts, and period-over-period session deltas now count distinct active session identities across the union of per-request ledger entries and ended non-supplement session records in the window. A conversation resumed multiple times within a window now counts once instead of once per run, and ledger-only days (such as processes killed before exit or historical daemon sessions that never persisted a summary record) report their actual active session count instead of zero.
- **Daemon and ACP session-end usage persistence:** Live per-session telemetry is now tracked separately from replayed or restored transcript history. When a daemon or ACP session is explicitly closed, retired while idle, or torn down during graceful shutdown, its own live delta (tokens, tools, changed lines, skills, duration, project, and request execution identities) is persisted at most once as a run-scoped summary record. Resumed sessions closed with no new live activity write nothing.
- **Localized daily chart subtitle:** The daily sessions chart subtitle in the daemon status Usage view is updated across all locales (`en`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `ru`) from ended runs per day to active sessions per day.

## Why it's needed

After #17902 aligned token, request, latency, and cache-read totals with the per-request ledger, session counts still came solely from persisted summary records. On heavy histories, hundreds of sessions recorded in the per-request ledger were missing from the session tile and daily chart — producing days with positive token consumption but zero sessions — while a single conversation resumed multiple times was overcounted as multiple sessions. At the same time, daemon and Web Shell sessions discarded their in-memory telemetry on close without persisting a summary record, losing durable per-project, tool, changed-line, duration, and skill metadata and forcing repeated transcript replay on dashboard refresh.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. **Deduplicated distinct-session counting:** Run a conversation once and resume the same conversation for a second turn in a separate process so two run-scoped summary records share one session identity. Open the daemon status Usage dashboard (Today and 7D) and `/stats`: the session total and daily session bar for that day should show `1` (while token and request totals sum both runs).
2. **Ledger-only session census:** In an isolated home containing only per-request ledger files (no persisted summary records and no transcripts, simulating killed processes or unpersisted historical daemon sessions), query the daemon Usage dashboard and `/stats`: the session count, daily session bar, and completed-day session delta should reflect the exact distinct session identities present in the ledger rather than `0` or `null`.
3. **Daemon / ACP session-end persistence without replay inflation:** Start an ACP or daemon session, execute one prompt, and close the session cleanly: a single run-scoped summary record should be appended with that run's exact token, project, and execution-identity delta matching the ledger. Then reload (resume) the same session and close it without sending a new prompt: no second summary record should be written.
4. **Localized daily sessions subtitle:** Open the daemon status Usage tab in Web Shell under `en`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, and `ru` and verify the daily sessions subtitle reads `active sessions per day` / `每日活跃会话数` / `每日活躍會話數` / `активные сессии по дням`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Measured against freshly built CLI, daemon, and ACP processes in isolated temporary homes using an ephemeral loopback mock model:

| Scenario | Before | After | Expected / Ledger truth |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Same session resumed once (2 run-scoped records, 4 requests / 600 tokens) | `sessions: 2`, `daily[today].sessions: 2` | `sessions: 1`, `daily[today].sessions: 1` | `1` distinct active session |
| Ledger-only history (summary records and transcripts deleted; 4 requests / 600 tokens) | `sessions: 0`, `daily[today].sessions: 0` | `sessions: 1`, `daily[today].sessions: 1` | `1` distinct active session |
| Real ACP session (`session/new` -> `session/prompt` -> `qwen/control/session/close`) | `0` summary records persisted on close | `1` run-scoped record (`300` tokens, 2 execution IDs, project recorded) | `300` tokens / 2 ledger rows |
| Resumed ACP session closed with zero new activity (`session/load` -> close) | N/A (never persisted) | `0` new records written (total stays `1`, exit code `0`) | `0` replay copies |
| Web Shell daily sessions subtitle (`en` / `zh-CN` / `zh-TW` / `ru`) | `runs ended per day` / `每日结束运行数` / `每日結束執行數` / `завершённые запуски по дням` | `active sessions per day` / `每日活跃会话数` / `每日活躍會話數` / `активные сессии по дням` | Matches active-session semantics |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local full workspace build, full typecheck (including integration tests), bundle build, ESLint, Prettier, focused unit test suites (core 458 passed, CLI 76 passed / 1 skipped plus 2 ACP close-wiring tests, Web Shell 13 passed across all 4 locales), and real-process CLI, daemon, and ACP end-to-end runs in isolated temporary homes.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: switching from run-record counts to distinct active session identities changes the displayed session number for histories where one conversation is resumed multiple times in the same window (now counted once instead of once per run), while increasing counts on histories with unpersisted ledger-only runs. The per-request ledger intentionally remains at schema version 1 without storing workspace paths to preserve the existing path-privacy boundary; per-project, tool, file, and skill metadata for daemon sessions now comes from persisting summary records at session close.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows and Linux native local runs (covered by CI); modifying the per-request ledger schema to store project paths; changing low-level record-only aggregation helpers.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Existing summary records and per-request ledger files require no migration, and the API payload shape is unchanged.

Design document: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/usage-ledger-session-census/docs/design/2026-11-25-usage-ledger-session-census.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/usage-ledger-session-census/docs/design/2026-11-25-usage-ledger-session-census.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17902.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 是 #17902 的直接后续，补齐了 Daemon 状态用量面板与跨会话 `/stats` 遗留的两项会话统计缺口：

- **台账口径唯一活跃会话普查：** 汇总会话数、每日会话柱状图、跨会话统计会话数以及环比会话变化现在统一统计时间窗口内「逐请求台账记录的会话 ∪ 已结束非补充运行记录的会话」的唯一会话数。同一会话在窗口内被多次恢复现在计为 1 次而非按运行次数重复累加；仅存在于台账中的日期（例如退出前被强杀的进程或历史未落盘的 daemon 会话）也会显示真实活跃会话数，不再出现有 token 消耗但会话数为 0 的情况。
- **Daemon 与 ACP 会话结束用量持久化：** 按会话隔离维护实时遥测与运行起始时钟，与重放或恢复的历史记录严格分离。当 daemon 或 ACP 会话显式关闭、空闲回收或随守护进程优雅停机销毁时，只将本会话自身产生的实时增量（token、工具、变更行数、技能、时长、项目及执行 ID）以按运行记录形式至多持久化一次；恢复后无新实时活动直接关闭则零写入。
- **多语种每日会话图副标题更新：** Web Shell 全部语种（`en`、`zh-CN`、`zh-TW`、`ru`）将每日会话图的副标题由「每日结束运行数」同步更新为「每日活跃会话数」。

## 为什么需要

在 #17902 将 token、请求数、平均延迟与缓存读取率对齐逐请求台账后，会话计数仍仅依赖持久化的摘要记录。在重量级历史上，逐请求台账中记录的大量会话在面板与每日图表中缺失，导致出现有 token 消耗却显示 0 会话的日期，同时同一会话多次恢复又会被重复算成多个会话。另一方面，daemon 与 Web Shell 会话在关闭时直接丢弃内存遥测而从未落盘摘要记录，导致关闭后丢失按项目、工具、代码变更、时长与技能明细，并迫使每次刷新重复重放 transcript。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. **唯一活跃会话去重：** 在两个进程中对同一会话运行首次对话与恢复续聊，生成两条共享同一会话 ID 的按运行记录。查看 Daemon 用量面板（今日 / 7 天）与 `/stats`：会话总数与当日每日会话柱应显示 `1`（同时 token 与请求数汇总两次运行）。
2. **纯台账会话普查：** 在仅保留逐请求台账文件（无摘要记录文件、无 transcript，模拟进程被强杀或历史未落盘 daemon 会话）的隔离 home 中查看 Daemon 用量面板与 `/stats`：会话数、每日会话柱以及已完成日环比应准确反映台账中的唯一会话数，而非 `0` 或 `null`。
3. **Daemon / ACP 会话结束落盘且不重放计费：** 启动 ACP 或 daemon 会话，执行一轮对话后正常关闭会话：应恰好追加 1 条按运行摘要记录，其 token、项目与执行 ID 增量与台账精确一致。随后重新加载（恢复）同一会话且不发送新请求直接关闭：不应追加新的重复记录。
4. **多语种副标题核对：** 在 Web Shell 中分别切换 `en`、`zh-CN`、`zh-TW`、`ru` 打开 Daemon 状态用量页，确认每日会话副标题显示为 `active sessions per day` / `每日活跃会话数` / `每日活躍會話數` / `активные сессии по дням`。

### 证据（修前与修后）

基于新鲜构建的 CLI、daemon 与 ACP 进程，在隔离临时 home 中连接一次性本地 mock 模型实测：

| 场景 | 修前 | 修后 | 预期 / 台账真值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 同一会话恢复一次（2 条按运行记录，4 请求 / 600 token） | `sessions: 2`、`daily[today].sessions: 2` | `sessions: 1`、`daily[today].sessions: 1` | `1` 个唯一活跃会话 |
| 纯台账历史（删除摘要记录与 transcript；4 请求 / 600 token） | `sessions: 0`、`daily[today].sessions: 0` | `sessions: 1`、`daily[today].sessions: 1` | `1` 个唯一活跃会话 |
| 真实 ACP 会话（新建 → 提问 → 关闭） | 关闭时持久化 `0` 条摘要记录 | 落盘 `1` 条按运行记录（`300` token、2 个执行 ID、含项目路径） | `300` token / 2 条台账行 |
| 恢复后的 ACP 会话无新活动直接关闭 | N/A（此前从未落盘） | 新增 `0` 条记录（总数保持 `1`，退出码 `0`） | `0` 条重放副本 |
| Web Shell 每日会话副标题（`en` / `zh-CN` / `zh-TW` / `ru`） | `runs ended per day` / `每日结束运行数` / `每日結束執行數` / `завершённые запуски по дням` | `active sessions per day` / `每日活跃会话数` / `每日活躍會話數` / `активные сессии по дням` | 与活跃会话口径一致 |

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

本地全仓构建、全仓类型检查（含集成测试）、bundle 打包、ESLint、Prettier、核心单元测试（core 458 passed、CLI 76 passed / 1 skipped 及 2 条 ACP 关闭接线测试、Web Shell 4 语种 13 passed），以及隔离临时 home 下的真实 CLI、daemon 与 ACP 进程端到端实测。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：将按运行记录计数切换为唯一活跃会话数，会使同一窗口内多次恢复同一会话的历史会话数下降（改为按唯一会话计 1 次），同时使存在未落盘纯台账运行的历史会话数上升。逐请求台账刻意保持 schema 版本 1、不写入工作目录路径以延续既有隐私边界；daemon 会话的按项目、工具、文件与技能明细由会话关闭落盘摘要记录自然补齐。
- 未验证 / 范围外：Windows 与 Linux 本机实测（交由远端 CI 覆盖）；扩展逐请求台账 schema 存储项目路径；改动底层纯记录聚合辅助函数。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。既有摘要记录与逐请求台账无需迁移，接口返回结构保持不变。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/usage-ledger-session-census/docs/design/2026-11-25-usage-ledger-session-census.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/usage-ledger-session-census/docs/design/2026-11-25-usage-ledger-session-census.zh-CN.md)。两版完整同步。

## 关联 Issue

#17902 的后续迭代。

</details>

prs.title: feat: add hybrid code mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Codex-aligned `tools.mode` enum with `direct`, `code_mode`, and `code_mode_only`. `code_mode` keeps ordinary tools directly callable while also exposing the isolated `exec` JavaScript tool; each visible ordinary tool carries its nested JavaScript declaration, while `exec` retains compact `ALL_TOOLS` metadata. `code_mode_only` preserves the strict exec-only ordinary-tool surface, and `direct` remains the default.

Updates filtered subagent tool surfaces so direct declarations and nested exec bindings honor the same allowlists, exposes the enum in Settings as Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only, regenerates the settings JSON schema, and removes the former `tools.codeModeOnly` boolean setting entirely.

Adds synchronized [English](docs/design/code-mode.md) and [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md) design documents, and brings the existing CodeModeOnly design up to the repository's bilingual documentation standard ([English](docs/design/code-mode-only.md), [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code previously offered only the default direct tool surface or the strict CodeModeOnly surface. Models could not combine direct calls for simple operations with `exec` orchestration for multi-tool workflows. A three-value enum matches Codex's `ToolMode` naming and gives users one explicit setting for all supported exposure modes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Leave `tools.mode` unset or set it to `direct`, restart Qwen Code, and confirm ordinary tools remain available while `exec` is absent.
2. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode`, restart, and confirm both ordinary tools and `exec` are available. Confirm ordinary tool descriptions include their `tools.<name>(args)` declaration and deferred tools remain discoverable through `tool_search`.
3. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode_only`, restart, and confirm ordinary tools are available through `exec` rather than as top-level calls, while direct control tools remain available.
4. Open Settings and confirm Tool Mode cycles among Default, Code Mode, and Code Mode Only. Confirm `tools.codeModeOnly` is no longer present in the settings schema.
5. Start with `--safe-mode` or `--bare` while either code mode is configured and confirm the effective mode is `direct`.

Automated verification completed: focused Core tests (121 tests), focused CLI tests (585 tests), a repeated settings-schema regression run (60 tests), full build, full typecheck, full lint, and both installed and branch-built CLI version smoke checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Settings exposed `Code Mode Only (Experimental)` as a boolean with `false` / `true`.

After: Settings exposes `Tool Mode (Experimental)` as an enum displaying Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only. Updated TUI snapshots cover the default display.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js v24.18.0; local source build and package-level Vitest suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Hybrid mode adds a short nested-call declaration to each ordinary tool description, increasing prompt size slightly; complete schemas are not duplicated in the `exec` description.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live-provider interactive runs and Windows/Linux local execution were not tested; CI covers supported platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `tools.codeModeOnly` is removed. Replace `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` with `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`.

## Linked Issues

Related to #10377.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增与 Codex 对齐的 `tools.mode` 枚举，支持 `direct`、`code_mode` 和 `code_mode_only`。`code_mode` 在保留普通工具直接调用能力的同时提供隔离的 `exec` JavaScript 工具；每个可见普通工具会携带自己的嵌套 JavaScript 声明，而 `exec` 保留精简的 `ALL_TOOLS` 元数据。`code_mode_only` 保持严格的普通工具仅经 `exec` 调用模式，`direct` 仍为默认值。

更新经过过滤的子智能体工具面，使直接声明和 `exec` 嵌套 binding 遵守同一组 allowlist；在设置界面中将该枚举显示为 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only；重新生成 settings JSON schema；并彻底移除原来的 `tools.codeModeOnly` 布尔设置。

新增同步的[英文](docs/design/code-mode.md)和[中文](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md)设计文档，并将现有 CodeModeOnly 设计补齐为仓库要求的双语文档（[英文](docs/design/code-mode-only.md)、[中文](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 此前只提供默认的直接工具面或严格的 CodeModeOnly 工具面。模型无法在简单操作中使用直接调用，同时在多工具工作流中使用 `exec` 编排。三值枚举与 Codex 的 `ToolMode` 命名一致，并为所有支持的暴露模式提供一个明确的统一设置项。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 不设置 `tools.mode` 或将其设为 `direct`，重启 Qwen Code，确认普通工具仍可用且不存在 `exec`。
2. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode` 并重启，确认普通工具和 `exec` 同时可用；确认普通工具描述包含各自的 `tools.<name>(args)` 声明，延迟工具仍可通过 `tool_search` 发现。
3. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode_only` 并重启，确认普通工具通过 `exec` 而不是顶层调用使用，同时直接控制工具仍然可用。
4. 打开设置界面，确认 Tool Mode 可在 Default、Code Mode 和 Code Mode Only 之间切换，并确认 settings schema 中不再存在 `tools.codeModeOnly`。

prs.title: fix(core): preserve flat OpenAI-compatible error bodies
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Preserves flat JSON error bodies on the default OpenAI-compatible HTTP path. When a non-2xx response has `object: "error"` and a string `message` but no standard `error` envelope, the provider now wraps the complete object in that envelope before the OpenAI SDK parses it. Successful responses, existing OpenAI error envelopes, and non-JSON responses continue unchanged.

The regression test drives the real provider, OpenAI SDK, and pipeline against a local HTTP server. It covers SGLang's flat 400 body in both streaming and non-streaming calls, checks that the original `object`, `message`, and `code` survive on the thrown error, verifies the permanent client-error classification instead of the bodyless retry path, and includes an existing-envelope control.

## Why it's needed

Current SGLang returns context overflow as a flat HTTP 400 JSON body. The pinned OpenAI SDK only decodes the standard envelope, so the provider text becomes `400 status code (no body)`. This loses the message needed by downstream error handling and also makes the error look like a retryable empty-body 4xx.

This PR addresses the transport half of #18135. Recognition of SGLang's new overflow wording is implemented separately in #14099. This PR does not claim that reactive compaction is fully enabled by this change alone, and it does not include or take credit for #14099.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `packages/core/src/core/openaiContentGenerator/flat-error-response.test.ts` against a local fake server. Before this change, the streaming and non-streaming flat-body cases both fail with `error: undefined`; the existing-envelope control passes. After this change, all three tests pass and each flat request is made once with SDK retries disabled.

The same run also covers `http413-payload.test.ts`, `provider/default.test.ts`, `errorHandler.test.ts`, `retryErrorClassification.test.ts`, and `contextLengthError.test.ts`. The complete set has 244 passing tests. The full repository build and TypeScript checks also pass on the merged head `2c014127023`.

As a dependency check, adding the overflow-detection assertions first leaves both flat cases red with `isExceeded: false`. Temporarily applying only #14099's `contextLengthError.ts` then makes all three tests pass, including both token counts and `limitKind: 'total'`. Those temporary files were restored and are not part of this PR.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: no user-interface change. The observable evidence is the real local HTTP error object and the test results above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

✅ tested · ⚠️ not tested · N/A

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 26.5.0, pnpm 12.21.0, local HTTP server only. No live SGLang server, model, credential, or external network service was used.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: normalization is deliberately limited to non-2xx JSON responses with `object: "error"`, a string `message`, and no existing `error` key. Other error bodies keep their original response path.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live SGLang server and no full `npm run preflight`. Full build, full typecheck, and the six focused test files were run instead. #14099 remains the separate owner of the new wording patterns.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #18135

Related: #14099
