prs.title: fix(core): replay the persisted startup prelude on resume
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A resumed session now replays the exact startup prelude it originally sent instead of rebuilding it from the current date, directory tree, git snapshot, MCP instructions, skills, and deferred-tool list. The prelude is persisted as a system record when a session starts or rebuilds it, recovery keeps the latest record and places it as the first API-history entry, and a session that already has the saved prelude no longer builds a second one.

This keeps the first user message byte-identical across resume, so an implicit prefix cache can reuse the conversation history instead of stopping at the system prompt.

## Why it's needed

When a session is resumed, the client rebuilds the startup prelude in front of the saved turns. The rebuilt prelude contains fresh workspace data, so the first user message differs from the one the previous process sent. With vLLM-style implicit prefix caching, the reusable prefix ends at that first difference.

A reported 417k-token conversation reused only about 14k tokens of KV cache and recomputed about 186k tokens, producing a 126-second time to first token. The stored transcript's first user record is the real prompt; it has no startup prelude, so a resumed process had nothing to replay.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused regression tests; all should pass on the branch:

```bash
cd packages/core
npx vitest run src/core/environmentContext.test.ts -t "reuses a stored startup prelude"
npx vitest run src/services/session-api-history.test.ts -t "startup context replay"
npx vitest run src/core/client.test.ts -t "records a generated startup prelude"
```

To see the regression, temporarily remove the saved-prelude reuse and the startup-context recovery branch (or stash the implementation) and rerun the same tests. Before the fix, the first test rebuilds a fresh prelude in front of the saved turns and the second drops the saved prelude entirely; both fail.

For a real session, start a new conversation with the branch and `--openai-logging`, complete a few turns, exit, and resume. The first request's `messages[0]` should be identical to the pre-resume request's first message, and the provider's cached-token count should include the conversation history rather than only the system prompt.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — this is a core session-recovery change with unit-level evidence.

Before the fix, the two focused tests failed:

```
environmentContext: reuses a stored startup prelude -> 1 failed
session-api-history: startup context replay -> 1 failed
```

After the fix, they pass. Full local runs:

```
client.test.ts                      624 passed
environmentContext.test.ts          116 passed
session-api-history.test.ts          63 passed
chatRecordingService.test.ts        191 passed
session-transcript-reader.test.ts   152 passed
transcript-records validation        48 passed
ACP targeted test                     1 passed
```

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| Linux | ✅ tested (Node 26.8.1, packages/core vitest) |

### Environment

Local Node 26.8.1 with `npx vitest` from `packages/core`; core `tsc --noEmit`, Prettier, and ESLint pass. The full CLI build and a live vLLM prefix-cache run were not executed in this environment.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the saved prelude keeps the original date and git/MCP/skills snapshot. Date freshness still comes from the existing history-derived tail reminder. The git snapshot is intentionally frozen at session start; the model can run `git status` for current state.
- Not validated / out of scope: full CLI build and live vLLM E2E; divergence caused by changes in the system prompt or tool declarations is a separate part of the broader context-immutability issue. Managed-session journals that cannot carry the new record fall back to rebuilding the prelude.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: sessions recorded before this change have no saved prelude. Their first resume rebuilds once and records the new prelude; later resumes can reuse it. No configuration or migration is required.

## Linked Issues

Part of #14215. Related: #8277, #14246, #16362.

## Design docs

- [English design](https://github.com/MikeWang0316tw/qwen-code/blob/fix/resume-startup-prelude-cache/docs/design/2026-11-06-resume-startup-prelude-cache.md)
- [Chinese design](https://github.com/MikeWang0316tw/qwen-code/blob/fix/resume-startup-prelude-cache/docs/design/2026-11-06-resume-startup-prelude-cache.zh-CN.md)

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做什么

resume 后的 session 现在会重播它当初送出的同一份 startup prelude，而不是用当下的日期、目录树、git snapshot、MCP instructions、skills 与 deferred-tool 清单重新建一份。session 开始或重建 prelude 时会把它写成 system record；还原时保留最新的一笔，放到 API history 的第一个 entry；已经有存档 prelude 的 session 不会再建第二份。

这让 resume 后的第一个 user message 与原本 request 完全一致，implicit prefix cache 才能重用整段对话历史，而不是只重用到 system prompt。

## 为什么需要

session resume 时，client 会在存档 turns 前面重建 startup prelude。重建的 prelude 带有最新的 workspace 信息，所以第一个 user message 与前一个 process 送出的不同。对 vLLM 这类 implicit prefix cache，可重用前缀就停在第一个差异。

实际回报的 417k-token 对话只重用了约 14k tokens 的 KV cache，其余约 186k tokens 重算，TTFT 126 秒。存下来的 transcript 第一笔 user record 是真正的 prompt，没有 startup prelude，所以 resume 的 process 无从重播。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

跑三个 focused regression tests；在 branch 上都应通过：

```bash
cd packages/core
npx vitest run src/core/environmentContext.test.ts -t "reuses a stored startup prelude"
npx vitest run src/services/session-api-history.test.ts -t "startup context replay"
npx vitest run src/core/client.test.ts -t "records a generated startup prelude"
```

要重现 regression，暂时移除「重用存档 prelude」与「startup-context recovery」的逻辑（或 stash 实现）后重跑同一组测试。修正前，第一个测试会在存档 turns 前重建一份新 prelude，第二个测试会完全丢掉存档 prelude；两者都失败。

用真实 session 验证时，用这个 branch 开一个新对话并加上 `--openai-logging`，完成几轮后离开再 resume。第一个 request 的 `messages[0]` 应与 resume 前的第一个 message 完全相同，provider 的 cached-token 数量应包含对话历史，而不是只有 system prompt。

### 证据（修正前后）

N/A — 这是 core session-recovery 变更，以 unit-level 证据为主。

修正前，两个 focused tests 失败：

```
environmentContext: reuses a stored startup prelude -> 1 failed
session-api-history: startup context replay -> 1 failed
```

修正后通过。完整本地测试：

```
client.test.ts                      624 passed
environmentContext.test.ts          116 passed
session-api-history.test.ts          63 passed
chatRecordingService.test.ts        191 passed
session-transcript-reader.test.ts   152 passed
transcript-records validation        48 passed
ACP targeted test                     1 passed
```

### 测试环境

| OS | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| Linux | ✅ 已测试（Node 26.8.1，packages/core vitest） |

### 环境

本地 Node 26.8.1，从 `packages/core` 跑 `npx vitest`；core 的 `tsc --noEmit`、Prettier、ESLint 都通过。此环境没有跑完整 CLI build 与 live vLLM prefix-cache 测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险／取舍：存下来的 prelude 会保留原始的日期与 git/MCP/skills 快照。日期新鲜度仍由既有的 history-derived tail reminder 负责；git snapshot 刻意冻结在 session 开始时，模型可自行跑 `git status` 取得目前状态。
- 尚未验证／超出范围：完整 CLI build 与 live vLLM E2E；若 divergence 来自 system prompt 或 tool declarations，属于更大的 context-immutability 问题，不在这个 PR。Managed session 的 journal 若无法携带新 record，会退回重建 prelude。
- Breaking changes／migration：在此变更之前建立的 session 没有存档 prelude。它们第一次 resume 会重建一次并记录新的 prelude，之后的 resume 才可重用。不需要设置或 migration。

## 关联 Issue

Part of #14215。Related: #8277、#14246、#16362。

## 设计文件

- [English design](https://github.com/MikeWang0316tw/qwen-code/blob/fix/resume-startup-prelude-cache/docs/design/2026-11-06-resume-startup-prelude-cache.md)
- [Chinese design](https://github.com/MikeWang0316tw/qwen-code/blob/fix/resume-startup-prelude-cache/docs/design/2026-11-06-resume-startup-prelude-cache.zh-CN.md)

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): point at the JSON error when a tool arg arrives as broken text
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a tool argument that must be an array or object arrives as a string whose text starts like JSON but does not parse, the validation error sent back to the model now explains it: it adds the JSON parse error, the text around the failing position with the exact spot marked `<<HERE>>`, and asks for the value as a JSON array/object instead of a string. All other validation errors are unchanged.

Before: `params/docs must be array`

After: `params/docs must be array; params/docs arrived as a string whose text is not valid JSON (Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 2215 (line 1 column 2216)). Text near the error, with <<HERE>> at that position: "…可辨读\"}]}<<HERE>>]}}, \"issues\": [{\"co". Fix the text there and send it as a JSON array, not as a string`

## Why it's needed

A structured-output run on DashScope qwen3.8-max failed after 15 turns: the model called `structured_output` eight times and every call was rejected with `params/docs must be array`. Bailian's server logs confirmed the chain: the model generated a `docs` array with an unbalanced bracket around character 2216 of a 2300-character value; with `tool_stream` off, DashScope buffers array/object arguments and, when the buffered value is not valid JSON, sends it on as a string; qwen-code's existing stringified-JSON coercion cannot parse it, so validation fails with a type error. That message does not say the text is malformed, so the model guessed at newlines and escaping and resent the same broken text each time.

Replaying the first failed call against qwen3.8-max (10 runs per message), the next call produced a complete valid document 1/10 times with the current message and 5/10 with the new one. Giving only the nearby text without the marker reached 3/10, which is why the exact spot is marked.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Point the CLI at an OpenAI-compatible mock whose first `structured_output` call passes an array-typed field as a string with one `]` too many, then inspect the tool result in the next request. Expected: the message names the field path, the parse error and position, shows the nearby text with `<<HERE>>`, and asks for a JSON array. A string that does not start with `[` or `{`, or one that is valid JSON, keeps today's message. Nested paths are reported once even when the field sits under `anyOf`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Mock-server E2E (headless, `--json-schema`), tool result in turn 2:
- Before (0.27.4): `params/docs must be array`
- After: `params/docs must be array; params/docs arrived as a string whose text is not valid JSON (Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 74 (line 1 column 75)). Text near the error, with <<HERE>> at that position: "[{\"pages\": [1], \"category_id\": \"tpl_a\", \"fields\": {\"a\": {\"raw_value\": \"x\"}<<HERE>>]}, \"issues\": []}]". Fix the text there and send it as a JSON array, not as a string`

Unit tests: schema validator, synthetic output tool and base tool suites pass (141 tests); core type-check clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Built CLI (`npm run build`) against a local mock server; real-model replays against DashScope Standard (Beijing) qwen3.8-max.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the extra text is appended only to type errors whose value is a JSON-looking string that fails to parse, so other tools and errors see no change. The message quotes up to 100 characters of the model's own argument back to it.
- Not validated / out of scope: the provider-side behavior (turning a broken array into a string) is not changed here; the model still has to resend the value. Parse-error wording comes from the runtime's JSON parser; when it has no position, the marker is omitted.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Related to #18242 and #18256 (other DashScope tool-argument failures seen in the same structured-output workload).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当一个要求是数组或对象的工具参数以字符串形式到达，并且这个字符串以 JSON 的样子开头却解析失败时，回给模型的校验错误现在会说明原因：附上 JSON 解析错误、出错位置附近的原文（并用 `<<HERE>>` 标出确切位置），并要求以 JSON 数组/对象而不是字符串发送这个值。其他校验错误保持不变。

改动前：`params/docs must be array`

改动后：`params/docs must be array; params/docs arrived as a string whose text is not valid JSON (Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 2215 (line 1 column 2216)). Text near the error, with <<HERE>> at that position: "…可辨读\"}]}<<HERE>>]}}, \"issues\": [{\"co". Fix the text there and send it as a JSON array, not as a string`

## 为什么需要

一次在 DashScope qwen3.8-max 上的结构化输出运行在 15 轮后失败：模型调用了 8 次 `structured_output`，每次都被 `params/docs must be array` 拒绝。百炼服务端日志确认了因果链：模型生成的 `docs` 数组在 2300 字符长的值中约第 2216 个字符处括号不配对；`tool_stream` 关闭时，DashScope 会缓冲数组/对象参数，缓冲的值不是合法 JSON 时，就把它作为字符串下发；qwen-code 现有的字符串化 JSON 修正无法解析它，于是校验报类型错误。这条信息没有说明文本本身是坏的，模型只能去猜换行和转义的问题，每次都重发同样的坏文本。

把第一次失败的调用对 qwen3.8-max 回放（每种信息 10 次），下一次调用产出完整合法文档的次数：现有信息 1/10，新信息 5/10。只给附近原文、不加标记时为 3/10，所以加上了确切位置的标记。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

让 CLI 连接一个 OpenAI 兼容的模拟服务端，第一次 `structured_output` 调用把一个数组类型字段以多一个 `]` 的字符串传入，然后检查下一次请求中的工具结果。预期：信息给出字段路径、解析错误和位置，展示带 `<<HERE>>` 的附近原文，并要求 JSON 数组。不以 `[` 或 `{` 开头的字符串、或本身是合法 JSON 的字符串，信息保持现状。嵌套路径即使位于 `anyOf` 下也只报告一次。

### 证据（前后对比）

模拟服务端 E2E（headless，`--json-schema`），第 2 轮的工具结果：
- 改动前（0.27.4）：`params/docs must be array`
- 改动后：`params/docs must be array; params/docs arrived as a string whose text is not valid JSON (Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 74 (line 1 column 75)). Text near the error, with <<HERE>> at that position: "[{\"pages\": [1], \"category_id\": \"tpl_a\", \"fields\": {\"a\": {\"raw_value\": \"x\"}<<HERE>>]}, \"issues\": []}]". Fix the text there and send it as a JSON array, not as a string`

单元测试：schema 校验器、synthetic output 工具和基础工具的测试全部通过（141 个）；core 类型检查通过。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

构建后的 CLI（`npm run build`）连接本地模拟服务端；真实模型回放使用 DashScope 标准版（北京）qwen3.8-max。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：额外文本只附加在"值是形似 JSON 但解析失败的字符串"的类型错误上，其他工具和错误不受影响。信息会把模型自己参数中最多 100 个字符回传给它。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：这里不改变服务端行为（把坏数组转成字符串），模型仍需重发这个值。解析错误的措辞来自运行时的 JSON 解析器；没有位置信息时省略标记。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

与 #18242、#18256 相关（同一结构化输出场景中出现的其他 DashScope 工具参数问题）。

</details>

prs.title: feat(memory): preserve workspace memory across task worktrees
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Bind private project auto-memory to the directory where a session starts or the workspace registered with `qwen serve`. The CLI captures the launch directory before `--worktree` opens the task checkout. A separate session started directly in a linked checkout uses its own memory directory. Standalone in-session worktree entry, exit and resume follow their existing working-directory and session lookup rules. The storage layout remains `projects/<encoded-workspace>/memory/`.

Add `/memory migrate-worktree <old path>`. An isolated model request proposes topic changes from one explicitly selected older library. The runtime shows the proposed changes and conflicts and waits for explicit consent before committing the displayed plan. The source library remains available.

Serialize project topic commits, reject stale revisions, and recover interrupted index rebuilds from the disk marker. Within each process, extract requests in arrival order and coalesce pending work from the same session. Legacy manual `/dream` still runs as a conversation turn. Project indexes have a fixed 200-line and 25,000 UTF-16 code-unit budget, with half that budget on models below 128K.

## Why it's needed

Starting a temporary checkout can hide memory learned in the workspace that created it. A useful lesson saved during the task should also be available when a user returns to that workspace. Independently registered workspaces still need private memory even when they share one repository and daemon.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- From a nested workspace with a saved topic, launch a task worktree and save another topic. A fresh session from the nested workspace should recall the new topic. A session started directly from a separate linked checkout should use its own store.
- Resume a session recorded by main from the same launch workspace using the original task name. Check that both ID and title locate the saved session and that the restored conversation receives the launch workspace's memory.
- Start a daemon task worktree and restart the daemon. The restored session should receive its registered workspace's memory. A distinct workspace whose encoded storage path collides with a registered workspace should receive an error with the runtime directory resolution.
- Start a migration with automatic tool approvals enabled. Reject the first proposal and check that the target is untouched. Approve a fresh proposal and check the selected topics and generated index. An edit made while confirmation is open should cause the stale proposal to fail.
- Run concurrent commits to different topics and verify both links. Interrupt a worker after topic publication and verify that the next index load includes the topic.

### Evidence (Before & After)

On `main@54fa2a6f6b`, a nested launch used the repository catalog, its task worktree missed the launch catalog, and the daemon accepted a colliding workspace path. The candidate used the nested launch catalog in both cases, resumed the main-generated task by ID and title with the prior turn intact, and rejected the colliding registration. Tasks from the nested daemon workspace retained their catalog after a cold restart. The separate verification comment includes the migration and crash-recovery results.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Local Git, CLI, and daemon with a controlled model |
| Windows | CI |
| Linux | CI |

## Risk & Scope

- The daemon collision check covers registered workspaces sharing an encoded store. Legacy libraries continue to use the existing encoded path, with no stored workspace identity. The legacy memory scope flag remains accepted for launch compatibility.
- Migration reads one explicitly selected library plus the current target within the model window and a 512 KiB input budget, and reserves up to 8,192 output tokens. The existing Codex import command manages its own library.

[English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/worktree-memory-ownership/docs/design/auto-memory/worktree-memory-ownership.md) · [中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/worktree-memory-ownership/docs/design/auto-memory/worktree-memory-ownership.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Closes #18030. Supersedes #18185.

The independent fix for branching from an existing nested daemon task worktree is in #18232.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动

私有项目自动记忆绑定会话启动目录或 `qwen serve` 注册工作区。CLI 在 `--worktree` 打开任务检出前捕获启动目录。直接在 linked checkout 另开会话时，使用该路径对应的库。独立 CLI 会话内进入、退出及恢复 worktree 沿用原工作目录和会话查找规则。存储沿用 `projects/<编码后的工作区>/memory/`。

新增 `/memory migrate-worktree <旧路径>`。隔离的模型调用读取用户指定的单个旧库并提出主题修改。运行时展示拟变更和冲突，收到明确确认后才提交对应方案。源库继续保留。

串行提交项目主题，拒绝覆盖已变更的版本，并通过磁盘标记修复中断的索引重建。同一进程内按到达顺序处理提取请求，仅合并同一会话的待处理请求。Legacy 手动 `/dream` 仍以对话轮次运行。项目索引常驻预算为 200 行、25,000 个 UTF-16 代码单元，低于 128K 的模型使用一半预算。

## 背景

临时检出可能读不到发起工作区已有的记忆。任务中保存的长期经验也应在回到所属工作区后可用。即使共享仓库和 daemon，独立注册的工作区仍应使用各自的私有项目记忆。

## Reviewer 验证

### 验证方式

- 从有记忆的子目录工作区启动任务 worktree 并保存另一条主题。从该工作区新开会话应能召回新主题，直接在独立 linked checkout 启动的会话应使用自己的库。
- 在原启动工作区使用相同任务名称恢复由 main 记录的会话。验证 ID 和标题都能找到旧会话，恢复后能读取启动工作区的记忆。
- 启动 daemon 任务 worktree 后重启 daemon。确认恢复会话仍能读取注册工作区的记忆。对与已注册工作区编码冲突的另一工作区，确认错误提示给出运行目录隔离方案。
- 在自动工具审批模式下发起迁移。拒绝第一份提案后核对目标没有变化。批准一份新提案，核对获选主题和生成的索引。等待确认时并发修改目标文件，过期的提案应失败。
- 并发写不同主题，验证两个链接都进入索引。在主题落盘后中断进程，验证下次加载索引包含该主题。

### 前后证据

在 `main@54fa2a6f6b`，从子目录启动读取仓库根的记忆，任务 worktree 漏读发起目录的记忆，daemon 接受了编码冲突的工作区。改动版在两种启动方式下都读取对应子目录的记忆，能按 ID 和标题恢复 main 生成的任务并保留原对话，并且拒绝冲突的注册。嵌套 daemon 工作区的任务在冷启动恢复后仍使用注册工作区的记忆。迁移和崩溃恢复结果见单独的验收评论。

### 测试平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | 使用本地 Git、CLI、daemon 和可控模型验证 |
| Windows | CI |
| Linux | CI |

## 风险与范围

- daemon 检查已注册工作区间的编码目录冲突。旧库沿用原编码路径，未记录工作区身份。旧的记忆作用域参数仍可用于启动兼容。
- 迁移在模型上下文窗口和 512 KiB 输入预算内读取用户指定的单个旧库和当前目标库，最多预留 8,192 个输出 token。Codex 库继续使用原导入命令。

[英文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/worktree-memory-ownership/docs/design/auto-memory/worktree-memory-ownership.md) · [中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/worktree-memory-ownership/docs/design/auto-memory/worktree-memory-ownership.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Closes #18030. 替代 #18185。

从嵌套 daemon 任务 worktree 再创建分支的独立修复见 #18232。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): park a wake-started Turn's approval wait
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This is the rest of slice S4 of Stage 2 in #18149: a Turn started by a wake input (a monitor notification, an automation run, a loop fire or a child-result notification) can now park while it waits for a tool approval, instead of keeping its Session resident until the human decides.

Such a Turn has no coordinator Turn row, so nothing on the control plane could bring it back after a park. Its park now claims the wake at its own due time. The seal records the wake as pending, with the park's wake time as its due time, and the park certificate gains an owner, `wake`. The existing wake-recovery scan then loads the Session when the park is due, and the wake pump resumes the wait through the recovery arm #18170 added. A decision brings it back sooner: decision delivery's load takes the Session over, and the pump resumes the wait.

- **The seal rule.** The control plane accepted a park certificate only on a seal that claims no wake. It now accepts one exactly when the claim matches the owner: a coordinator park must not claim a wake, and a wake-owned park must, or nothing would ever load it. The Harness sends this shape only when the writer grant advertises a new capability bit, which the control plane advertises together with Action parking. As in S2, the control plane does not read the bit: an older control plane never advertises it, so it never receives the shape.
- **Eligibility.** The Harness admits exactly what the recovery arm resumes: one of the four sources, through one predicate that the resume and park eligibility now share, and a native plan, so an extension command step on a wake Turn stays resident. Because the pump owns wake inputs, the "only unsettled input" term reads "no unsettled prompt input" for a wake Turn; a second wake input still refuses at the gate.
- **Approval-mode changes.** The change's busy check exempts a parked Session only when its certificate is the Session's only live work. For a wake-owned park that proof is "no active Turn row", with the same seal, approval-revision and foreign-Action checks. The same transaction makes the park's head due at once, so the scan loads it on its next pass and the resumed wait re-reads the approval mode.

Two control-plane reads used an active Turn row as the sign of a parked Turn, and a wake Turn has none. A native-file Turn records its Runtime cleanup as owed before it reaches the approval wait, so both would have seen that debt:

- The cleanup-debt scan would cleanup-load the parked Session, which reopens the park and parks again after the idle period, on every scan. It now skips a head whose current seal carries a park certificate, the same way it skips one whose seal certified a background hold: the resumed Turn releases its own cleanup when it settles.
- The recovery view would count that debt as unsettled work and, with no Harness evidence for a sealed Session, report `operator_required`. A current wake-owned park now certifies its Turn's own obligations, as a background certificate does, so the view reads `ready`, the same as a Session sealed with a deferred wake input.

## Why it's needed

Wake-started Turns are the largest group that still stays resident while waiting for an approval. #18170 made their wait survive a crash; this lets it park, since a park is a controlled crash at the same point. Channel and `pr_event` Turns, which also carry reply plans and channel settlement, follow in S4b.

The coverage design's S4 section is updated in both languages with the seal rule as implemented, the eligibility details, and the two control-plane reads above (`docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.md` and `docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.zh-CN.md`, §4.4 and §7).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

A new Harness test commits a monitor notification whose Turn asks for a write approval, lets the monitor exit so the wait is the Session's only live work, and idles the Session:

- The wait parks after one idle period. The seal claims the wake with the park's wake time as its due time and names the owner `wake`, and the Session leaves the Harness.
- A load carrying only the passive recovery flag, which decision delivery sends, attaches the Session and the pump resumes the wait. After Allow, the tool runs exactly once, the Turn settles completed, and no crash-aftermath continuation is queued.
- Without the new bit, the same wait stays resident and is counted under the `wake_owned` refusal.
- With the eligibility change reverted, the park case fails.

Control-plane cases:

- A wake-owned certificate claims the wake at its due time, and a writer acquisition clears it while keeping the head pending for the scan. A wake-owned certificate without a wake claim, or with an unknown owner, is refused.
- An approval-mode change on a wake-owned park is admitted and makes the head due; with a live Turn row present, it is refused and the due time is unchanged.
- The cleanup-debt scan skips a debt whose head carries a current park certificate, and lists it again once the certificate is for another revision.
- The recovery view reads `ready` for a wake park whose Turn owes cleanup, and not once the seal is for another revision.
- The store controller advertises the new bit.

Points to scrutinize:

- Only the monitor source has an end-to-end case. Loop, automation and child-result Turns take the same predicate and the same pump path, and expiry, where the scan loads the head at the park's wake time, is not driven end to end.
- A monitor whose run is still live keeps the Session resident unless S2 certifies that run as a background hold; that combination has no case here.
- Reporting `ready` for a wake park follows the 3a precedent for a Session sealed with a deferred wake input. A user Prompt sent meanwhile meets the resumed wake Turn, as it would if the wait had stayed resident.

Locally green on Linux:

- the control-plane seal stamp, approval change, cleanup-debt, recovery view, store controller, schema, runtime staging and Turn command test classes (8 classes, 271 cases), and Checkstyle with no violations;
- the Hosted Harness Session, wake turn, wake scheduler, wake continuation, Action parking, automation, loop, recovery and cleanup suites (9 files, 1126 cases), and the core Store client suite (254 cases);
- ESLint and Prettier on the changed files, and a narrow typecheck rooted at the changed TypeScript files, which reports only errors that exist without this change, all in unrelated files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change (control-plane seal, scan and view; Harness park eligibility).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests on H2 and the Harness test fixture only; no live deployment, no MySQL.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** a wake-started Turn's park depends on the wake-recovery scan to come back at expiry, and on decision delivery's load otherwise. A writer that clears the certificate and then crashes leaves the head pending, so the existing scan still loads it.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - MySQL 8.4 and the real-process profiles could not run locally. The seal-stamp and Turn command MySQL suites inherit the new cases; the full Managed Agent tier runs after the first approval.
  - The end-to-end gaps above.
  - S4b: channel and `pr_event` Turns.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none. Everything stays behind `qwen.managed-agent.action-parking.enabled`, which is off by default. The schema change adds one nullable column to the V1 baseline in place, per this module's rules; the new grant field is additive.

## Linked Issues

Part of #18149 (Stage 2, S4). Builds on #18170 and #18187.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

这是 #18149 阶段 2 中 S4 切片的剩余部分：由 wake 输入启动的 Turn（monitor 通知、automation 运行、loop 触发或 child 结果通知）在等待工具审批时现在可以停靠，不必在人做决定之前一直让 Session 常驻。

这类 Turn 没有协调器的 Turn 行，所以停靠后控制面上没有任何东西能把它带回来。现在它的停靠会在自己的到期时间声明 wake：seal 把 wake 记为待处理，到期时间取停靠的唤醒时间，停靠证书新增 owner `wake`。之后既有的 wake 恢复扫描会在停靠到期时加载 Session，wake 泵通过 #18170 增加的恢复臂恢复这次等待。有决定时会更早回来：决定投递的加载接管 Session，泵恢复等待。

- **seal 规则。** 控制面原先只在不声明 wake 的 seal 上接受停靠证书。现在只要声明与 owner 相符就接受：协调器的停靠不能声明 wake，wake 所有的停靠则必须声明，否则没有任何东西会加载它。Harness 只在 writer grant 公告一个新的能力位时才发送这种形态，控制面与审批停靠一起公告该位。与 S2 一样，控制面不读该位：旧控制面从不公告它，也就不会收到这种形态。
- **停靠资格。** Harness 接受的恰好是恢复臂能恢复的：来源是四种之一（恢复与停靠资格现在共用同一个谓词判断），且计划是原生的，所以 wake Turn 上的 extension command step 保持常驻。由于 wake 输入归泵所有，对 wake Turn 而言"唯一未结算输入"这一项变为"没有未结算的 prompt 输入"；第二条 wake 输入仍会在闸门处被拒。
- **审批模式变更。** 变更的忙碌检查只在停靠证书是 Session 唯一活跃工作时才豁免该 Session。对 wake 所有的停靠，这一证明是"没有活跃的 Turn 行"，并保留相同的 seal、审批修订和外来 Action 检查。同一事务把该停靠的 head 立即置为到期，扫描会在下一轮加载它，恢复的等待会重新读取审批模式。

有两处控制面读取把活跃的 Turn 行当作存在停靠 Turn 的标志，而 wake Turn 没有这一行。原生文件 Turn 在进入审批等待之前，就已把 Runtime 清理记为待偿，所以两处都会看到这笔欠账：

- 清理欠账扫描会对停靠的 Session 做仅清理加载，这会重新打开停靠，空闲一段时间后再次停靠，每轮扫描都如此。现在它跳过当前 seal 带有停靠证书的 head，与已有的"seal 认证了后台持有就跳过"一致：恢复的 Turn 结算时会自己释放清理。
- 恢复视图会把这笔欠账算作未结算工作，又因为已 seal 的 Session 没有 Harness 证据，报告 `operator_required`。现在当前的 wake 所有停靠会像后台证书一样认证其 Turn 自身的义务，所以视图显示 `ready`，与带有延迟 wake 输入的已 seal Session 一致。

## 为什么需要

wake 启动的 Turn 是等待审批时仍然常驻的最大一类。#18170 让它们的等待能扛过崩溃；本 PR 让它们能停靠，因为停靠就是在同一位置的一次受控崩溃。带回复计划和渠道结算的 channel 与 `pr_event` Turn 放在 S4b。

覆盖面设计的 S4 一节已中英文同步更新：实现后的 seal 规则、资格细节，以及上述两处控制面读取（`docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.md` 与 `docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.zh-CN.md`，§4.4 与 §7）。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

新增的 Harness 测试提交一条 monitor 通知，让它的 Turn 请求写入审批；随后让 monitor 退出，使这次等待成为 Session 唯一的活跃工作，再让 Session 空闲：

- 等待在一个空闲周期后停靠。seal 声明 wake，到期时间取停靠的唤醒时间，owner 为 `wake`，Session 离开 Harness。
- 只带被动恢复标志的加载（决定投递发出的正是这种）接上 Session，泵恢复这次等待。Allow 之后，工具恰好执行一次，Turn 以 completed 结算，没有排入崩溃善后的 continuation。
- 没有新能力位时，同样的等待保持常驻，并计入 `wake_owned` 拒绝原因。
- 撤掉停靠资格的改动后，停靠用例失败。

控制面用例：

- wake 所有的证书在到期时间声明 wake；取得 writer 会清除它，同时让 head 对扫描保持待处理。不声明 wake 的 wake 所有证书、或 owner 未知的证书会被拒绝。
- 对 wake 所有停靠的审批模式变更会被接受，并让 head 到期；存在活跃 Turn 行时会被拒绝，到期时间不变。
- 清理欠账扫描跳过 head 带有当前停靠证书的欠账；证书属于其他修订时重新列出它。
- 停靠 Turn 欠清理时，恢复视图对 wake 停靠显示 `ready`；seal 属于其他修订时则不是。
- Store controller 公告新能力位。

值得仔细审查的地方：

- 只有 monitor 来源有端到端用例。loop、automation 与 child 结果 Turn 走的是同一个谓词和同一条泵路径；到期路径（扫描在停靠唤醒时间加载 head）没有端到端驱动。
- monitor 的运行仍然活跃时，Session 会保持常驻，除非 S2 把该运行认证为后台持有；这种组合本 PR 没有用例。
- 对 wake 停靠报告 `ready` 沿用了 3a 的先例（带延迟 wake 输入的已 seal Session）。其间发来的用户 Prompt 会遇到恢复的 wake Turn，与等待一直常驻时的情况相同。

在 Linux 本地通过：

- 控制面的 seal stamp、审批变更、清理欠账、恢复视图、Store controller、schema、运行时暂存与 Turn 命令测试类（8 个类，271 例），Checkstyle 无违规；
- Hosted Harness Session、wake turn、wake 调度器、wake continuation、审批停靠、automation、loop、恢复与清理测试（9 个文件，1126 例），以及 core Store 客户端测试（254 例）；
- 改动文件上的 ESLint 和 Prettier，以及以改动的 TypeScript 文件为入口的窄范围类型检查，只报出不改动时也存在的错误，都在无关文件里。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A — 非 UI 改动（控制面 seal、扫描与视图；Harness 停靠资格）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境

仅 H2 上的单元测试与 Harness 测试夹具；没有在线部署，没有 MySQL。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍：** wake 启动的 Turn 停靠后，到期时依靠 wake 恢复扫描回来，否则依靠决定投递的加载。清除证书后又崩溃的 writer 会让 head 保持待处理，所以既有扫描仍会加载它。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内：**
  - 本地无法运行 MySQL 8.4 和真实进程 profile。seal stamp 与 Turn 命令的 MySQL 测试会继承新用例；完整的 Managed Agent 层级会在首次批准后运行。
  - 上面提到的端到端缺口。
  - S4b：channel 与 `pr_event` Turn。
- **破坏性改动/迁移：** 无。所有改动都在默认关闭的 `qwen.managed-agent.action-parking.enabled` 之后。按本模块规则，schema 改动是在 V1 基线中原地新增一个可空列；新的 grant 字段只是追加。

属于 #18149（阶段 2，S4）。基于 #18170 和 #18187。

A Turn started by a monitor notification, an automation run, a loop fire
or a child-result notification has no Turn row, so its approval wait
stayed resident. Its park now claims the wake at its own due time: the
seal records the wake as pending, and the certificate's new owner, wake,
says which Turn it parked. The existing wake-recovery scan loads the head
when the park is due, and the pump resumes the wait through the recovery
arm #18170 added. The Harness sends this shape only on the new
wakeActionParking grant bit.

Eligibility admits exactly what that arm resumes: one of the four
sources, through one predicate they now share, and a native plan. An
approval-mode change proves a wake-owned park by the absence of an
active Turn row and makes its head due at once. Two control-plane reads
that relied on a Turn row learn the park too: the cleanup-debt scan
skips a head whose seal parked a Turn, and the recovery view treats a
wake park's own owed cleanup as certified work.

Refs #18149

prs.title: fix(core): append effective permission context before model requests
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Provide the model with the effective runtime approval mode before newly prepared main-session requests. Following Codex's snapshot approach, unchanged state adds nothing and mode changes append a reminder to conversation history. The system prompt and earlier permission snapshots remain unchanged, preserving the existing cacheable prefix.

Persist the snapshots through resume and managed-session migration, reintroduce them when compaction removes them, and let inherited chats append their own mode when it differs. Include pending snapshots in prompt sizing and avoid counting them twice.

## Why it's needed

A session can run in `default` while its settings file still contains `auto`. Without authoritative context, a model can read that file after a successful tool call and incorrectly claim that automatic approval is active. The reminder explains that settings and successful execution do not establish the current approval mode or prove human approval.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a session with persisted `auto` and an effective `default` override. The first provider request should announce `default` before the model chooses an action.
2. In both ACP loops, change modes through `default → default → auto → auto-edit → yolo → plan → default`. The repeated mode should add no snapshot; each change should append one. The system prompt must remain identical, and every preceding complete request message array must remain an exact prefix of the next.
3. Resume, compact, rewind, and fork into a different mode. Retained snapshots should survive restoration; missing or changed state should produce a current update without rewriting inherited history.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No UI change. Provider-request captures, focused test results and build/typecheck results are reported in the separate verification comment. The baseline lacked an effective-mode announcement outside the existing plan reminder.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local verification |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Isolated worktree, local deterministic OpenAI-compatible provider and isolated session settings. No external inference or effectful tools.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: each initial snapshot or mode change adds a small amount of context. Prefix preservation does not guarantee a provider cache hit; compaction and other request changes can still affect caching.
- Not validated / out of scope: live-model compliance, actual cache-hit rates, forced approval and duplicate-command prevention. Tool permission decisions remain unchanged. Exact prepared-request replay keeps its saved context; the next fresh request checks the live mode again.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: adds an internal transcript record. Existing sessions acquire a snapshot on their next newly prepared main request.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-11-24-effective-permission-context.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-24-effective-permission-context.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

No linked issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 变更内容

在主会话新构造请求前，向模型提供运行时生效的审批模式。参考 Codex 的快照方式，状态不变时不追加内容，模式变化时向对话历史追加提醒。系统提示词与旧权限快照保持不变，保留已有可缓存前缀。

快照随会话恢复和托管迁移持久化，压缩移除后重新注入；继承历史的会话在实际模式不同时追加自身状态。待追加快照纳入提示词大小估算，并避免重复计量。

## 变更原因

会话实际运行于 `default` 时，配置文件仍可能包含 `auto`。缺少权威上下文时，模型可能在工具执行成功后读取配置，并错误地声称当前启用了自动审批。提醒明确说明：配置文件和执行成功都不能确定当前审批模式，也不能证明人工批准。

## 评审验证计划

### 验证方式

1. 配置持久值为 `auto`，用实际 `default` 覆盖启动会话。第一次 provider 请求应在模型决定操作前声明 `default`。
2. 两种 ACP loop 均执行 `default → default → auto → auto-edit → yolo → plan → default`。重复模式不新增快照，每次变化只追加一份。系统提示词须完全相同，前一次完整请求消息数组须为后一次请求的精确前缀。
3. 验证恢复、压缩、回退及分叉到不同模式。保留的快照应能恢复；状态缺失或变化时应补充当前状态，同时保持继承历史不变。

### 前后证据

没有 UI 改动。provider 请求捕获、定向测试及构建和类型检查结果见独立验证评论。基线除了已有 plan 提醒，缺少生效模式声明。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 测试环境

独立 worktree、本地确定性 OpenAI 兼容 provider 及隔离会话配置。未调用外部模型或执行有副作用的工具。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：首次快照和每次模式变化增加少量上下文。保留前缀不等于保证 provider 命中缓存；压缩及其它请求变化仍可能影响缓存。
- 未验证或不在范围内：真实模型遵从性、实际缓存命中率、强制审批和重复命令防护。工具权限裁决保持原有行为。已准备请求的精确回放保留原上下文，下一次新构造请求再次检查实际模式。
- 兼容性或迁移说明：新增内部 transcript 记录。已有会话在下一次新构造主会话请求时获得快照。

设计：[English](docs/design/2026-11-24-effective-permission-context.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-24-effective-permission-context.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

没有关联 Issue。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): switch ManagedSessionsPage chat column onto shared ChatSurface (slice 3c.3)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR switches the Managed sessions page chat column onto the shared backend-neutral chat surface backed by the Managed controller adapter, retiring the page's duplicated inline message-list, tool-approval, question-card, and composer orchestration while keeping Managed's live stream count, child-session action isolation, durable pending outbox, and visual layout unchanged:

- **Adds a shared-state Managed controller binding so live streams are never duplicated.** The Managed controller binding now exposes a shared-state entry point that reuses the page's already-mounted session, pending-actions, and turn-cancellation hooks rather than opening a second event stream or polling loop. Pending-action responses travel through one shared transport call that carries operation admission and settlement observers so forbidden latches, retryable errors, draft clearing, and controller operation state stay synchronized. The existing standalone Managed controller binding keeps its exact contract unchanged.
- **Hardens child-session action isolation and expired-action display in the Managed controller.** Pending-action projection caching, in-flight tracking, and live-action guards now scope by session and action identity together so multiple child sessions sharing an action identifier never collide, child-session approval previews exclude root-session messages, and an opt-in retention flag allows expired actions to remain visible in a disabled state while still rejecting expired submissions fail-closed.
- **Adds backend-neutral host seams to the shared chat surface and switches the Managed sessions page onto it.** The shared chat surface now accepts optional host pass-throughs for transcript and composer properties, decision chrome slots (action selector, child-session banner, expiry/size/argument caveats), question draft and submit-block props, composer visibility/cancel/submit hooks, and layout wrapper classes — every added seam is actively consumed by the Managed sessions page, and omitting them preserves existing defaults unchanged. The Managed sessions page no longer renders or imports the message list, tool approval card, question card, composer editor, or request projection helpers directly.

Design docs: [English](docs/design/2026-11-26-managed-page-chat-surface-switch.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-26-managed-page-chat-surface-switch.zh-CN.md)

## Why it's needed

After unifying all four chat primitives onto shared components, the Managed sessions page still carried its own inline chat column wiring, request projection caches, and cancellation wrapper instead of rendering the shared chat surface. Switching the Managed column onto the shared chat surface completes Managed's structural convergence onto one surface + two adapters with zero visual drift and zero duplicate network streams, clearing the path for daemon main-column and split-pane convergence.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open a Managed session with root/child pending questions, a pending permission approval, and an active turn; verify the chat column renders through the shared chat surface with a single active event stream (no duplicate subscriptions or action polling), preserving exact layout alignment.
2. Answer a child-session multi-line question, switch across a second child question sharing the same action identifier and a root permission approval, approve the root permission, retry a transient 503 failure on the second child question (confirming the exact same idempotency key and multi-line answers are sent), and confirm the first child's multi-line draft stays intact.
3. Verify an expired Managed action remains visible in a disabled state with the expired status notice while submission is rejected fail-closed; verify stopping a running or cancellable failed turn routes through the shared surface's cancel path and settles cleanly, while read-only/non-cancellable host mode keeps the composer stop action hidden and inactive.
4. Run the focused and broad web-shell test suites, both package typecheck configs, artifact tests, lint, formatting, and repository build/typecheck:
   - `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run components/managed chat-core components/messages/AskUserQuestion.test.tsx components/TranscriptViewport.test.tsx` (75 test files, 1635 tests passed)
   - `cd packages/web-shell && npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` (clean)
   - `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run build-artifact.test.ts` (47 tests passed)
   - `npm run build && npm run typecheck` (clean)

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Before (inline chat column on `main`) | After (shared chat surface, pixel-consistent layout) |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: inline Managed chat column](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets-pr18376/pr18376-r2/before-managed-chat-surface.png) | ![After: shared chat surface](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets-pr18376/pr18376-r2/after-managed-chat-surface.png) |

Expired permission card rendered disabled with an `Expired` status notice (after F1 fix):

![After: expired permission card disabled with Expired notice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets-pr18376/pr18376-r2/after-expired-permission.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node 22 + Vitest + Vite + headless Chromium (`StrictMode`) against a local Managed HTTP/SSE endpoint serving root/child questions, a root permission approval, and a cancellable active turn (verifying shared chat surface rendering, single active SSE stream, pixel-consistent Before/After layout, child multi-line draft preservation, permission approval, 503 retry with identical idempotency key, and turn cancellation through the shared surface, with 0 page errors and 0 unexpected console errors).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Managed's durable pending-command outbox (IndexedDB/localStorage persistence, side queries, and user-message queue) stays hosted behind the surface's optional composer-submit seam rather than being folded into the controller in this PR, avoiding conflicts with the surface's transient unknown-admission banner and keeping draft-retry flows intact until a dedicated outbox convergence pass.
- Not validated / out of scope: Daemon main-column switching, split-pane convergence, status-stack/usage-stat parity, and bundle boundary enforcement belong to subsequent slices. No daemon/Java routes, OpenAPI schemas, storage keys, or i18n keys were changed.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None for existing production callers; all new shared chat surface props are optional with defaults matching existing behavior, and the standalone Managed controller binding keeps its existing contract.

## Linked Issues

Part of #17460.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 将 Managed 会话页面的聊天列切换至由 Managed 适配器驱动的共享后端中立聊天界面，退场页面内联的消息列表、工具审批、提问卡片与编辑器编排，同时保持 Managed 实时事件流唯一、子会话动作隔离、持久化待发队列与视觉布局完全不变：

- **新增共享状态 Managed 控制器绑定，避免重复开启事件流。** Managed 控制器绑定现提供共享状态入口，直接复用页面已挂载的会话、待处理动作与取消 hook，不再开启第二条 SSE 流或重复轮询。待处理动作响应经由同一次传输调用透传准入与结算观察者，使禁止闩锁、错误重试、草稿清理与控制器意图台账保持一致。既有独立 Managed 控制器绑定契约保持不变。
- **加固 Managed 控制器的子会话动作隔离与过期动作展示。** 待处理动作的投影缓存、在飞跟踪与活跃守卫现统一按会话与动作标识联合限定，避免共享同一动作 ID 的多个子会话互相冲突；子会话审批预览不再混入根会话消息；支持按需在投影中保留过期动作以便展示禁用提示，同时提交入口继续 fail-closed 拒绝过期提交。
- **为共享聊天界面补齐后端中立宿主缝隙并完成 Managed 会话页面切换。** 共享聊天界面新增面向转录、编辑器、决策卡外框（多动作切换器、子会话提示、过期/超限/参数说明）、提问草稿与仅禁提交、编辑器可见性/取消/提交以及布局类名的可选宿主属性——每项新增属性均由 Managed 会话页面实际消费，省略时保持原有默认行为。Managed 会话页面不再直接导入或渲染消息列表、审批卡、提问卡、编辑器及请求投影助手。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-11-26-managed-page-chat-surface-switch.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-26-managed-page-chat-surface-switch.zh-CN.md)

## 为什么需要

在四个聊天原语全部统一到共享组件后，Managed 会话页面仍保留了一整套内联聊天列编排、重复请求投影缓存与取消包装，尚未真正挂到共享聊天界面上。本 PR 完成 Managed 侧到「一个共享界面、两套适配器」的结构收敛，零视觉漂移、零重复网络流，为后续 Daemon 主列与分屏收敛铺平道路。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证步骤

1. 打开包含根/子会话待处理问题、权限审批与运行中回合的 Managed 会话，确认聊天列经由共享聊天界面渲染，仅开启 1 条实时事件流（无重复订阅与轮询），页面布局对齐无漂移。
2. 在子会话问题中输入多行草稿，切换到共享同一动作 ID 的另一子会话问题与根权限审批，批准根权限并在第二个子会话问题上模拟 503 失败重试（确认两次发送相同幂等键与多行答案），验证第一个子会话的多行草稿完好保留。
3. 确认已过期的 Managed 动作保留禁用展示与过期提示且提交被 fail-closed 拒绝；确认停止运行中或可取消的失败回合经共享界面取消路径正常结算，而只读/不可取消模式下编辑器停止按钮保持隐藏与禁用。
4. 运行单测与集成套件、两份包类型门禁、构建产物契约测试与全仓构建/类型检查：
   - `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run components/managed chat-core components/messages/AskUserQuestion.test.tsx components/TranscriptViewport.test.tsx`（75 个测试文件，1635 项用例全部通过）
   - `cd packages/web-shell && npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`（通过）
   - `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run build-artifact.test.ts`（47 项用例通过）
   - `npm run build && npm run typecheck`（通过）

### 证据（改前 / 改后）

| 改前（`main` 上的内联 Managed 聊天列） | 改后（共享聊天界面，布局零漂移） |
| --- | --- |
| ![改前：内联 Managed 聊天列](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets-pr18376/pr18376-r2/before-managed-chat-surface.png) | ![改后：共享聊天界面](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets-pr18376/pr18376-r2/after-managed-chat-surface.png) |

已过期权限审批卡片保持禁用态并显示 `Expired` 状态提示（修复 F1 后）：

![改后：过期权限审批卡禁用并展示 Expired 提示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets-pr18376/pr18376-r2/after-expired-permission.png)

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 测试环境（可选）

本地 Node 22 + Vitest + Vite + headless Chromium（`StrictMode`）对接本地 Managed HTTP/SSE 端点（提供根/子会话问题、根权限审批与可取消活动回合，实测共享聊天界面渲染、单条 SSE 流、改前/改后布局一致、子会话多行草稿保留、权限批准、503 同幂等键重试及经共享界面取消回合，0 页面错误、0 非预期控制台错误）。

## 风险与范围

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): park an approval wait beside a certified background hold
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This is slice S2 of Stage 2 in #18149. A tool approval wait in a Session whose background runs are covered by a verified background hold (Phase 3b) can now park, instead of keeping the Session resident for as long as the human takes to decide.

Until now the two certificates could not share a seal: the control plane refused a seal that carried both the background hold and the park certificate, so the Harness kept every approval wait resident while a background run was live.

The change has three parts:

- **The seal accepts both certificates.** The writer grant gains a new capability bit, which the control plane advertises together with Action parking. The Harness sends the pair only when it sees that bit. The control plane does not read the bit when it accepts the pair: an older control plane never advertises it, so it never receives the pair.
- **A background terminal makes a park due at once instead of ending it.** When the Broker stages a background terminal for a parked Session, the park certificate stays on the head and its wake time moves to now. This happens on both server paths that meet staged work: the seal, when work was already staged before it (this path used to clear the park fields), and the staging transaction, which also releases a Turn row that is already parked. Whatever the order of staging, seal and park, the park succeeds with a retry time of now, the dispatch sweep picks the Turn up on its next pass, and the background terminal never costs the Turn a charged retry.
- **The Harness parks beside a certified background hold.** With the bit advertised, a certified background hold no longer blocks a parked wait, and the seal carries the background flag beside the park certificate.

## Why it's needed

A Session that runs a long build or a Monitor in the background and then asks for an approval is a common shape, and it stayed resident through the whole wait. Stage 2 of #18149 lifts that exclusion.

This PR departs from the merged coverage design in one place. The design had staging clear the park certificate, and the coordinator then classify the refused park as an awakened one. Once the certificate is cleared, nothing is left to classify it by, and the ordinary fallback is a charged retry whose backoff never resets, so every background terminal near a park would cost the Turn a failure. Keeping the certificate and making it due now removes the need for a classification: every order ends in a successful park that is redispatched at once, and the coordinator does not change. The coverage design (`docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.md` and `docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.zh-CN.md`, §4.2) and the parent design's §4.9 item 3 (`docs/design/2026-11-21-managed-action-parking.md` and its `.zh-CN.md` version) are updated to match, in both languages.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Control plane:

- A seal carrying both certificates records both.
- A seal that meets already-staged work keeps the park certificate, with its wake time moved to now.
- Staging a wake-worthy batch for a parked Session moves the certificate's wake time to now and releases the parked Turn row.
- A park against a certificate that is already due parks the Turn with a retry time of now, spends no retry, and leaves the Turn immediately dispatchable.
- The Store controller advertises the new bit beside Action parking.

Harness and its Store client:

- The Store client reads the new bit on acquisition and renewal, and sends the combined seal unchanged.
- With a certified background hold and the bit advertised, an approval wait parks after one idle period, and the seal carries the background flag and the park certificate. After a cold load and Allow, the tool runs exactly once.
- With the bit absent, the same wait stays resident and is counted as an eligibility failure.
- Reverting the Harness change makes the parked case fail; reverting the staging change makes the staging case fail.

Points to scrutinize:

- The first increment changes behavior too. A park seal that met staged work used to drop the certificate, so the park was refused and the Turn took one ordinary retry; it now parks due at once. This also applies to a Session without a background hold.
- A wake-recovery load that takes the writer before the park still clears the certificate, as any writer acquisition does, and that park falls back to one ordinary retry, as today.
- The Harness test stubs the background certificate. No test drives the full path: a real background run, a park, a staged terminal, a cold load, and the notification delivered after the Turn settles. The Harness Session test fixture has no Phase 3b background-suspension scaffolding at all, so this acceptance case (§7 of the coverage design) stays open.

Locally green on Linux:

- the control-plane seal stamp, runtime staging, Turn command and Store controller test classes (72 cases), and Checkstyle with no violations;
- the core Store client suite (253 cases);
- the Hosted Harness Session, Action parking and cleanup suites (931 cases);
- the full build, ESLint and Prettier on the changed files, and a narrow typecheck rooted at the changed files, which reports only errors that exist without this change, all in unrelated files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change (control-plane seal and staging, Harness park eligibility).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests on H2 and the Harness test fixture only; no live deployment, no MySQL.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** parking now covers Sessions with live background runs. Cold recovery of such a park combines the Phase 3b reattach and drain with the approval recovery arm. #18151 confirmed that the wake loads enter that arm, but the combined path has no end-to-end test yet.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - MySQL 8.4 and the real-process profiles could not run locally, and are left to CI. The seal-stamp and Turn command MySQL suites inherit the new cases; the staging MySQL suite does not.
  - The full control-plane verification run, including SpotBugs, is left to CI.
  - The end-to-end case above.
  - Wake-started Turns (S4) are a separate slice.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none. Everything stays behind `qwen.managed-agent.action-parking.enabled`, which is off by default. The new grant field is additive, and no schema or configuration changes.

## Linked Issues

Part of #18149 (Stage 2, S2). Independent of #18164, #18166 and #18170.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

这是 #18149 阶段 2 的 S2 切片。如果一个 Session 的后台运行已由经过验证的 background hold（阶段 3b）覆盖，它的工具审批等待现在也可以停靠，不必在人做决定的整段时间里让 Session 一直常驻。

此前两份证书不能出现在同一个 seal 里：控制面会拒绝同时带有 background hold 和停靠证书的 seal，所以只要有后台运行，Harness 就让每个审批等待保持常驻。

改动分三部分：

- **seal 接受两份证书同时存在。** writer grant 新增一个能力位，控制面与审批停靠一起公告它。Harness 只在看到该位时才发送这种组合。控制面接受这种组合时不读该位：旧控制面从不公告它，所以也不会收到这种组合。
- **后台终态让停靠立即到期，而不是结束停靠。** Broker 为停靠中的 Session 暂存后台终态时，停靠证书留在 head 上，唤醒时间改为当前时间。遇到暂存工作的两条服务端路径都这样处理：一是 seal，当 seal 之前已经有暂存工作时（这条路径过去会清空停靠字段）；二是暂存事务，它还会解除已经停靠的 Turn 行。无论暂存、seal 与停靠的先后顺序如何，停靠都会以当前时间作为重试时间成功，分派扫描在下一轮取到该 Turn，后台终态也不会让 Turn 走一次计入预算的重试。
- **Harness 在已认证的 background hold 旁停靠。** 公告了该位时，已认证的 background hold 不再阻止停靠等待，seal 会在停靠证书旁带上 background 标志。

## 为什么需要

Session 在后台跑一个长构建或 Monitor，随后请求审批，这是常见形态，而它在整个等待期间都保持常驻。#18149 的阶段 2 解除这一排除。

本 PR 在一处偏离了已合入的覆盖面设计。设计原本让暂存清除停靠证书，再由协调器把被拒的停靠归类为"被唤醒的停靠"。可证书一旦清除，就没有任何依据可以归类；而兜底的普通重试会计入预算，退避也永不重置，所以每个落在停靠附近的后台终态都会让 Turn 记一次失败。保留证书并让它立即到期，就不再需要归类：每种顺序都以一次成功的停靠结束并立即重新分派，协调器也不用改。覆盖面设计（`docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.md` 与 `docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.zh-CN.md`，§4.2）以及父设计 §4.9 第 3 点（`docs/design/2026-11-21-managed-action-parking.md` 及其 `.zh-CN.md` 版本）都已按此修改，中英文同步。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

控制面：

- 同时带两份证书的 seal 会把两份都记录下来。
- seal 遇到已暂存的工作时保留停靠证书，唤醒时间改为当前时间。
- 为停靠中的 Session 暂存一个 wake-worthy 批次，会把证书的唤醒时间改为当前时间，并解除已停靠的 Turn 行。
- 对已经到期的证书执行停靠，会以当前时间作为重试时间停靠该 Turn，不消耗重试，且 Turn 立即可分派。
- Store controller 在审批停靠旁公告新能力位。

Harness 及其 Store 客户端：

- Store 客户端在获取和续约 writer 时读取新能力位，并原样发送组合 seal。
- 存在已认证的 background hold 且公告了该位时，审批等待在一个空闲周期后停靠，seal 同时带有 background 标志和停靠证书。冷加载并 Allow 之后，工具恰好执行一次。
- 没有该位时，同样的等待保持常驻，并计为一次资格失败。
- 撤掉 Harness 改动后，停靠用例失败；撤掉暂存改动后，暂存用例失败。

需要重点审查的地方：

- 首个增量的行为也有变化。停靠 seal 遇到暂存工作时，过去会丢掉证书，停靠被拒，Turn 走一次普通重试；现在会以立即到期的状态停靠。没有 background hold 的 Session 也适用。
- 如果 wake 恢复加载在停靠之前取得 writer，它仍会像任何取得 writer 的操作一样清除证书，这次停靠退回一次普通重试，与现在一致。
- Harness 测试对 background 证书做了桩。没有测试走完整条路径：真实的后台运行、停靠、暂存终态、冷加载、Turn 结算后投递通知。Harness Session 测试夹具完全没有阶段 3b 后台挂起的搭建，所以这个验收用例（覆盖面设计 §7）仍未覆盖。

本地在 Linux 上通过：

- 控制面的 seal stamp、运行时暂存、Turn 命令和 Store controller 测试类（72 例），Checkstyle 无违规；
- core Store 客户端测试（253 例）；
- Hosted Harness Session、审批停靠与清理测试（931 例）；
- 完整构建，改动文件上的 ESLint 和 Prettier，以及以改动文件为入口的窄范围类型检查，只报出不改动时也存在的错误，都在无关文件里。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A — 非 UI 改动（控制面 seal 与暂存、Harness 停靠资格）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境

仅 H2 上的单元测试与 Harness 测试夹具；没有在线部署，没有 MySQL。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍：** 停靠现在覆盖有活跃后台运行的 Session。这种停靠的冷恢复要把阶段 3b 的重新附着与排空和审批恢复臂结合起来。#18151 已确认 wake 加载会进入该恢复臂，但这条组合路径还没有端到端测试。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内：**
  - 本地无法运行 MySQL 8.4 和真实进程 profile，留给 CI。seal stamp 与 Turn 命令的 MySQL 测试会继承新用例；暂存的 MySQL 测试不会。
  - 完整的控制面验证（包括 SpotBugs）留给 CI。
  - 上面提到的端到端用例。
  - wake 启动的 Turn（S4）是单独的切片。
- **破坏性改动/迁移：** 无。所有改动都在默认关闭的 `qwen.managed-agent.action-parking.enabled` 之后。新增的 grant 字段只是追加，没有 schema 或配置改动。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #18149（阶段 2，S2）。与 #18164、#18166、#18170 互不依赖。

</details>

auto_merge.commit_message:
A Session whose background runs held a verified 3b certificate kept its
approval wait resident, because the Store refused a seal carrying both
certificates. The seal now accepts the pair, and a Harness sends it only
when the writer grant advertises the new backgroundActionParking bit.

A background terminal the Broker stages no longer ends a park: the
certificate stays but falls due at once, on the seal's staged-wake path
and in the staging transaction, which also unparks a parked Turn row.
Every interleaving with the park CAS then parks the Turn for immediate
dispatch instead of taking a charged retry.

Refs #18149

prs.title: feat(cli): persist reasoning effort and context window per model
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Qwen Code now remembers reasoning effort and context window size for each model in the interactive CLI. Both preferences take effect when saved and are restored on a model switch or a fresh launch. Model IDs shared by different endpoints have separate preferences.

## Why it's needed

Different models suit different reasoning and context budgets. A single shared effort setting made it easy to carry the wrong effort into the next model. Setting a window from the CLI lets users choose how much context the session should keep before compaction.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In Ink or OpenTUI, open `/effort` and move the highlight to another tier. Confirm that Esc keeps the saved tier. Open the picker again, choose a tier, and press Enter. The confirmation and status line should show the selected tier.
2. Set a smaller window on the same model and open `/context`. The configured window and compaction thresholds should reflect the change. An oversized window should be rejected. Resetting the window should restore the model default and keep the saved effort.
3. Save distinct preferences for two models, switch A → B → A, and start a fresh CLI process using the same settings. Check that both models recover their own effort and window without re-entering either value.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Before:** Main saves one shared reasoning effort. The interactive CLI has no `/context-window` command.

**After:** Both terminals restored `gpt-5.4` (`low`, 128,000 tokens) and `gpt-5.2` (`high`, 192,000 tokens) on model switches and in a fresh process. `/context` confirmed each window and a loopback OpenAI-compatible mock confirmed the model ID and effort on each request. The E2E comment includes the switch-back and restart screenshots.

<details>
<summary>Actual terminal screenshots · choose a tier, save it, and change the window</summary>

**Choose a tier with the arrow keys**

![OpenTUI effort picker with medium highlighted](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4d2ef1b9-43a7-409e-a384-adfeb71edc55)

**Press Enter to save**

![OpenTUI confirms medium and updates the status line](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/890d0e96-d0ee-44ef-8d33-04bd75049753)

**Change the context window**

![OpenTUI confirms the context window change from 128000 to 160000 tokens](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/33f72464-5352-4093-b529-3f63fd7ecc8f)

</details>

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Ink and OpenTUI |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Bundled CLI on macOS with isolated settings and a loopback OpenAI-compatible mock.

## Risk & Scope

- Preference lookup depends on the resolved model and endpoint identity. The tests cover same-ID endpoints, settings precedence, and the OAuth hot-switch path at the unit level.
- Interactive validation used a local mock. Provider-hosted requests and remote clients are outside the test scope.
- The existing global effort remains the fallback for models that have no saved effort.

Design documents · [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1f938d404fe873d3cc63f5379b9fa5aac33f7e40/docs/design/2026-11-25-per-model-preferences.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1f938d404fe873d3cc63f5379b9fa5aac33f7e40/docs/design/2026-11-25-per-model-preferences.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 改动内容

Qwen Code 在交互式 CLI 中按模型保存思考强度和上下文窗口。设置保存后立即生效，切换模型或启动新进程时自动恢复。不同端点上的同名模型各自保存设置。

### 为什么需要

不同模型适合不同的思考和上下文预算。只保存一个全局强度时，切换模型容易沿用上一模型的强度。通过 CLI 设置窗口，也能调整会话在压缩前保留的上下文量。

### 审阅者测试计划

1. 在 Ink 或 OpenTUI 中打开 `/effort`，把高亮移到其他档位。按 Esc 应保留原档位。重新打开后选择一档，按 Enter。确认提示和状态栏应显示新档位。
2. 为同一模型设置较小的窗口，打开 `/context` 核对窗口和压缩阈值。超限输入应被拒绝。重置后应恢复模型默认窗口并保留思考强度。
3. 为两个模型保存不同设置，执行 A → B → A，再使用同一份配置启动新的 CLI 进程。两个模型都应自动恢复各自的思考强度和窗口。

**改动前**，main 只保存一个共享的思考强度，交互式 CLI 没有 `/context-window` 命令。

**改动后**，两个终端都在切换和启动新进程后恢复了 `gpt-5.4`（`low`、128,000 tokens）和 `gpt-5.2`（`high`、192,000 tokens）的设置。`/context` 确认了窗口，本地 OpenAI 兼容模拟接口确认了每次请求的模型 ID 和思考强度。上方三张截图依次展示选择档位、确认保存和修改窗口，E2E 评论附有切回模型和启动新进程的截图。

**测试环境**为 macOS 上的打包版 Ink 与 OpenTUI，使用隔离配置和本地 OpenAI 兼容模拟接口。Windows 和 Linux 未在本地运行。

### 风险和范围

- 偏好查找依赖解析后的模型和端点标识。测试覆盖了同名模型的多个端点、配置优先级，并用单测覆盖 OAuth 热切换。
- 交互验证使用本地模拟接口。真实供应商请求和远程客户端不在本轮验证范围内。
- 没有保存过思考强度的模型继续使用已有的全局强度作为回退值。

设计文档 · [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1f938d404fe873d3cc63f5379b9fa5aac33f7e40/docs/design/2026-11-25-per-model-preferences.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1f938d404fe873d3cc63f5379b9fa5aac33f7e40/docs/design/2026-11-25-per-model-preferences.zh-CN.md)

### 关联 Issue

无。

</details>
