prs.title: fix(cli): refresh worktree status and preserve exit cleanup
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Coordinates the existing final-process watcher policy with confirmed interactive exits and restarts, and replaces worktree sidecar directory watching with an exact-file, nonpersistent 500 ms subscription. A changed configuration or session cannot display an old sidecar, and unsubscribe affects only the owning listener.

The review follow-up checks that a supervised in-place restart launcher resolves to a regular file and is executable after cleanup, immediately before the original exec attempt. A known invalid launcher or catchable JavaScript exception produces a best-effort safe error and terminal exit code 42. Without a supervisor, manual restart is required. Successful restart arguments, GC flags and cleanup order remain unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Final exits should apply the existing watcher shutdown policy consistently. Worktree footer updates need to survive sidecar creation, deletion and atomic replacement without depending on directory notifications. Separately, a real owned-copy test showed that removing the launcher could run cleanup and then abort the runtime rather than reach the former catch-based fallback. The new precheck handles this known-invalid-path case; it does not make native exec failure generally recoverable.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm that the first unconfirmed interrupt still only warns, while confirmed exits retain their existing codes. Enter and leave a worktree and check that the current footer follows the durable sidecar. Switching owners, removing a listener, a failed read after a previously loaded worktree, and a later successful read should not leave stale state or disturb another subscriber.

For restart failure, use only an owned executable copy: start it, remove that copy, and request a restart. Cleanup should run once, the safe error should be reported when writable, and the process should exit 42 rather than signal-abort. Check that valid launchers retain the original arguments and that a closed error stream cannot prevent the catchable-error fallback. Do not remove or modify an installed/global executable.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the real owned Node-copy/unlink reproduction ran cleanup, then native exec failed with ENOENT/SIGABRT instead of 42. After: the real-child regression passed with cleanup recorded, no terminating signal and exit 42. The current follow-up has passed build, typecheck and seven whole CLI files (185 tests). Full lint, formatting and bundle passed. The final test-only compatibility condition was followed by fresh build/type, all 20 tests in that whole file, targeted lint, formatting and bundle; the other six whole files (165 tests) are byte-identical. This is 185 unique current tests, not 205 distinct tests. The initial follow-up run retained an ESM-namespace spy fixture failure after its real child had already passed; only the test mock wiring was corrected, without changing production behavior.

The prior candidate separately passed 181 affected tests and three short-fit public sidecar profiles; those passes belong to its earlier artifact and are not new-candidate public qualification. The retained signal matrix is 5 passed / 1 failed, including the Native first-interrupt hint failure also reproduced on the clean baseline. Separate Bun Trust restart failures/NQs remain unresolved. This follow-up does not claim to repair them.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | Build/type/185 unique affected tests, full lint, format/bundle passed; earlier public evidence scoped separately |
| 🪟 Windows | Current follow-up not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | Current follow-up not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node 24 source/build tests, with a separate owned executable child and core dumps disabled. Published commit is `7da3f7ccc6012303ba7441ba6b7655995bebe51c`, tree `1b82b0f10ac4dbccece2746126e71e7adc0823fe`. Build preceded the commit; the later four-design checkpoint preserved every code/test blob and all 1,455 bundle files. Windows or runtimes without execve skip the native-exec fixture; absence of that API retains the legitimate existing exit-42 route and must not be counted as real-exec coverage.

## Historical CI at 7da

Remote CI update for `7da3f7ccc6012303ba7441ba6b7655995bebe51c`: TUI snapshots/no-flicker and both Managed loop jobs succeeded. Qwen CI remains **failed** at [no-AK shard 2, ACP retry-again round-count assertion](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43789339488/job/133046231671), plus its derived aggregate. The three automatic CI attempts recorded differing shared/kernel debug-round counts; requests/updates/stop-reason equality was not reached there. The uploaded failure artifact has JUnit only, without the three-arm dumps/debug logs. A single local Node 24/macOS attempt reached the unchanged assertions with current 0/0, shared 3/0 and kernel 3/3 and equal normalized results; its outer cleanup guard still failed after a SIGTERM to an addressable process group. That is not a full local pass, a Linux reproduction, an infrastructure diagnosis or a waiver of the CI failure. Useful next maintainer/CI-owner evidence is the failed attempt's existing ACP_PARITY_DUMP and retained scratch debug logs, separated by attempt so retries cannot overwrite them. No CI rerun or Core change was made.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: executable checks are observations, not an atomic guarantee. E2BIG, ENOEXEC, noexec mounts, permission changes or mutations after precheck may still cause native runtime abort; the JS catch cannot guarantee terminal42 for all syscall failures. The process-global final marker remains sticky until exec or exit.
- Not validated / out of scope: all exit routes, all filesystems/platforms, installers, native signal handling, Bun post-exec startup and overall migration/stability. No automatic supervisor or retry is introduced. The existing review status is unchanged; no automatic resolution, review request or merge is implied.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no new flags, Core changes or migration requirement. Metadata polling can coalesce intermediate writes. Redundant test consolidation is deferred to preserve unique final-policy coverage and module isolation in this bounded correctness follow-up.

Designs: [exit policy (EN)](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/7da3f7ccc6012303ba7441ba6b7655995bebe51c/docs/design/2026-11-15-cli-final-watcher-exit-chain.md), [退出策略（中文）](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/7da3f7ccc6012303ba7441ba6b7655995bebe51c/docs/design/2026-11-15-cli-final-watcher-exit-chain.zh-CN.md), [polling (EN)](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/7da3f7ccc6012303ba7441ba6b7655995bebe51c/docs/design/2026-11-15-worktree-sidecar-polling.md), [轮询（中文）](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/7da3f7ccc6012303ba7441ba6b7655995bebe51c/docs/design/2026-11-15-worktree-sidecar-polling.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to this PR's first review round; no additional issue is closed.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

在已确认的交互退出和重启前接入既有最终进程 watcher 策略，并将 worktree sidecar 目录监测替换为精确文件、非持久的 500 ms 订阅。切换配置或会话不能显示旧 sidecar，取消订阅只影响所属 listener。

本轮审查后续在清理完成后、原 exec 尝试之前，检查 supervised 原位重启的 launcher 是否解析为普通文件并可执行。已知不可用 launcher 或可捕获 JavaScript 异常会尽力安全报告并以代码 42 终止。无 supervisor 时必须手动重启。成功路径的重启参数、GC 参数及清理顺序不变。

## 为什么需要

最终退出应一致应用既有 watcher 清理策略。Worktree 页脚需能随 sidecar 创建、删除和原子替换更新，而不依赖目录通知。另外，真实 owned 副本测试证明删除 launcher 后可能完成清理却直接终止运行时，无法进入此前的 catch 回退。新预检处理这一已知无效路径情形，不使全部原生 exec 失败变得可恢复。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

确认首次未确认中断仍只提示，已确认退出保持原退出码。进入及离开 worktree，检查当前页脚跟随持久 sidecar。切换 owner、移除 listener、已加载 worktree 后读取失败，以及随后读取恢复，都不应保留过期状态或干扰其他订阅者。

重启失败仅使用 owned 可执行副本验证：启动它、删除该副本，再请求重启。清理应恰好一次，输出可写时应安全报告错误，进程应以 42 退出而非信号中止。确认有效 launcher 参数不变，错误输出流关闭不阻止可捕获错误的回退。禁止删除或修改已安装或全局可执行文件。

### 前后证据

修复前：真实 owned Node 副本删除自身 launcher 后完成清理，随后原生 exec 发生 ENOENT/SIGABRT，而非 42。修复后：真实子进程回归通过，清理已记录、无终止信号且退出码为 42。当前后续候选已通过构建、类型检查与七个完整 CLI 测试文件（185 项）。完整 lint、格式及 bundle 已通过。最终仅改测试兼容条件后，又完成新的 build/type、该整文件全部 20 项、定向 lint、格式及 bundle；另六个完整测试文件的 165 项 blob 不变。当前共 185 项独立测试，不是 205 项。首轮后续检查在真实子进程已通过后遇到 ESM namespace spy 夹具失败；仅修正测试 mock 接线，没有改变生产行为。

此前候选另有 181 项受影响测试及三个 short-fit 公开 sidecar 配置通过；这些属于旧产物，不是新候选的公开验收。原信号矩阵仍为 5 通过 / 1 失败，其中 Native 首次中断提示失败也在干净基线复现。另案 Bun Trust 重启失败及 NQ 仍未关闭，本后续不宣称修复这些问题。

### 已测试环境

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | build/type/185 项独立受影响测试、完整 lint、format/bundle 通过；旧公开证据单独保留范围 |
| 🪟 Windows | 当前后续未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | 当前后续未测试 |

### 运行环境

本地 Node 24 源码及构建测试，使用独立 owned 可执行子进程并禁止 core dump。出版 commit 为 `7da3f7ccc6012303ba7441ba6b7655995bebe51c`，tree 为 `1b82b0f10ac4dbccece2746126e71e7adc0823fe`。构建发生在 commit 之前，后续四文档 checkpoint 保持全部 code/test blob 及 1,455 个 bundle 文件不变。Windows 及不提供 execve 的运行时跳过 native-exec 夹具；缺少该 API 时保留合法的既有退出 42 路径，不能计为真实 exec 覆盖。

## 7da 的历史 CI

远端 CI 更新：TUI snapshots/no-flicker 及 Managed 两条路径成功；Qwen CI 仍因 no-AK shard 2 的 ACP 重试轮次断言和派生汇总失败。CI 自动尝试记录的 shared/kernel debug 轮数不同，尚未执行后续请求、更新及停止原因比较；上传产物只有 JUnit，没有失败当次三路径 dump/debug。本机 Node24/macOS 单次原场景的轮数与归一化结果一致，但外层清理守卫仍因向可寻址进程组发送 SIGTERM 而失败；不是完整本地通过、Linux 复现、基础设施结论或 CI 豁免。下一步需 CI 维护者保留失败当次既有 ACP_PARITY_DUMP 和 scratch debug，按 attempt 分隔，防重试覆盖。未重跑 CI，未改 Core。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：可执行检查只是一次观测，不是原子保证。E2BIG、ENOEXEC、noexec 挂载、预检后的权限或文件变化仍可能导致原生运行时中止，JS catch 不能保证全部系统调用失败都退出 42。进程全局最终标记在 exec 或退出前仍保持 sticky。
- 未验证及范围外：全部出口、全部文件系统及平台、安装产物、原生信号处理、Bun exec 后启动及整体迁移和稳定性。不增加自动 supervisor 或重试。现有审查状态不变，不自动解决讨论、请求审查或合并。
- 破坏性变更及迁移：不新增 flag、不改 Core、无需迁移。Metadata 轮询可能合并中间变化。本轮有界正确性后续暂缓重复测试整合，以保留独有的最终策略覆盖和模块隔离。

设计：[exit policy (EN)](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/7da3f7ccc6012303ba7441ba6b7655995bebe51c/docs/design/2026-11-15-cli-final-watcher-exit-chain.md)、[退出策略（中文）](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/7da3f7ccc6012303ba7441ba6b7655995bebe51c/docs/design/2026-11-15-cli-final-watcher-exit-chain.zh-CN.md)、[polling (EN)](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/7da3f7ccc6012303ba7441ba6b7655995bebe51c/docs/design/2026-11-15-worktree-sidecar-polling.md)、[轮询（中文）](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/7da3f7ccc6012303ba7441ba6b7655995bebe51c/docs/design/2026-11-15-worktree-sidecar-polling.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联问题

对应本 PR 第一轮审查的后续，不额外关闭 issue。

</details>


### R2 and same-attempt CI evidence follow-up — da695eb5508df3322c9006b8bccf7c123883a2b7

Production/Core behavior and the round-count assertion are unchanged. The real restart regression now bundles current source with one shared cleanup module. Fresh full typecheck and its whole 20-test file passed, along with targeted lint, format, references and actionlint. Direct no-AK meta: 15 passed / 4 platform skips; selected changed-job/adjacent contracts: 7 passed / 193 filtered, not whole-file passes. A no-rebuild falsification left the old built-module test passing (child 42) but made the source-bound test fail as expected (native ENOENT/SIGABRT); source/test and all bundle bytes were restored exactly. Historical built-module results above remain scoped to 7da.

Same-attempt evidence now retains per-agent/PID pre-kill/post-exit raw debug, results and observer errors, plus the three existing arm dumps, in failure-only seven-day CI artifacts isolated by run/attempt/shard and cleaned afterwards. Local directed parity passed with unchanged pre/post bytes and counts current 0/0, shared 3/0, kernel 3/3. A separate narrow lifecycle observation also passed without outer signals; it observed one transient child disappearing without outer signals, not reproduction of the whole-file cleanup issue. The whole ACP file still has 25 inner passes / outer cleanup NQ; original Node 22/Linux CI round mismatch remains open. Sync evidence I/O perturbs timing, does not flush the logger and proves no Core cause. No retry/assertion/timeout is relaxed; fresh CI and maintainer review remain required. No automatic thread resolution or state change.

### R2 与 CI 当次证据后续——da695eb5508df3322c9006b8bccf7c123883a2b7

生产/Core 行为及轮数断言不变。真实重启回归现在打包当前源码并共享一个 cleanup 模块。新的完整类型检查与该整文件 20 项通过，定向 lint、格式、引用及 actionlint 通过。直接 no-AK meta 为 15 通过 / 4 平台跳过；选定的变更 job/邻接合同为 7 通过 / 193 过滤，不计整文件通过。不重建反证中，旧构建模块测试仍通过（child 42），源码绑定测试按预期失败（原生 ENOENT/SIGABRT）；源码、测试及全部 bundle 字节随后精确恢复。上述旧构建模块结果仍限定于 7da。

同次证据新增按 agent/PID 的清理前、退出后原始 debug、结果及 observer 错误，保留既有三路径 dump；CI 仅失败时上传七天，按 run/attempt/shard 隔离并清理临时目录。本地定向 parity 通过，pre/post 字节相同，计数为 current 0/0、shared 3/0、kernel 3/3。另一次窄生命周期观测无外层 signal 地通过，仅观察一个短暂子进程在未收到外层 signal 的情况下消失，不是整文件清理问题的复现。ACP 整文件仍为内部 25 项通过 / 外层清理 NQ；原 Node 22/Linux CI 轮数失败仍开。同步存证 I/O 会扰动时序，不 flush logger，不证明 Core 根因。不放宽重试、断言或期限；仍需新 CI 与维护者审查，不自动解决讨论或改变状态。

Design: [EN](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/da695eb5508df3322c9006b8bccf7c123883a2b7/docs/design/2026-11-16-acp-retry-parity-evidence.md) / [中文](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/da695eb5508df3322c9006b8bccf7c123883a2b7/docs/design/2026-11-16-acp-retry-parity-evidence.zh-CN.md).


### Main integration verification — 55dd73c80b98c9cd89b6807fa15c66754363616f

Integrated `main` at `b5698f6b07c32dec2d587dc16d8658ec0abac9cd` to resolve the actual ACP test conflict. Its upstream #17365 settled-log helper and pre-shutdown count read are preserved; the observer still saves pre-kill/post-exit bytes and does not overwrite those counts. This is an ordinary two-parent merge, with no new Core/runtime policy or retry change.

On the integrated source tree `7f238ebe53ec7e129c4999ee4b3326d49e32d908`, fresh full build, full typecheck, full lint, formatting of all 17 PR paths, seven whole CLI files (185 passed), and bundle passed. The fresh source bundle has 1,462 observed files and entry SHA256 `066ccf2fdc777781fd884a1da373d6c766b44cf709225d3e7e39f41a6fbe40c9`. Whole ACP passed all 25 tests and its outer lifecycle: no timeout, cleanup signals or remaining owned process group. Its 365 JSON records contain 74 complete PID-scoped observer sets with empty error lists. Two pre/post raw snapshots changed, while all snapshot round-count projections still matched their recorded results; this is not a general logger-drain guarantee.

The earlier Node 22/Linux failure and earlier 25-inner-pass/outer-NQ remain historical records, not retroactively changed. CI/meta/actionlint sources are unchanged from the separately verified prior follow-up; this does not claim those tools were rerun in the new build gate. New exact-head CI and maintainer review remain required. No automatic resolution, approval, merge, default switch or overall migration completion is implied.

### main 集成验证——55dd73c80b98c9cd89b6807fa15c66754363616f

为解决实际 ACP 测试冲突，集成固定 `main` 的 `b5698f6b07c32dec2d587dc16d8658ec0abac9cd`。保留上游 #17365 的日志稳定读取 helper 及关闭前计数读取；observer 仍保存 kill 前与退出后字节，不覆盖这些计数。采用普通双 parent merge，不新增 Core/运行时策略或重试改动。

集成源码树 `7f238ebe53ec7e129c4999ee4b3326d49e32d908` 新执行完整 build、typecheck、lint、全部 17 个 PR 路径格式、七个 CLI 整文件（185 项通过）及 bundle，均通过。新 source bundle 观察到 1,462 个文件，entry SHA256 为 `066ccf2fdc777781fd884a1da373d6c766b44cf709225d3e7e39f41a6fbe40c9`。ACP 整文件 25 项及外层生命周期通过：无超时、清理信号或残留所属进程组。365 个 JSON 包含 74 套完整 PID 目录 observer 记录，errors 均为空。两处 pre/post 原始快照变化，但所有快照轮次投影仍与记录结果相同；不建立通用日志 drain 保证。

此前 Node22/Linux 失败及此前 25 内部通过/外层 NQ 继续保留，不反向改判。CI/meta/actionlint 源码与此前独立验证的后续相同，不宣称在新构建 gate 中重新执行这些工具。仍需新 exact-head CI 和维护者审查；不自动解决讨论、批准、合并、切换默认或宣称整体迁移完成。


### Public worktree sidecar verification — 55dd73c80b98c9cd89b6807fa15c66754363616f

The same 55dd source tree and `066ccf2f` source-bundle entry now passed the original short-fit public workflow on Node+Ink, Bun+Ink and strict Bun+OpenTUI. Each run used actual owned worktree enter/exit tools, the complete 87-cell ASCII removal command on one physical row, default focused Yes and exactly one approval CR. Current-composer sidecar indicator enter/exit observations were 135/107 ms, 189/262 ms and 125/164 ms respectively, all inside the original 2-second bounds. Each profile made six closed loopback model requests (18 total), reached PTY exit 0/signal 0 before helper cleanup, and removed its owned workspace only after application termination and server close. No Root timeout, cleanup signal, remaining owned process group or source-pin drift occurred. The relocated harness noEmit check also passed.

This qualifies the sidecar indicator and short-fit consent route only. Other Git footer labels visible in a captured Ink transition frame are outside this assertion; it is not evidence that all footer metadata refreshed. Long-command geometry, all inner-process waitpid identities, packaging, Windows/Linux public TTYs, signal/Trust failures, stability and overall migration remain separate. Historical failures and NQs are retained; exact-head CI and review are still required.

### 公开 worktree sidecar 验证——55dd73c80b98c9cd89b6807fa15c66754363616f

同一 55dd 源码树及 `066ccf2f` source-bundle entry 已通过 Node+Ink、Bun+Ink、严格 Bun+OpenTUI 三种原 short-fit 公开流程。每次均调用真实所属 worktree 进入/退出工具，在单一物理行显示完整 87-cell ASCII 删除命令，默认焦点 Yes 且恰一次批准 CR。当前 composer 下 sidecar 指示器进入/退出观察值分别为 135/107ms、189/262ms、125/164ms，均在原 2 秒上限内。每配置六个已关闭 loopback model 请求，共18个；helper 清理前 PTY 自然退出 0/signal0，只有应用终态及服务器关闭后才删除所属工作区。无 Root 超时、清理信号、所属进程组残留或源码绑定漂移。迁入 harness 的 noEmit 检查也通过。

只验证 sidecar 指示器和短命令 consent 流程。某个 Ink 过渡帧中显示的其他 Git 页脚标签不在此断言内，不宣称全部 footer metadata 刷新。长命令几何、全部内层进程 waitpid 身份、安装产物、Windows/Linux 公开 TTY、signal/Trust 失败、稳定性及整体迁移仍独立；历史失败及 NQ 保留，仍需 exact-head CI 和审查。


### Completed CI and bounded footer observation — 55dd73c80b98c9cd89b6807fa15c66754363616f

The exact-head [Qwen CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43817042233), [TUI parity](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43817042213) and [Managed loop](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43817042209) runs completed successfully. Linux lint/build, both unit shards, both Web Shell shards and both no-AK shards passed. The no-AK shard 2 log confirms the exact 55dd checkout on Node 22.23.2: the ACP whole file passed 25 tests, including the previously failing repeated-retry scenario (8.635 s); its shard passed 30 files / 229 tests. Unit shard 1 carries a deflake/rerun annotation and a GitHub issue-creation 502, so this is not a zero-retry claim. Skipped macOS/Windows/installed-package jobs are not passes. The review workflow completed, but the latest substantive review is COMMENTED with five Suggestions and the aggregate remains CHANGES_REQUESTED; workflow success is not approval. These CI results apply to 55dd, not later commits.

A separate Node+Ink current-footer observation passed on the same artifact: initial `main` was observed in 0.456 ms and, after the exit tool had completed, the current composer footer converged to `main` with no sidecar in 194.133 ms. These are distinct new 12-second branch bounds; the original 2-second sidecar indicator oracles remained unchanged. An earlier transition frame still displayed the old branch, so this establishes post-tool convergence for this Node route, not immediate branch refresh, all footer metadata or other runtimes. The run made six loopback model requests and reached exit 0/signal 0 before helper cleanup.

Native SIGINT remains open: the plain 55dd run observed the first hint, then failed the original five-second confirmed-exit bound; there was no pre-helper exit 130. The helper's later exit 129 is not the requested natural-exit pass. A separate nonshipping instrumented run also failed that bound; its finite receiver records showed re-arming rather than confirmation, with a roughly 5.211 s same-install callback interval despite a roughly 409 ms physical-send gap. The pre-helper capture had only the first callback sequence; the second appeared only in the later capture alongside cleanup signals. This does not identify OS-packet delivery, a lock, cleanup fault or root cause. Diagnostic I/O can perturb timing, and the private artifact is not the published candidate or a product pass. Original CI failures and prior NQs remain historical evidence; no new Ready, resolved-thread or migration claim is made.

### 已完成 CI 与有限页脚观测——55dd73c80b98c9cd89b6807fa15c66754363616f

精确提交的 [Qwen CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43817042233)、[TUI parity](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43817042213) 和 [Managed loop](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43817042209) 均已成功完成。Linux lint/build、两单测分片、两 Web Shell 分片和两 no-AK 分片通过。no-AK shard 2 日志确认实际检出 55dd、运行 Node 22.23.2：ACP 整文件 25 项通过，包含此前失败的重复重试场景（8.635 秒）；该分片共 30 文件 / 229 项通过。单测 shard 1 有 deflake/重跑及 GitHub 创建 issue 遇到 502 的注记，因此不称零重试。跳过的 macOS/Windows/安装包任务不计通过。Review workflow 已完成，但最新实质审查为 COMMENTED、五条 Suggestion，汇总仍为 CHANGES_REQUESTED；workflow 成功不是批准。这些 CI 结果仅适用于 55dd，不代表后续提交。

同产物另一次 Node+Ink 当前页脚观测通过：初始 `main` 在 0.456ms 被观察到，退出工具完成后，当前 composer 页脚在 194.133ms 收敛为 `main` 且无 sidecar。这是独立新增的 12 秒 branch 上限，原 2 秒 sidecar 指示器 oracle 不变。此前过渡帧仍显示旧 branch，因此只证明本 Node 流程在工具完成后的收敛，不证明即时刷新、全部页脚 metadata 或其他 runtime。该运行有六个 loopback model 请求，helper 清理前退出 0/signal 0。

Native SIGINT 仍未关闭：未加日志的 55dd 运行观察到首次提示，随后在原五秒确认退出期限失败；helper 前没有退出 130，之后 helper 得到的 129 不是所请求的自然退出通过。独立非发布日志诊断也在该期限失败；有限 receiver 记录显示重新 arm 而非确认，同一次安装内 callback 间隔约 5.211 秒，而物理发送间隔约 409ms。Helper 前快照仅有首次 callback 序列，第二次仅出现在伴随清理信号的后续快照中。不据此判定 OS packet 投递、锁、清理故障或根因。同步诊断 I/O 会扰动时序，私有产物不是已发布候选或产品通过。原 CI 失败及旧 NQ 均保留历史范围，不新增 Ready、已解决讨论或整体迁移结论。


### Failure-evidence robustness — e8360599db0b0bfc0f1a6b420879ded08f70dc2d

The ACP observer now shares the test helper's debug-file enumeration and writes partial result/status receipts even when the original request, cleanup or home-isolation assertion fails. Successful result collection remains after the original cleanup and home assertion. Empty debug enumeration records an observer error. CI keeps exactly four target-owned upload paths, binds their slug to the actual source scenario, and warns on an empty upload. No production logic, business assertions, retries or timeouts change.

Validation: the complete ACP file passed 25 tests with 74 complete status receipts and no observer errors; helper suites passed 17 tests; the no-AK meta file passed 15 with four original Linux-only skips. Three restored source mutations verified the real slug contract failure, partial evidence after the original home assertion failed, and missing-debug evidence NQ even when the business test passed. Build/type/lint/format/reference/actionlint results are recorded with the final source candidate. Earlier setup/selection mistakes and product failures remain separate records.

The overlapping hook-harness consolidation suggestion remains deferred: the current final-exit test really checks prepare→unmount→exact unwatch plus a separate Core control. Consolidation needs to preserve those distinct assertions and module isolation; this change does not remove coverage or claim that suggestion resolved. No review approval, default switch or migration completion is implied.

### 失败存证健壮性——e8360599db0b0bfc0f1a6b420879ded08f70dc2d

ACP observer 现在与测试 helper 共用 debug 文件枚举，即使原请求、清理或 home 隔离断言失败，也保存标记为 partial 的 result/status。成功结果仍在原清理和 home 断言之后采集。空 debug 枚举会记录 observer error。CI 仍只上传四条目标所属路径，将 slug 与真实源码场景绑定，并在无匹配文件时警告。不修改生产逻辑、业务断言、重试或期限。

验证：ACP 整文件 25 项通过，74 份状态均完整且无 observer 错误；helper 测试共 17 项通过；no-AK meta 文件 15 项通过，保留四项原 Linux-only skip。三次已精确恢复的源码变异分别验证真实 slug 合同失败、原 home 断言失败后仍保存 partial 证据，以及业务用例通过时缺失 debug 仍判证据 NQ。构建、类型、lint、格式、引用和 actionlint 结果绑定最终源码候选；之前的配置、筛选错误和产品失败分别保留。

重叠 hook harness 的合并建议继续明确延期：当前 final-exit 测试实际验证 prepare→unmount→精确 unwatch，并有独立 Core control。合并须保留这些断言与模块隔离，本次不删覆盖，也不宣称该建议已解决。不暗示审查批准、默认切换或迁移完成。

The newer public-bootstrap SIGINT counterpart also failed the original one-second first-hint bound after qualifying the actual Bun child and bootstrap parent. In a separate private instrumented input-intervention case, one printable character after the first signal was followed by confirmation and pre-helper exit 130; that supports further input-wakeup investigation, not a plain-signal pass or a fix. All normal-signal failures remain open. CI on e8360599db0b0bfc0f1a6b420879ded08f70dc2d is newly triggered and not covered by the prior 55dd green runs.

新的公开 bootstrap SIGINT 对照在核实实际 Bun 子进程与父入口后，仍在原一秒首次提示门槛失败。另一私有日志诊断在首次信号后仅补一个字符，本次进入确认分支并在 helper 前退出 130；这支持继续调查输入唤醒，不算普通信号通过或修复。普通信号失败仍未关闭。e8360599db0b0bfc0f1a6b420879ded08f70dc2d 的 CI 是新一轮，不能继承此前 55dd 的绿灯。


### Lint-gate main integration — 28d6cf8ca7f0a8b5b44e676103088f3a1cda4ab1

The previous `e8360599db0b0bfc0f1a6b420879ded08f70dc2d` CI attempt failed the lint-gate freshness check because upstream `0c2458a3` changed the ESLint gate. This ordinary two-parent merge incorporates pinned main `e147a0788d1e3e4e67d5b7e64ffebb0b201e8f7b`; its archived Java runtime and related changes are existing maintainer-merged main history, not a new Core refactor authored by this PR. The Common 19 paths retain exactly their previous bytes and modes. Relative to that main parent, the PR remains 19 paths / 1,202 additions / 178 deletions (gross 1,380).

Current integrated verification passed: full build, full typecheck, full lint, formatting, linked design references and actionlint; 12 complete CLI files / 504 tests, helper suites / 17 tests, no-AK meta / 15 passes with four original Linux-only skips, and the complete ACP file / 25 tests. All 74 observer statuses were complete with no observer errors. Root consumed the actual terminal without timeout, forced signals or leftover owned groups. The 1,462-file source bundle is tied to tested tree `949c8916`, built while HEAD was `e836`, entry SHA `19d7b72b7c8721d4617007b8de2ef1ad2149f6d4267c0d39876774578e31c613`; this source/tree bridge is explicit and is not installed-release qualification. Exact-head CI at `28d6cf8c` completed successfully: [Qwen CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43839282226), [TUI parity/no-flicker](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43839282370), and [Managed loop](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/43839282254). Linux lint/build, both unit shards, Web Shell and no-AK checks passed. Skipped macOS/Windows and installed-package jobs are not passes. The review aggregate remains CHANGES_REQUESTED; these checks do not imply approval or merge. Ordinary Native SIGINT remains unresolved and the isolated eager-stderr experiment is not part of this PR. Keep the e836 freshness failure, earlier ACP failures/outer NQs and Native SIGINT failures in their original scope. This is gate integration and revalidation, not a new runtime fix or an explanation of those failures. Existing review disposition remains; no automatic resolution, approval, Ready or merge is implied.

### lint gate 的 main 集成——28d6cf8ca7f0a8b5b44e676103088f3a1cda4ab1

此前 `e8360599db0b0bfc0f1a6b420879ded08f70dc2d` 的 CI 因上游 `0c2458a3` 改动 ESLint gate 而在 freshness 检查失败。本普通双亲 merge 合入固定 main `e147a0788d1e3e4e67d5b7e64ffebb0b201e8f7b`；其中 Java runtime 归档及相关改动属于维护者已合并的 main 历史，不是本 PR 新撰写的 Core refactor。Common 19 路径的字节与 mode 均保持此前版本不变。相对此 main parent，PR 仍为 19 路径 / 增加 1,202 行 / 删除 178 行（gross 1,380）。

本次集成验证已通过：完整 build、typecheck、lint、格式、互链设计引用及 actionlint；12 个 CLI 整文件 / 504 项测试、helper / 17 项、no-AK meta / 15 项通过并保留四项原 Linux-only skip，以及 ACP 整文件 / 25 项。74 份 observer status 均完整且无观测错误。Root 已消费实际终态，无 timeout、强制信号或所属组残留。1,462 文件源码 bundle 绑定受测 tree `949c8916`，构建时 HEAD 为 `e836`，entry SHA 为 `19d7b72b7c8721d4617007b8de2ef1ad2149f6d4267c0d39876774578e31c613`；明确区分源码 tree 与构建 HEAD，不冒已安装发布产物资格。精确提交 `28d6cf8c` 的 Qwen CI、TUI parity/no-flicker、Managed loop 均已成功完成；Linux lint/build、两单测分片、Web Shell 及 no-AK 检查通过。跳过的 macOS/Windows 与安装包任务不计通过。审查汇总仍为 CHANGES_REQUESTED，不表示批准或合并。普通 Native SIGINT 仍未解决，隔离的 eager-stderr 实验不在本 PR 中。保留 e836 freshness 失败、旧 ACP 失败及外层 NQ、Native SIGINT 失败各自原范围。本次为 gate 集成及重新验证，不是新增运行时修复，也不解释上述失败。既有审查状态保留，不自动解决讨论、批准、设为 Ready 或合并。

prs.title: feat(cli): add native generated-skill review
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Restores generated-skill review in OpenTUI: keep or discard individual skills or all remaining skills, edit the actual staged file and refresh its preview, defer a task with Escape, and disable automatic generation without deleting the pending batch. Review owns input before queued prompts can drain; selected-session and task changes revoke stale actions. The existing Ink surface also receives a narrow bare-Escape and review/composer ownership correction. The shared native editor preserves Memory behavior, with a one-line CommonJS boundary repair for its owned test launchers. No Core production policy or API changes are included.

## Why it's needed

A generated skill must remain a proposal until the user decides. The native surface previously lacked this decision flow, and ordinary native completed-tool bookkeeping did not reach the existing worker threshold. This change uses the existing manager and public bookkeeping methods, preserving the20-tool threshold, permissions, staging and promotion policy. It is based directly on frozen main `dab5253c`, after Memory merged as `12f13d09`; the Memory feature is not resubmitted.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-11-14-opentui-skill-review.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-14-opentui-skill-review.zh-CN.md).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Generate proposals through the real20-read worker route. Check individual and bulk decisions, stable selection as the batch shrinks, Escape deferral across successive tasks, persistent disable followed by Memory re-enable, and disabled generation producing no worker. Edit a staged file and confirm preview refresh without implicit acceptance; an editor exit7 must retain the proposal and show an error. Queue a user prompt while the worker completes: review must appear first, and the queued prompt must resume exactly once after an explicit decision. Confirm unrelated files and settings remain unchanged. Replacing the session or task must invalidate old callbacks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The matching frozen candidate and bundle `7ef650d9` passed A–H on Node24/Ink, Bun1.4.4/Ink and strict Bun1.4.4/OpenTUI:24 application passes,108 closed model HTTP requests and24 natural exits. Two strict Native Memory editor regressions passed with modelHTTP0 and two natural exits. The combined result is26 application passes and26 natural exits, not26 recorded outer tool successes:25 complete tool-terminal records exist; one Native Escape-deferral case has a passing durable application result and clean controller receipt but a missing exact tool chunk/exit archive. That archiving failure is disclosed and is not a product failure or a fabricated tool record.

Same-source normal qualification consists of successful build/typecheck,11 whole CLI files(976 passed,2 skipped), three workflow metadata files(395 passed,4 skipped), targeted zero-warning lint, formatting and bundle. The original wrong Node metadata invocation is retained; corrected repository Vitest completed metadata without repeating the first three successful stages. Thirty build warnings remain recorded. Earlier failures stay in the detailed E2E record. On the same frozen source, native SkillReview geometry passed all 10 fixture cases across five viewport sizes and single/bulk batches: 184 saved frames, 40 complete focused-label checks and 228 one-row wheel events. Complete preview/error text, actual scrollbar clearance, nonoverlapping options, one Escape dismissal and unchanged staged bytes were verified. This is component fixture layout evidence, not real worker, GUI, OS resize or complete application acceptance. A separate Source partial-acquisition run on the same product bundle `7ef650d9` passed Node24/Ink and Bun1.4.4/Ink, while strict Bun1.4.4/OpenTUI still failed at deny-b. That Source gate remains open; the 26 SkillReview/Memory application passes do not close it.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | Local Darwin application observations above |
| 🪟 Windows | NOT_RUN on this integrated candidate |
| 🐧 Linux | NOT_RUN on this integrated candidate |

### Environment (optional)

Frozen main `dab5253c` plus the26-file increment, Node24.19.0, Bun1.4.4, one matching built bundle, owned temporary workspaces and real tool execution against a closed local model fixture. This is not latest/final-main or installed-package qualification.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: existing manager operations cannot atomically cancel filesystem writes already dispatched before ownership changes; bulk decisions are not a transaction.
- Not validated / out of scope: CI/maintainer approval, real GUI editors, Windows/Linux, OS resize, IME/accessibility, devices and whole migration acceptance. The separate Native extension-acquisition failure remains open. Defaults and Ink remain unchanged; no release or automatic merge.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none intended. The existing public task and approval policies remain in force. This is proposed as Draft pending review.

## Linked Issues

No issue is closed by the validation claims above.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

恢复 OpenTUI 生成技能审核：逐项或批量保留/丢弃、编辑实际 staged 文件并刷新预览、Escape 延后任务，以及关闭自动生成但保留未决批次。审核在排队提示 drain 前取得输入所有权，所选 session 或 task 改变后撤销旧操作。既有 Ink 表面另补局部裸 Escape 和审核/composer 所有权修正。共享原生编辑器保持 Memory 行为，owned 测试 launcher 另补一行 CommonJS 边界。不修改 Core 生产策略或 API。

## 为什么需要

生成技能在用户决定前必须仍是提案。原生界面此前缺少决策流程，普通原生完成工具记账也未达到既有 worker 阈值。本改动复用已有 manager 和公开记账方法，保持20工具阈值、权限、staging 与 promotion 策略。直接基于冻结 main `dab5253c`，Memory 已以 `12f13d09` 合并，不重复提交其功能。

设计：[英文](docs/design/2026-11-14-opentui-skill-review.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-14-opentui-skill-review.zh-CN.md)。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

通过真实20-read worker 路线生成提案。验证单项/批量决策、批次缩短时选择稳定、连续任务间的 Escape 延后、持久关闭后通过 Memory 重开，以及禁用时没有 worker。编辑 staged 文件应刷新预览但不隐式批准；编辑器 exit7 应保留提案并显示错误。worker 完成时排队用户提示：审核须先出现，明确决策后队列仅恢复一次。无关文件和设置不变，session/task 替换应使旧回调失效。

### 前后证据

对应冻结候选与 bundle `7ef650d9` 在 Node24/Ink、Bun1.4.4/Ink 和 strict Bun1.4.4/OpenTUI 下通过 A–H：24次应用通过、108次完整关闭模型 HTTP、24次自然退出。另两项 strict Native Memory 编辑器回归通过，模型 HTTP0、自然退出两次。合计26次应用通过及26次自然退出，不等于26份已记录外层工具成功：现有25份完整工具终态；一项 Native Escape 延后案保留通过的持久应用结果和干净 controller receipt，但精确工具 chunk/exit 归档缺失。该归档失败如实披露，不当作产品失败或伪造工具记录。

同源码正常验证包括 build/typecheck、11份 CLI 整文件测试(976通过、2跳过)、三份 workflow metadata(395通过、4跳过)、定向零警告 lint、格式及 bundle。原误用 Node metadata 调用的失败保留，更正后用仓库 Vitest 完成 metadata，未重跑前三个成功阶段。30条构建警告保留，旧失败详见独立 E2E 记录。同一冻结源码上的 Native SkillReview 几何夹具在五组 viewport、单项/批量两类下十案通过：184份保存帧、40项完整焦点标签检查、228次单行滚轮事件。核对完整预览/错误文本、实际滚动条避让、选项不重叠、一次 Escape 延后及 staged 字节不变。这仅为组件夹具布局证据，不代表真实 worker、GUI、OS resize 或完整应用验收。同一产品 bundle7ef650d9 的独立 Source 部分安装场景中，Node24/Ink 和 Bun1.4.4/Ink 通过，严格 Bun1.4.4/OpenTUI 仍在 deny-b 失败。Source 门槛仍开放，26项 SkillReview/Memory 应用通过不能关闭它。

### 已测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | 仅上述本机 Darwin 应用观察 |
| 🪟 Windows | 本整合候选 NOT_RUN |
| 🐧 Linux | 本整合候选 NOT_RUN |

### 环境（可选）

冻结 main `dab5253c` 加26文件增量，Node24.19.0、Bun1.4.4、同一构建 bundle、自有临时工作区以及真实工具执行和关闭完整的本地模型 fixture。不代表最新/最终 main 或安装包资格。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：已有 manager 操作无法原子取消所有权改变前已经发出的文件写入，批量决策不是事务。
- 尚未验证或不在范围内：CI/维护者批准、真实 GUI 编辑器、Windows/Linux、OS resize、IME/无障碍、设备及整体验收。独立 Source 路线的 Native 扩展安装失败仍未关闭。不切默认、不移除 Ink、不发布或自动 merge。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：不预期。保持既有公开 task 和审批策略，拟以 Draft 交付审阅。

## 关联事项

上述验证不关闭 issue。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): batch extension refresh and retain healthy watchers
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Extends this existing Draft from a partial-installation experiment into a focused Source installation correction: finish all selected plugin decisions before one additional CLI runtime refresh while preserving each Core installation’s existing refresh, retain healthy extension watchers when their physical roots and manager remain unchanged, and admit the real partial-installation case into the dedicated three-renderer CI lane. It keeps the existing single-install refresh behavior, explicit consent, partial-success accounting and owned Git-fixture cleanup. It does not change Core policy or include temporary diagnostic logging.

## Why it's needed

Installing A and denying B should produce one success and one failure without delaying the next consent behind a duplicate CLI runtime refresh. Replacing a state file atomically should not require destroying otherwise healthy extension watches. The public experiment is needed to distinguish these behaviors from cold-start and exit failures that still remain open. This remains Draft, not Ready.

Design: [partial acquisition](docs/design/2026-11-14-extension-partial-acquisition-acceptance.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-14-extension-partial-acquisition-acceptance.zh-CN.md), [batch refresh](docs/design/2026-11-15-opentui-extension-batch-refresh.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-15-opentui-extension-batch-refresh.zh-CN.md), [watcher reuse](docs/design/2026-11-15-opentui-extension-watcher-reuse.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-15-opentui-extension-watcher-reuse.zh-CN.md).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Approve A and deny B; confirm exact partial status and cleared selection. Explicitly select only B and give fresh consent, then inspect both persisted identities, activation policy and hot/cold command availability. Require the complete requested command prefix inside the actual composer as well as the suggested command name; a matching suggestion alone does not prove all input arrived. Confirm metadata refresh still works after state-file replacement, linked-root changes and manager replacement, and that stopping the watcher prevents stale callbacks from restarting it.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The candidate is based on main checkpoint `dab5253c`, not latest or final main, and excludes the separate SkillReview feature and temporary diagnostic logging. The latest prefix-admission candidate freshly passed build, typecheck, changed-test lint, formatting and bundle. Fourteen other production/helper/CI files are byte-identical to the earlier Source composition, whose normal checks recorded 148 CLI tests and 218 metadata/helper tests passing with four Linux-only skips; these 366 scoped passes were not rerun or counted as new tests. The earlier document-formatting failure remains recorded, followed by a verified document-only correction.

The current `64467dcc` three-profile matrix is **Node/Ink PASS, Bun/Ink FAIL, strict Bun/OpenTUI FAIL**, with one whole-case execution per profile and no retries. Node completed hot and cold behavior with two natural exits. Both Bun profiles completed the hot installation/partial/reselection/consent/persistence/completion chain and naturally exited once, then failed the unchanged 30-second cold-start readiness wait; startup-failure cleanup eventually required SIGKILL. The three executions recorded 99 phases, four natural exits, two forced cold teardowns, 53 catalog/Git HTTP requests and zero model HTTP requests. This Draft does not claim the Source acceptance gate is closed.

Seven earlier saved frames showed that a suggested command name could appear before the complete requested prefix reached the composer. The new observation gate also requires the full prefix inside the actual composer without changing inputs, waits, phases or retry policy. Eight actual completion frames and their eight subsequent clear frames were independently checked in the new matrix: both commands in each Bun hot session and both commands in Node hot/cold sessions. This qualifies the narrower observation behavior, not a product-input fix or general terminal-layout guarantee. The earlier Bun clear failure and Native hot-exit failure on `22d7`, and older candidate results, remain separate historical records.

A separate temporary diagnostic and one identity-qualified cold-start OS sample showed a Bun main-thread lock wait and a CF thread registering FSEvents while cold readiness was still pending, before failure cleanup. The Bun frames are stripped; the specific watcher, mutex holder and cause remain unknown. A small public watcher-registration probe completed within 15 seconds on both runtimes but recorded a much slower asynchronous ready interval on Bun in that single observation. It explicitly exits after registration and does not establish natural exit, close behavior, a performance distribution or a fix. These diagnostics are excluded from this production tree. No further whole-application sampling is part of this PR update.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | Fresh build/type/lint/format/bundle; actual matrix 1 PASS / 2 cold-start FAIL |
| 🪟 Windows | Not run; this Git HTTP fixture is not qualified on Windows |
| 🐧 Linux | Dedicated CI wiring included; remote functional result not yet qualified |

### Environment (optional)

Node 24.19.0, Bun 1.4.4 and OpenTUI 0.5.10, owned HOME/workspace/runtime/temp and a real loopback HTTP catalog/Git publisher. The case keeps 120-second execution, local 15-second / CI 45-second conditions and zero retries; recorded experiments used a separate 180-second outer cap. Startup and exit budgets are unchanged.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: watcher reuse changes CLI configuration infrastructure and requires Tier 2 maintainer judgment; mocked watcher lifecycle tests do not qualify native events on every platform. Observer file writes may affect timing.
- Not validated / out of scope: Bun cold startup on both renderers, historical natural-exit failures, Linux/Windows, installed distribution, hook-sensitive plugins, original local-directory publisher semantics and overall migration. No default switch, Ink removal, release or merge approval is requested.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none intended. This is one coherent Source behavior and acceptance increment; unrelated SkillReview changes and all temporary Core/CLI diagnostics are excluded. CI functional acceptance is not claimed merely because a test was added to the lane.

## Linked Issues

No issue is closed. This updates the existing Draft #17269 in place with the coherent Source correction and its actual failure evidence. It remains Draft: no Ready transition, reviewer request, merge, release or external dispatch is requested.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

在现有部分安装实验 Draft 上增加一项聚焦 Source 修正：完成所有所选插件决策后统一做一次额外 CLI runtime 刷新，Core 每项安装原有刷新保持不变；物理监测根与 manager 未改变时保留健康 watcher；将真实部分安装用例接入专用三 renderer CI。保持单项安装刷新、明确同意、部分成功计数及 owned Git fixture 清理。不改变 Core 策略，不包含临时诊断日志。

## 为什么需要

安装 A、拒绝 B 应得到一成功一失败，不应让重复 CLI runtime 刷新延迟下一同意。state 文件原子替换也不应销毁仍健康的扩展监测。公开实验用于区分这些行为与仍未解决的冷启动、退出失败。继续保持 Draft，非 Ready。

设计：[部分安装](docs/design/2026-11-14-extension-partial-acquisition-acceptance.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-14-extension-partial-acquisition-acceptance.zh-CN.md)、[批次刷新](docs/design/2026-11-15-opentui-extension-batch-refresh.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-15-opentui-extension-batch-refresh.zh-CN.md)、[watcher 复用](docs/design/2026-11-15-opentui-extension-watcher-reuse.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-11-15-opentui-extension-watcher-reuse.zh-CN.md)。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

批准 A、拒绝 B，确认精确 partial 状态与选择清空。明确仅选择 B 并重新同意，检查两个持久身份、激活策略及热冷命令可用性。除建议命令名称外，还要求实际 composer 显示完整请求 prefix；建议名称匹配不能证明全部输入已到达。验证 state 文件替换、link 根变化及 manager 替换后元数据刷新仍有效，停止 watcher 后旧回调不能重新启动它。

### 前后证据

候选基于 main 检查点 `dab5253c`，并非最新或最终 main，排除独立 SkillReview 功能及临时诊断日志。最新 prefix 准入候选已重新通过 build、typecheck、改动测试的 lint、格式及 bundle。其他十四份 production/helper/CI 文件与此前 Source 组合逐字节一致；此前正常检查记录 148 项 CLI、218 项 metadata/helper 测试通过以及四项 Linux-only 跳过。这 366 项分范围通过未重跑，也不计为本轮新增测试。此前文档格式失败原样保留，之后有明确的仅文档修正桥接。

当前 `64467dcc` 三 profile 矩阵为 **Node/Ink 通过、Bun/Ink 失败、strict Bun/OpenTUI 失败**，每 profile 各执行一遍完整用例、零重试。Node 完成热冷行为并两次自然退出。两个 Bun profile 均完成热态安装、partial、重选、同意、持久化及补全链，并各自然退出一次；随后均在未改的 30 秒冷启动 ready 等待失败，启动失败清理最终需要 SIGKILL。三次执行共记录 99 个 phase、四次自然退出、两次冷态强制清理、53 个 catalog/Git HTTP 请求和零模型 HTTP。本 Draft 不宣称 Source 验收门槛关闭。

此前七份保存帧显示，建议命令名称可能在完整请求 prefix 显示于 composer 前就出现。新观察门槛额外要求实际 composer 内有完整 prefix，未改变输入、等待、phase 或重试策略。新矩阵中的八份实际 completion 帧及之后八份 clear 帧已独立核验：两个 Bun 热会话各两个命令，以及 Node 热冷会话各两个命令。这只使更窄的观察行为取得资格，不是产品输入修复或任意终端布局保证。此前 `22d7` 的 Bun 清空失败、Native 热退出失败以及其他旧候选结果均独立保留。

另一个临时诊断和一次身份核同的冷启动 OS 采样，在 ready 尚未到达、失败清理开始之前观察到 Bun 主线程锁等待和 CF 线程注册 FSEvents。Bun 栈已剥离符号，具体 watcher、锁持有者和根因仍未知。小型公开 watcher 注册探针在两个 runtime 均于 15 秒内完成，但这次单次观察中 Bun 的异步 ready 明显更慢。探针在注册后显式退出，不证明自然退出、关闭行为、性能分布或修复。以上诊断均不进入生产候选树；本 PR 更新不包含更多完整应用采样。

### 已测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | 最新 build/type/lint/format/bundle；实际矩阵一通过、两项冷启动失败 |
| 🪟 Windows | 未运行；此 Git HTTP fixture 在 Windows 尚未取得资格 |
| 🐧 Linux | 专用 CI 接线已纳入；远端功能结果尚未取得资格 |

### 环境（可选）

Node 24.19.0、Bun 1.4.4、OpenTUI 0.5.10，owned HOME/workspace/runtime/temp 与真实 loopback HTTP catalog/Git publisher。整案保持 120 秒、local15 秒/CI45 秒条件和零重试；记录实验另有 180 秒外层上限。启动、退出预算未变。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：watcher 复用涉及 CLI config 基础设施，需要 Tier 2 维护者裁决；mock 生命周期测试不使各平台 native 事件取得资格。observer 写盘可能扰动时序。
- 尚未验证或不在范围内：两个 renderer 的 Bun 冷启动、历史自然退出失败、Linux/Windows、已安装分发、hook-sensitive 插件、原本地目录 publisher 语义及整体迁移。不请求切默认、删除 Ink、发布或合并批准。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：不预期。这是完整 Source 行为和验收增量，排除无关 SkillReview 及全部临时 Core/CLI 诊断。测试被接入 CI 不等于真实 CI 功能验收通过。

## 关联事项

不关闭 issue。在现有 Draft #17269 原位呈现完整 Source 修正与实际失败证据。继续保持 Draft，不请求转 Ready、指定审查者、合并、发布或外部派发。

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): Add native OpenTUI trust management
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes `/trust` actionable in OpenTUI: choose folder trust, parent trust or no trust, cancel without writing, and restart when the effective trust decision changes. It preserves the existing trust evaluator and locked writer, binds actions to the selected live workspace and reports failed writes or restarts truthfully. Small terminals can scroll through complete choices and restart hints.

Shared CLI relaunch now performs the existing watcher exit preparation before cleanup. The public regression also runs on both Ink runtimes so the restart behavior is checked beyond the new dialog.

## Why it's needed

The native command previously displayed only a read-only trust value. During complete real-restart validation, the prior candidate also saved a decision but sometimes failed to produce a fresh Bun application session. Preparing watchers before irreversible process cleanup closes the missing lifecycle step; the exact native blocking stack was not captured, so this PR does not claim a proven FSEvents root cause.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open `/trust` in a trusted workspace. All three choices should be available. Parent trust with unchanged effective trust saves immediately; an effective trust change remains pending until `r`. Escape must discard it. Restart twice, first to untrusted and then to trusted: each should reconstruct the application in the same terminal, preserve unrelated trust rules, and support a subsequent cold launch. A stale or mismatched workspace must never write or restart another runtime. In narrow terminals, navigate and scroll until full labels and hints are visible.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the native baseline displayed the read-only placeholder. The prior full-restart candidate retained real Native/BunInk failures, including cleanup signal9. After: this exact source passed the complete public scenario on Node+Ink (76.57s), Bun+Ink (101.38s) and strict Bun+OpenTUI (84.63s): six real restarts, twelve natural exits, zero model requests and no cleanup errors. Five actual native terminal sizes and real page-key scrolling passed. Build, typecheck, full zero-warning lint, formatting and bundle passed; 224 relevant CLI tests and 202 workflow meta-tests passed. Four Linux-only meta-tests were skipped on macOS. Earlier failures remain failures.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS arm64 | Local Node 24.19.0 / Bun 1.4.4; verification recorded below |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Not tested locally; four Linux-only meta-tests skipped on macOS |

## Risk & Scope

- Process relaunch is irreversible; owner checks precede the trust commit and cleanup. Its five existing callers all exit or re-execute the CLI.
- Core policy, trust storage, update relaunch, default renderer and Ink production dialogs remain unchanged. Native device, Windows, installed-package and final migration acceptance are separate.
- English and Chinese design documents are synchronized: [English](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-trust-manager-20261114/docs/design/2026-11-14-opentui-trust-manager.md), [中文](https://github.com/chiga0/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-trust-manager-20261114/docs/design/2026-11-14-opentui-trust-manager.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of the ongoing Ink → OpenTUI migration.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本变更补齐 OpenTUI 的 `/trust`：可选择当前文件夹、父文件夹或不信任；取消不写入；有效信任变化时按 `r` 后才保存并重启。复用原信任求值及带锁写入，操作绑定当前选中工作区，读写或重启失败显示真实错误。小终端可滚动查看完整选项和提示。

共享 CLI 重启在 cleanup 前补上已有 watcher 退出准备。完整公开回归同时覆盖两种 Ink 运行时，不仅测试新原生对话框。

此前原生命令只有只读值。完整真实重启测试还发现旧候选在 Bun 下写入后可能没有新 session；本次补齐退出准备步骤，但未捕获具体原生阻塞栈，不宣称已证明 FSEvents 根因。

评审请检查三种选择、父信任立即保存、有效变化延期到 r、Escape 丢弃、两次真实重启、新 session 和同一终端、无关信任规则保持、冷启动持久化及小终端完整文字。过时或不匹配工作区不得写入或重启其他 runtime。

变更前的只读占位与旧 Native/BunInk 的真实失败（包括 cleanup signal9）永久保留。修后相同源码的完整公开场景在 Node+Ink（76.57秒）、Bun+Ink（101.38秒）和严格 Bun+OpenTUI（84.63秒）全部通过：合计六次真实重启、十二次自然退出、零模型请求及零清理错误。五种真实原生终端尺寸与实际翻页键通过；build、typecheck、全量零 warning lint、format、bundle、224项相关 CLI 测试和202项工作流元测试通过；macOS 上四项 Linux 专属元测试跳过。旧失败仍保留为失败。

本机为 macOS arm64，Node24.19.0/Bun1.4.4；Windows、Linux 未在本机实测，四个 Linux 专属元测试跳过。重启不可逆，owner 校验必须先于提交及 cleanup；五个既有消费者均退出或重新执行 CLI。Core 政策、信任存储、更新重启、默认 renderer 和 Ink 对话框生产代码不变。设备、Windows、安装产物及整体迁移验收独立保留。双语设计完整同步。本变更属于持续 Ink→OpenTUI 迁移。

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): add OpenTUI agent creation and read-only details
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Replaces the OpenTUI agent-creation placeholder with manual and Qwen-guided creation, including location, description, tools, color and explicit save confirmation. Adds read-only agent selection and details that work both immediately after saving and after restarting the CLI. Existing Ink color selection now persists canonical color ids accepted by the parser.

Pending generation and save results lose authority when their configuration owner changes or the dialog closes. Cancelling generation retains the editable description; a late response cannot advance the form or overwrite a newer request. Persistence stays with the existing manager and its commit checks. No Core implementation changes are included.

This PR builds on #17148, #15948, #15950 and #15951. Its feature series starts at the current #15951 head and includes the CI follow-up. The increment is 18 files, +2736/-101; the current cumulative upstream-main diff is 33 files, +3565/-152 (gross 3717). Prerequisite changes remain visible until the stack is integrated.

## Why it's needed

OpenTUI exposed `/agents create` as an unusable placeholder, while `/agents manage` could not open a selected agent's details. Users could not complete the existing Ink creation workflow in the native renderer. The existing Ink selector also emitted the display label `Blue` instead of the serialized id `blue`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Open `/agents create`, cancel at the location screen, and confirm neither agent store changes.
- Choose Manual Creation, enter a name, prompt and description, select tools and Blue, then inspect the confirmation. There must be no file before Save; saving creates the exact project Markdown with `color: blue`, without changing user-level agents or sending a model request.
- Use the deterministic guided interactive case to hold the first generation request, cancel it, and release its response late. The description must remain editable and both stores unchanged. A second explicit generation must populate the review flow through the existing schema, without saving until confirmation.
- Open `/agents manage`, select the new agent and View Agent. Check its description, prompt and color, back out, quit, restart, and inspect the same details and file. Viewing must not mutate either store; both public quits must finish naturally.
- Retain the owner-change, duplicate-submit and stale-completion regressions when reviewing the asynchronous paths.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Cropped actual PTY viewport text from the source-bundle runs:

```text
Before:
Subagent Create

After:

Step 6: Confirm and Save

Tools: *
Color: blue
Description: Use this agent when validating owned guided creation.
System Prompt: You are an owned guided test subagent. Reply only OWNED_GUIDED_REPLY.
```

Initial feature validation: normal build, typecheck, lint and formatting passed, together with 116 tests across six affected whole CLI files. All six complete public cases passed on one source bundle: manual and guided creation under Node/Ink, Bun/Ink and strict Bun/OpenTUI. They completed twelve natural exits; manual cases made zero model requests, and guided cases made six owned loopback requests total, comprising three cancelled and three completed schema responses. A separate E2E report comment records the scope and commands.

Vitest 3.2.7; isolated owned homes, workspaces and temporary directories; deterministic loopback model fixture; zero test retries. The six public runtime cases belong to the source bundle before the documentation-only status update, matching all thirteen production/test files in the initial head 72447e43. The follow-up 726fe086 changes only a stable ref-object alias in production and updates the virtual-list geometry fixture; those six cases were not rerun on that follow-up. prs.title: fix(cli): bound OpenTUI extension dialog content widths
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps both the frame and content of direct extension choice and settings dialogs inside the shared OpenTUI popup bounds. At 80/120/200 terminal columns, the frame starts at column 2 and is 76/100/100 columns wide; the content budget is 72/96/96 columns. The current head is `956cf8f0`: seven files, 114 additions and 13 deletions, including synchronized design checkpoints. The extension dialog feature itself is already on main.

## Why it's needed

The direct routes originally passed terminal-based content widths of 76/116/196. Capping the content alone fixed that budget but left the surrounding frame terminal-wide. The final change also constrains the two direct mounts, so the border and content agree with the existing popup layout. This addresses the [maintainer's P1 review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15950#discussion_r4567427980) and the [frame-width Critical](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15950#discussion_r4568757938).

Design checkpoints: extension choice [English](docs/design/2026-10-31-opentui-extension-plugin-choice.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-10-31-opentui-extension-plugin-choice.zh-CN.md), and setting input [English](docs/design/2026-10-31-opentui-extension-setting-input.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-10-31-opentui-extension-setting-input.zh-CN.md).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open the public extension install flow and inspect the direct plugin picker and settings prompt at 80, 120 and 200 terminal columns. Confirm a two-column left inset, frame widths of 76/100/100 and content widths of 72/96/96. The border must stay capped on wide terminals. Cancel the picker, then exercise settings consent; enter a distinguishable 110-character value once, resize through those widths, save it and confirm the stored value is exact. Confirm normal quit exits naturally and neither route issues a model request.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The initial six content regression cases failed with 76/116/196 instead of 72/96/96. The first content-only fix passed its scoped tests and real tmux value-preservation witness, but that witness still showed terminal-wide borders. Those earlier passes do not establish the final frame correction.

A subsequent native replay using the real direct shell branches and widgets failed all six physical frame cases: x0 and terminal-wide borders. After the parent-bound correction, the unchanged replay passed all six cases. A separate complete strict Bun/OpenTUI tmux CLI run also passed all six painted bounds:

| Terminal columns | Frame left column | Frame width | Content budget |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 80 | 2 | 76 | 72 |
| 120 | 2 | 100 | 96 |
| 200 | 2 | 100 | 96 |

That full CLI run covered public picker cancellation, settings consent and exact preservation of the once-entered 110-character value, followed by a natural exit0/signal0, zero model requests and no forced cleanup. These results belong to the frozen `aa02d998 + 6cd975d6` source and bundle `3ac63a1d`; the subsequent follow-up changed documentation only. They are local macOS evidence, not an installed or final merged-main candidate. The before and after evidence uses distinct candidates, not a same-main performance comparison.

Post-correction normal build, five whole CLI test files totaling 248 passing tests, typecheck, full zero-warning lint, formatting and bundle passed. Earlier content-only 163-test and composed 180-test results remain historical evidence with their original scope.

The earlier CI at `e3fc8569` passed TUI parity, no-flicker, Linux unit, build/lint and no-AK checks, but Web Shell smoke failed on the Copy label. The new head inherits the exact test-only correction already merged in [#17187](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17187) (`6f754be6`): it exercises the intended container-width band without changing visibility or selection assertions. The original case failed locally before that correction, and the merged-main case passed afterward. On the updated width candidate, the complete table file produced 20 passes, 1 skip and 1 different failure: the fullscreen nonmodal case observed a missing body scroll lock while the saved page showed Session loading. Its cause remains unknown and this failure is retained. Formatting, zero-warning lint for the changed test and full Web Shell typecheck passed. The original six width files are byte-identical; this follow-up changes no product logic or CSS. New-head CI is separate evidence and must finish before any all-green claim.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local normal checks, native geometry and complete strict Bun/OpenTUI tmux flow |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally; CI results are listed separately above |

### Environment (optional)

Local macOS, Bun 1.4.4 and the frozen built bundle. Fixtures use owned temporary directories; the setting value and public controls are real. Unrelated later upstream changes are outside these local results.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: wide terminals intentionally use the existing 100-column popup cap; text viewports are narrower than the previous terminal-wide layout.
- Not validated / out of scope: local Windows/Linux runs, broader extension lifecycle or migration acceptance, and unrelated Web Shell smoke repair. Nonblocking duplication/key suggestions remain separate from this focused width correction.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no intended API, configuration, queue, policy or persistence changes.

## Linked Issues

Addresses the width and frame review findings on this PR; no unrelated issue is closed.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

让直接打开的扩展选择和设置对话框，其边框与内容都遵守共享 OpenTUI 弹窗边界。在 80/120/200 列终端下，边框从第 2 列开始，宽度为 76/100/100，内容预算为 72/96/96。当前 head 为 `956cf8f0`：七个文件，增加 114 行、删除 13 行，包含同步的设计验证记录。扩展对话框功能本身已在 main 上。

## 为什么需要

直接路由原先传入按终端计算的内容宽度 76/116/196。仅限制内容虽然修正了该预算，但外边框仍然占满终端。最终修正也约束两处直接挂载的父容器，让边框与内容共同遵守已有弹窗布局。本次回应[维护者的 P1 审查](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15950#discussion_r4567427980)与[边框宽度 Critical](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15950#discussion_r4568757938)。

设计验证记录：扩展选择[英文](docs/design/2026-10-31-opentui-extension-plugin-choice.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-10-31-opentui-extension-plugin-choice.zh-CN.md)，设置输入[英文](docs/design/2026-10-31-opentui-extension-setting-input.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-10-31-opentui-extension-setting-input.zh-CN.md)。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

从公开的扩展安装流程打开直接插件选择器和设置提示，分别使用 80、120、200 列终端。确认左侧缩进两列、边框宽度为 76/100/100、内容宽度为 72/96/96；宽终端下边框必须保持上限。取消选择器，再执行设置同意流程；仅输入一次可辨识的 110 字符值，在三个宽度之间调整终端，保存后确认磁盘值逐字一致。确认正常退出自然结束，且两条路由都不发起模型请求。

### 前后证据

最初六个内容回归用例均失败，得到 76/116/196，而预期是 72/96/96。第一版仅内容修复通过了其范围内的测试和真实 tmux 值保留验证，但该验证仍显示终端全宽边框。这些早期通过不证明最终边框修正。

后续使用真实直接 shell 分支和控件的 Native 回放，六个物理边框用例全部失败：x0 且边框占满终端。约束父容器后，原样回放六案全部通过。另一次完整 strict Bun/OpenTUI tmux CLI 流程也通过全部六个绘制边界：

| 终端列数 | 边框起始列 | 边框宽度 | 内容预算 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 80 | 2 | 76 | 72 |
| 120 | 2 | 100 | 96 |
| 200 | 2 | 100 | 96 |

该完整 CLI 流程覆盖公开插件选择取消、设置同意，以及仅输入一次的 110 字符值精确保留；随后自然退出0/signal0、模型请求为0、无强制清理。结果属于冻结的 `aa02d998 + 6cd975d6` 源码与 bundle `3ac63a1d`，其后跟进仅修改文档。这是本地 macOS 证据，不代表已安装候选或最终合并 main。前后证据使用不同候选，不是同一 main 的性能对比。

修正后的正常构建、五个完整 CLI 测试文件共 248 项通过、类型检查、全量零警告 lint、格式检查和 bundle 均通过。早期仅内容修复的 163 项、组合候选的 180 项结果按原范围保留。

此前 `e3fc8569` 的 TUI parity、no-flicker、Linux 单测、构建/lint 与 no-AK 检查均成功，但 Web Shell smoke 在 Copy 文字可见性处失败。新 head 原样同步了已合并 [#17187](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17187)（`6f754be6`）的测试修正：让用例落入目标容器宽度区间，不改变可见性或选择断言。原用例在本地先复现失败，已合并版本的对应单案随后通过。在更新后的宽度候选上，完整表格文件为 20 通过、1 跳过、1 个不同失败：全屏 nonmodal 用例读取到 body 缺少滚动锁，取证页面显示 Session loading。该失败原因仍未知，原记录保留。修改测试的格式、零警告 lint 和完整 Web Shell 类型检查通过。原六个宽度文件字节不变，此跟进未改产品逻辑或 CSS。新 head 的 CI 是另一组证据，完成前不宣称全绿。

### 已测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地正常检查、Native 几何和完整 strict Bun/OpenTUI tmux 流程 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未进行本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未进行本地测试，CI 结果单独列于上文 |

### 环境（可选）

本地 macOS、Bun 1.4.4 和冻结的已构建 bundle。fixture 使用自有临时目录，设置值与公开控件均为真实流程。其后无关上游变化不属于本地验证结果。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：宽终端有意遵守已有 100 列弹窗上限，文本视窗比此前的终端全宽布局更窄。
- 尚未验证或不在范围内：本地 Windows/Linux、扩展更完整的生命周期或整体迁移验收，以及无关 Web Shell smoke 修复。非阻塞的重复代码/key 建议与本次聚焦宽度修正分开处理。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：不预期改变 API、配置、队列、政策或持久化行为。

## 关联事项

回应本 PR 的宽度和边框审查问题，不关闭无关 issue。

prs.title: fix(cli): own direct extension setting input
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Routes direct extension setting requests through the existing OpenTUI modal queue. The current configuration owns each request; pending input survives normal rerenders and is cancelled on replacement or unmount. Consecutive requests have independent drafts and settlement. The existing Source setting widget is reused without changing its input behavior.

## Why it's needed

A public non-sensitive setting reproduction saved the correct value, but native typing also reached the composer and the subsequent quit failed to exit naturally. Ink controls completed the same fixture. The direct native command fell back to a separate stdin prompt because only consent was registered; this change gives setting input the same explicit UI ownership.

This change now includes the watcher-exit prerequisite #17148 and participates in the current W→S→T→U review stack below. The already-merged #15947 and b74f34b9/ec0e bases are historical validation context. Its setting bridge adds no Core, Source-acquisition, manual-agent, provider or headless policy behavior.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Install an owned extension requiring one non-sensitive label. Approve installation, enter the label in the focused setting dialog, and confirm its exact stored value. Typing must not enter the composer, and the normal quit command must exit. For queue ownership, verify ordinary rerenders retain the input, separate requests keep separate values, and cancellation/configuration replacement/unmount reject pending requests. Late submissions must not settle another request.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: native persisted the exact .env value but showed simultaneous prompt/composer input and failed natural quit; the original complete native case remains FAIL. Three Ink controls passed, including an installed baseline whose source identity is unknown. No unique kernel raw-mode cause is asserted.

After: the precommit setting bridge on b74f34b9 passed normal full build/typecheck/lint/bundle/native and298 tests in five whole CLI files. Existing Source widget behavior remains unchanged. Two public cases passed across strict Bun+OpenTUI, Node+Ink and Bun+Ink; a separate source-unknown installed Ink baseline passed both cases as well. Together these are eight executions/two unique cases,12 actual natural exit0/signal0 outcomes and zero model requests, independently matched from saved results. The actual tested entry is `7fd97e9ee34f8461a8e828d8439fab34661fff0a47790e2dca27ee878bbd3852`, not a postcommit shipping artifact.

Save checks exact native manifest/local source/.env, no composer submission, ordinary quit, then cold restart with identical entire authority/artifact/raw maps and public text-list visibility before another natural quit. The list is text output, not manager navigation. In a separate fresh workspace, one Escape at setting input acknowledges cancellation, preserves the initialized snapshot and allows natural quit. The readonly fixture is unchanged. After inheriting the stable manager test fixture, this worktree also passed all24 additional headless real-shell voice tests; audio/devices/transports remain mocked, and these24 are separate from298. A fresh full build/typecheck/bundle on b74f34b9 and six new current-profile executions qualified the final entry; the unchanged installed baseline was not rerun.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | Full normal gates and298 tests passed; current three profiles plus separate installed baseline passed save/cold and cancel cases. |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested for this change. |
| 🐧 Linux | Not tested for this change. |

## Risk & Scope

- The existing consent/shell FIFO now includes configuration-owned settings. Cleanup never restores a no-op or overwrites a successor registration.
- Source's explicit setting callback retains precedence; Core APIs and transaction boundaries remain unchanged. Cancellation cannot roll back a completed Core commit.
- Public reproduction uses one non-sensitive setting; sensitive/keychain storage, other setting scopes and overall migration remain outside current evidence.
- [English design](docs/design/2026-10-31-opentui-extension-setting-input.md) / [中文设计](docs/design/2026-10-31-opentui-extension-setting-input.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Depends on #17148; #15947 is an already-merged prerequisite. No automatic closing reference.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

将直接安装扩展的设置请求接入现有 OpenTUI 模态队列。请求归当前配置所有，普通重渲染保留，替换或卸载取消；连续请求保留独立草稿和结算。复用既有 Source 设置组件，不改输入行为。

公开非敏感设置复现中，原生虽保存正确值，相同输入也进入 composer，随后 quit 未自然退出；Ink 对照完成同一 fixture。原生仅注册了确认，直接设置落到独立 stdin prompt，本改动补明确的 UI 所有权。当前包含 watcher 退出前置 #17148，并参与下述 W→S→T→U 审查栈；已合并的 #15947 及 b74f34b9/ec0e 基础只作为历史验证上下文。设置桥不增加 Core、Source 获取、手动 agent、provider 或 headless 策略行为。

评审应安装owned单标签扩展，同意安装后在聚焦设置框输入，核精确持久化，确保输入不进入composer并可正常退出。另验证普通重渲染保留输入，独立请求各自结算，取消/替换/卸载拒绝等待，旧提交不能结算后继。

原 native 保存.env但输入混流且未自然退出的整案FAIL保留；三Ink对照P，其中安装基线source未知。当前b74f34b9基础的precommit设置桥已通过完整build/type/lint/bundle/native、五个CLI整文件298P。两个公开case在strict Bun+OpenTUI、Node+Ink、Bun+Ink各通过，独立source未知安装Ink基线也通过，共八执行/两唯一/12次真实exit0signal0自然退出/模型0，保存结果独审核同。实际入口7fd97e9ee34f8461a8e828d8439fab34661fff0a47790e2dca27ee878bbd3852不冒提交后的发布产物。

保存检查精确manifest/本地源/.env、无composer提交，热退出后冷启动全权限/产物/raw快照同，公开文本列出扩展再自然退出；不证明manager导航。另一个新工作区在设置输入单Esc确认取消、初始化快照不变并自然退出。只读fixture不变。继承稳定manager测试夹具后，本工作树额外的headless真实shell语音整文件24P，音频/设备/传输均mock，与298分列。b74f34b9基础重新完成完整build/typecheck/bundle，并以六次当前配置执行验证最终入口；未重跑不变的安装基线。

macOS已验证上述检查与限定case，Windows/Linux未测。现有FIFO纳入配置所有的设置，清理不恢复noop或覆盖继任；Source明确回调仍优先，CoreAPI/事务不改，不能回滚已提交事务。只测非敏感值，不声明keychain/设备权限、全scope、安装最终main或hook生命周期资格，整体迁移仍未完成。双语设计同步，当前依赖17148；15947为已合并基础，无自动关闭引用。

</details>

## Current combined review evidence / 当前组合审查证据

This dependency stack is W [#17148](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17148) (`ca5c12c6`) → S [#15948](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15948) (`df0b1f71`) → T [#15950](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15950) (`d61e5d50`) → U [#15951](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15951) (`e6d36a90`). Parallel review is useful; integration must account for these dependencies. No automatic merge is authorized.

The shared U candidate, tree `05d23c58`, passed normal build/typecheck/lint/format/bundle and seven whole CLI test files (640 tests). Independent saved-result review confirmed six public executions: setting clear/save/cold reload and selected Beta approval/install/cold reload under Node/Ink, Bun/Ink and strict Bun/OpenTUI, with twelve natural exit0/signal0 outcomes and zero model HTTP requests. This is combined W+S+T+U evidence, not independent S-only or T-only runtime validation. All original failures remain preserved.

Separately, committed U `e6d36a90` and its single owned tarball (`efed228d…`) passed 33 local installed/distribution test executions: 9 installed checks plus 12 each under Node22 and Node26, independently audited. These are Darwin arm64 scoped results, not 33 natural exits or unique scenarios: each 12-case distribution run includes eight natural exits and four expected exit1 refusals, plus four model HTTP requests. Earlier T documentation's “approved installation unqualified” describes its earlier candidate; the later combined Beta approval result above does not qualify arbitrary original user-publisher mutation semantics or Core hook lifecycle.

These changes are CLI-only. Review readiness is not maintainer approval/C=0, final merged-main acceptance, all-platform/device/sensitive-storage qualification, user semantic approval, or permission to publish, change the default renderer or remove Ink. Skipped platform jobs remain skipped. Any new CI or review finding must be addressed before integration.

当前依赖栈为 W #17148（`ca5c12c6`）→ S #15948（`df0b1f71`）→ T #15950（`d61e5d50`）→ U #15951（`e6d36a90`）。可以并行审查，整合仍须处理上述依赖；不授权自动合并。

共享 U 候选 tree `05d23c58` 已通过正常 build/typecheck/lint/format/bundle 及七个 CLI 整文件的 640 项测试。独立保存证据审查确认六次公开执行：Node/Ink、Bun/Ink、严格 Bun/OpenTUI 各自验证 setting 清空/保存/冷重载及选择 Beta 后批准/安装/冷重载，共十二次自然 exit0/signal0、零模型 HTTP。这是组合 W+S+T+U 的证据，不是独立 S 或 T 的运行验证；原失败全部保留。

另有已提交 U `e6d36a90` 的同一 owned tarball（`efed228d…`）通过 33 次本机安装/分发测试执行：9 项安装检查及 Node22、Node26 各 12 项，并经独审。范围仅 Darwin arm64；不是 33 次自然退出或 33 个独立场景。每组 12 项分发测试含八次自然退出、四次预期 exit1 拒绝及四次模型 HTTP。T 旧文档中“批准安装未资格化”指旧候选；后继组合 Beta 批准证据不代表任意用户原目录变更语义或 Core hook 生命周期已获认可。

这些改动仅限 CLI。进入审查不等于维护者批准/C=0、最终 merged-main 验收、所有平台/设备/敏感存储资格或用户语义批准，也不授权发布、切换默认 renderer 或删除 Ink。跳过的平台任务仍是跳过；整合前仍须处理新增 CI 或审查问题。

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds OpenTUI manual agent creation and management through the existing public manager: exact persistence, hot/cold details, configured-editor edits, tools/color changes and explicit deletion while preserving project/user identity. Builtin, extension and session agents remain read-only. Canonical color persistence and compact creator geometry are corrected without changing Core APIs or the default renderer.

This remains Draft #15921 and depends on #15908. Candidate `9313b41f28e6619eac9eb9581025930c47e07ac3` preserves the corrective2bd commit, signed remote merge81, validated2f60 and ordinary merges32953/9313 incorporating required upstream9eb/e7fe gate ancestors. The source comparison against frozen e7fe is41 paths/5,535 added-deleted lines; final remote comparison may differ and is checked before publication. Publication requires remote head81 unchanged and never force-updates another author's change.

## Why it's needed

Ink already exposed agent creation and mutation while the old OpenTUI path lacked them. A real native probe later found creator screens growing to37/36/35 rows inside an11-column/12-row region and hiding the method choice. Caller-local measured chrome and a compact bounded body correct that Critical without changing input/save ownership or normal-width labels.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Create a project agent manually; cancel without writing, navigate back with draft text intact, and save canonical color explicitly. Reopen and restart to confirm exact name, prompt and description. Viewing/back must remain read-only; editor/tools/color/confirmed deletion affect only the selected owned agent, leaving a same-name user agent intact. Failed or cancelled operations must retain the appropriate files without duplicate writes.

At narrow width, location/manual labels remain readable and typing reaches the name field without painting outside the region. Normal width retains full labels and keyboard behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The original0a34 native failure remains:37/36/35 rows with overpaint/no method label. The corrected original probe passed six observations (narrow12-row frames and normal19-row frames, Pr…/Ma… visible); the permanent suite preserves original132 observations plus six creator screens with actual name input. Earlier collection/mock/type/native/color failures remain recorded.

Normal build/typecheck/lint/bundle and native verification actually ran on producer commit32953. The later metadata merge9313 has identical CLI, Core, integration-test, package-manifest and lockfile Git projections. These checks are reused as source-projection evidence, not described as a fresh9313 build. The actual tested bundle entry is `002ae92e007ef4c8bb81bcef86742e56f26c330089b1b3c5d61ecac8a39f41c2`; its builder identity remains32953. No matching9313 shipping/installed artifact is claimed.

On the resulting9313 checkout, thirteen whole CLI files passed423 tests and two affected script files passed127 tests. An earlier13-file attempt failed in an owned long temporary path with tsx EINVAL; it remains failed. The successful second invocation changed only the owned temporary root, preserving product source and assertions.

The current full public matrix passed on strict Bun+OpenTUI, Node+Ink and Bun+Ink:15 executions/five unique cases,24 observed natural session exits with exit0/signal0 and zero model requests. All15 saved results/request logs and all three receipts were read and matched. The twelve editor results record source9313 and the exact32953-built entry; the three Source results omit source fields, so their provenance comes from the shared actual runner/binding rather than invented fields. Independent saved-result review matched all15 outcomes,24 exits,zero requests and the66 actual prelaunch finite named inputs. It performed no fresh live/full-system rehash and establishes the five named behaviors, not every agent capability or a complete native/transitive closure.

Earlier evidence remains separate:0a34 had146P and15 executions/five unique cases/24 natural exits/model0; the first corrective tree had148P and manual-only3 executions/six natural exits/model0;2f60 had208P and its own15-execution matrix. Failed publications70542 and93433 remain preserved and did not update the remote ref.

The new metadata/reference fixture tests passed37 with one skip (38 registered; root-required service-account ownership case); the workflow contract file passed115 with five skips (120 registered; Linux-only host-lock/Maven-cache cases). These exercise synthetic metadata/jar fixtures and workflow contracts, not a real current Java annotation-processor build. The real annotation-processor-generated reference equality check remains pending CI because current Spring metadata was not generated locally; fixture tests do not replace that check.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | Applicable32953 normal/native checks;9313 thirteen whole files423P, affected scripts127P, five-case three-profile matrix15P/24 natural exits/model0. |
| 🪟 Windows | No current agent-creation/mutation runtime qualification. |
| 🐧 Linux | No current agent-creation/mutation runtime qualification claimed. |

### Environment (optional)

Owned workspace/config/runtime/editor fixtures, deterministic loopback fake model API, existing Node24 and Bun1.4.4. Source bundle identity is distinct from installed artifacts and final merged-main release acceptance.

## Risk & Scope

- Compact caller geometry measures actual wrapped chrome; input/save owner behavior remains intact.
- Guided generation, user-level disk E2E, every narrow wizard page, installed mutation and other platforms remain outside these established results.
- No Core API, agent format, renderer default, Ink removal or release change. [English design](docs/design/2026-10-30-opentui-manual-subagent-creation.md) and [中文设计](docs/design/2026-10-30-opentui-manual-subagent-creation.zh-CN.md) remain synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Depends on #15908. Update existing Draft #15921 and its existing E2E report only.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 通过现有公共 manager 补齐 OpenTUI 手动创建与管理，包括精确持久化、热冷详情、配置编辑器、工具/颜色及显式删除，保持 project/user 身份；内置、扩展和 session agent 只读。创建器 caller 的窄区限高修复保留输入和保存 owner，不改 Core API、默认 renderer、Ink 或发布。

当前候选9313保留2bd修正、已有签名81、已验证2f60，以及32953/9313的普通 merge 历史；纳入9eb/e7fe门槛祖先。相对冻结e7fe为41路径/5,535增删行，发布前另检查实际远端比较与81旧 head，绝不强推覆盖。

原0a34在11×12区域绘制37/36/35行、隐藏方式项的失败保留。修后原probe六项通过：窄区12行、常规19行、Pr…/Ma…可见；永久native保留原132项并增六项含姓名输入。普通build/type/lint/bundle/native实际生产者为32953；9313仅合并元数据，其CLI/Core/集成测试/根manifest/lockfile投影与32953完全同，因此复用的是前驱源码投影证据，不伪称9313重新构建。实际测试入口002ae92e…由32953生成，不声明9313安装/发布产物。

9313当前13个CLI整文件423P、两个受影响script整文件127P。第一次13文件因owned长TMP触发tsx EINVAL的失败保留；第二次仅缩短owned临时根，不改产品或断言。五个公开case在strict Bun+OpenTUI、Node+Ink、Bun+Ink共15执行/五唯一/24次exit0 signal0自然退出/模型请求0；已读全部15结果/请求和三个receipt。12个editor结果记录9313和实际入口，三个Source结果无source字段，仅按同次runner/binding关联，不补造字段。独立保存结果审查核同15结果/24退出/零请求和66项实际prelaunch具名输入，未新增live或全系统重采。此前0a34、首次修正及2f60结果各保原范围，70542/93433发布失败与所有历史F保留，不冒当前结果。

新增metadata/reference fixture为37P/1skip（总38），workflow合同为115P/5skip（总120），只证synthetic metadata/jar及workflow；真实annotation processor生成元数据后的页面一致性仍待CI，不能由fixture测试替代。Windows/Linux未声明当前agent创建/修改runtime通过；引导生成、user级磁盘、全部窄页、安装态修改、完整native/transitive闭包及整体迁移不在当前已证范围。评审应验证取消不写、草稿返回、规范颜色、热冷精确读取、查看只读、受选身份内编辑/删除和同名user保护。仍为依赖15908的草稿，只更新既有PR与E2E报告。

</details>
